cce96fe6.title: Presales Consultant
cce96fe6.description:
**Job Title (Designation) :** Senior Executive/ Assistant Manager - Presales

**Reporting to:** Team Lead **-** Presales  
 **Office Location :** Bengaluru/ Hyderabad  
 **Mode of Work :** Work from Office

**Preferred Industry:** Any / Fresher graduate can also apply.

  

**Job Overview:** We are seeking a highly motivated and energetic Presale Executive to join our dynamic real estate team. This role is perfect for individuals with a passion for dynamic, strong communication skills, and a drive to achieve results. You will play a crucial role in supporting our sales efforts through client engagement, including cold calling, and promoting our real estate offerings.

  

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelors degree in any discipline.
* Fresher’s can also apply
* Exceptional verbal and written communication skills; fluency in English, Hindi is preferable.
* A strong interest in real estate and the ability to quickly learn about industry trends and market dynamics.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and familiarity with CRM software.
* Previous experience in cold calling or sales is a plus.
* A proactive, high-energy approach with a demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team-oriented environment.
* Strong organizational skills with attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
* A positive attitude and a passion for delivering excellent customer service

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Cold Calling:** Proactively identify and reach out to potential clients through cold calls, introducing our services and generating interest in our real estate offerings.
* **Client Engagement:** Build and maintain relationships with prospective clients, understanding their needs and providing tailored solutions to enhance customer satisfaction.
* **Product Knowledge:** Develop a deep understanding of our real estate offerings, including residential, commercial, and investment properties, to provide informed insights to clients.
* **Sales Support:** Assist the sales team during client meetings, presentations, and negotiations, bringing enthusiasm and energy to every interaction when needed.
* **Feedback Collection:** Actively gather client feedback and insights to continually enhance our service offerings and sales approach.
* **Collaboration:** Work closely with cross-functional teams, including marketing and operations, to ensure a seamless client experience.

  

**Benefits to employees:**

* Provident Fund ( If Applicable)
* Paid Leaves + Festival Holidays
* Medical Insurance + Personal Accident Insurance
* Maternity and Paternity leaves
* Unlimited Incentives
* Weekly, Monthly, and Quarterly Rewards to best-performing employees

35b9999e.title: Architect
35b9999e.description:
Thoughtful Natives Architects is a design practice dedicated to creating meaningful, sustainable, and human-centered architecture. We believe in thoughtful, context-sensitive design that enhances communities and the environment. Our work spans residential, commercial, and cultural projects, each approached with innovation, craftsmanship, and a deep respect for place. Job Description: We are seeking a talented and passionate Architect to join our collaborative studio. The ideal candidate will have strong design sensibilities, technical expertise, and a commitment to thoughtful, sustainable architecture. You will work closely with our team to develop innovative design solutions from concept through construction, ensuring projects align with our firm’s ethos of purposeful and enduring design. Key Responsibilities: - Lead and contribute to the design development of architectural projects across various scales and typologies. - Produce schematic designs, detailed drawings, 3D models, and construction documents using industry-standard software. - Collaborate with clients, consultants, and contractors to ensure design integrity and project success. - Conduct site visits, surveys, and construction administration to oversee project execution. - Research materials, building systems, and sustainable practices to integrate into design solutions. - Present design concepts to clients and stakeholders with clarity and confidence. - Mentor junior team members and contribute to a culture of creativity and excellence. Qualifications & Skills: - Professional degree in Architecture (B.Arch or M.Arch). - Minimum of 2 years of experience in an architectural practice. - Strong proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, and rendering tools (e.g., Enscape, Lumion, V-Ray). - Experience in all phases of design, from concept to construction documentation. - Knowledge of building codes, zoning regulations, and sustainable design principles (LEED, Passive House, etc. is a plus). - Excellent design sensibility, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail. - Strong verbal, written, and visual communication skills. - Ability to work collaboratively in a dynamic studio environment. Why Join Us? - Work on inspiring, socially conscious projects that make a difference. - Collaborate with a passionate, creative team in a supportive studio culture. - Opportunities for professional growth and leadership development. - A commitment to sustainability, craftsmanship, and thoughtful design.

Job Types: Full-time, Permanent

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

27accf51.title: Domain Solution Architect
27accf51.description:
**Job Title: BFS Digital Solution Architect Lead Advisor - BPS**
**Req ID:**
372422
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a BFS solution architect to join our team in India (hybrid/remote), reporting to the Global Head of BFS Solutions, Agentic AI and BPS.
  
  
**BPS Solution Architect**
At NTT DATA Services, we know that with the right people on board, anything is possible. We’re building the next era of Business Process Services—AI-native, agentic BPaaS that fuses deep process expertise with LLMs, AI agents, and data-first design. This is not outsourcing 2.0—it’s services-as-software, built for scale, speed, and intelligence.
  
  
Join our founding team and reinvent how banks and financial services lend, serve, and grow, with AI native operations built to be faster, smarter, and more adaptive than anything the market has seen.
  
  
Location: Hybrid/Remote Type: Full-Time Role
  
  
Overview:
  
  
You will design AI native solutions for lending and banking operations within the BFS solutioning team. You will work alongside client stakeholders, product teams, and engineers to map current state operations and Co create the future state processes and solution designs for banks and financial services.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
:
  
  

* Understand BFS client workflows (commercial / small business lending, onboarding, servicing, KYC / AML) and pain points
* Design solution components for ai-native landing operations, leveraging modular agentic platforms
* Define data and process models in collaboration with ontology and ML teams
* Translate client needs into use cases, requirements and demo scenarios
* Build business cases, collateral, and inputs to proposals, RFPs, and POVs
* Support client presentations and workshops, presenting solutions sections to senior stakeholders

**Required Skills**
:
  
  

* 8-12 years in the BFS domain, with depth in lending operations
* Strong understanding of digital transformation and BPS
* Experience in designing automation workflows or BPaaS models
* Excellent client-facing communication and executive storytelling skills
* Familiarity with AI/ML concepts, even if not hands-on

**Preferred Skills**
:
  
  

* Onboarding and KYC / AML familiarity
* Exposure to collections, loss mitigation, or mortgage and consumer lending business processes
* Understanding of model risk management and AI governance
* Hands-on knowledge of intelligent document processing for spreading, statements, and loan documents
* Lean Six Sigma certification; MBA

d82bc170.title: Senior Data Architect
d82bc170.description:
CSS Innovation Studios is seeking Senior Data Engineers/Architects with deep expertise in PySpark and data engineering to deliver strategic AI and data-transformation programs for Oracle’s largest enterprise customers.

In this senior, customer-facing role, you will design, build, modernize, and operationalize enterprise-scale data platforms and AI-driven data solutions on Oracle AI Data Platform (AIDP) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). You will work directly with CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, chief architects, engineering leaders, and Oracle product teams to accelerate AI adoption, modernize legacy data estates, and deliver secure, high-performing production solutions.

The role combines hands-on software and data engineering with technical consulting. You will develop scalable systems supporting generative AI, large language models, real-time analytics, and modern data workloads; lead complex platform implementations and migrations; and partner with architects, product managers, and engineers to apply and evolve Oracle product capabilities through real-world customer deployments.

* 10–12+ years of experience designing, architecting, and delivering enterprise-scale data platforms.
* Proven experience as a Senior Data Engineer, Data Architect, Principal Solution Architect, Consulting Engineer, or technical leader in professional services.
* Expert knowledge of one or more modern cloud data platforms like Databricks
* Extensive hands-on experience with Apache Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Python, SQL, Scala or Java, Kafka and modern data ecosystems.
* Exposure to building autonomous agents and orchestration pipelines.
* Deep expertise in Spark architecture, configuration, distributed systems, performance engineering, optimization, and tuning at scale.
* Demonstrated success modernizing enterprise analytics platforms and refactoring Spark and ETL workloads.
* Must have a solid understanding of networking concepts to design and optimize data transmission networks, configure network settings, and diagnose and resolve network-related issues.
* Strong understanding of DataOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, data security, governance, metadata, lineage, and observability.
* Outstanding executive communication, customer advisory, and stakeholder-management skills.

  

Lead architecture and delivery of enterprise Oracle AI Data Platform transformations, including platform implementations and migrations.

* Design and build scalable, governed, AI-ready data architectures, software components, and services for data consolidation, integration, transformation, and data products.
* Develop Lakehouse, Medallion, streaming, and real-time analytics solutions on OCI using technologies such as Spark, PySpark, Delta Lake, Parquet, Flink, and distributed-systems patterns.
* Build AI/ML and Generative AI data pipelines, including feature engineering, feature extraction, MLOps workflows, and vector-ready datasets.
* Assess and modernize workloads by refactoring PySpark and ETL code and optimizing Spark configuration, cluster sizing, partitioning, memory, adaptive query execution, reliability, and performance at scale.
* Develop APIs, SDKs, web applications, and automation frameworks that simplify adoption of Oracle AI Data Platform and Generative AI services.
* Create reusable migration accelerators, reference architectures, automation frameworks, and delivery methodologies.
* Collaborate with engineering, product, and field teams to solve complex technical challenges; share customer insights to inform product roadmaps.
* Serve as a trusted technical advisor throughout customer engagements.
* Mentor senior engineers globally, promote engineering excellence across CSS, and continuously evaluate emerging AI, cloud, and data-engineering practices.

1e97be04.title: AI Customer Engineer, Digital Natives, Google Cloud
1e97be04.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience working within tech startups or digital-native organizations.
* Experience engaging with, and presenting to, technical stakeholders and executive leaders.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in developing financial services or telecommunication agents using frameworks such as LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, or the Google AI Agent Development Kit (ADK).
* Experience with cloud technologies including SaaS applications, iPaaS, business automation solutions, Cloud infrastructure, Agentic AI, and cloud networking.
* Knowledge of integration patterns using OpenAPI and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to connect AI agents with business systems and Application Programming Interface (API) Gateways.
* Knowledge of observability constructs including distributed tracing, logging, and audit logging for AI applications.

**About The Job**
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.
  
  
Leading with the future, the AI GTM team are trusted AI advisors, expanding across Google to deliver transformative customer experiences that shape the next generation of their business. Partnering to provide AI expertise, thought leadership, and industry best practices, we revolutionize customer outcomes.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Drive the technical solution for complex workloads within AI product areas to ensure rapid and successful adoption, primarily supporting the business cycle from technical evaluation through customer ramp.
* Combine business strategies and direct development and prototyping to provide functional, customer-tailored solutions that secure buy-in from customer domain experts.
* Provide technical consultation to customers, acting as a technical advisor and building customer relationships.
* Leverage learnings from customer engagements to contribute to reusable solutions and assets with the Go-to-Market team. Travel to customer sites, conferences, and other related events as required, acting as a public advocate for Google Cloud.
* Work within product and engineering management systems to document, prioritize and drive resolution of customer feature requests and issues.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

cac8f488.title: Cloud AI Engineer, Technical Onboarding Center
cac8f488.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
  
  
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3 years of experience in software engineering, cloud architecture, or technical consulting, infrastructure with 2 years of experience in building and deploying GenAI applications, intelligent agents, or LLM-powered solutions to production.
* Experience building and orchestrating agents using ADKs, LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen and in designing modern application architectures, including API design, microservices, and integrating AI models into existing enterprise software systems.
* Experience with Python.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field.
* Google Cloud Professional certifications.
* Experience implementing scalable RAG architectures and securely connecting LLMs with external productivity tools (e.g., Google Workspace) and complex enterprise databases in high-traffic environments.
* Experience leading technical project deployments, working with engineering teams, or acting as the technical lead on large-scale cloud transformations.
* Experience deploying, configuring, and managing enterprise-grade generative AI platforms (particularly Gemini Enterprise), with an understanding of AI security, Large Language Models (LLM) governance, guardrails, and enterprise compliance requirements (e.g., data privacy regulations).

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a Cloud AI Engineer, you will play a key leadership role in ensuring that strategic customers have the best experience adopting Gemini Enterprise alongside the broader Google Cloud Agentic AI suite of products. You will design and implement robust, production-ready application architectures to support customer use cases, leveraging Gemini Enterprise and core Google AI products. You will work with customers to identify opportunities to transform their workflows with autonomous agents, actively removing technical barriers to ensure successful deployment and high adoption rates of Gemini Enterprise. You will have access to Google’s technology to monitor application performance, debug and troubleshoot complex agent behaviors, and address customer and partner needs. In this role, you will lead the end-to-end and timely execution of adopting Google Cloud Platform solutions to the customer.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead the delivery, deployment, and implementation of Gemini Enterprise solutions, utilizing Agent Development Kits (ADKs) to solve complex, enterprise-scale technical customer challenges.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor to Google’s most strategic customers to shape their AI strategy, drive, and accelerate the adoption of Gemini Enterprise.
* Provide architectural guidance on existing product challenges, collaborate closely with the engineering team to address gaps, and architect scalable workarounds for edge cases.
* Deliver leading practice recommendations and technical presentations adapted to different levels of key business and technical stakeholders (including C-suite executives) to proactively foster Gemini Enterprise adoption and enablement.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

e49adf1c.title: GenAI Solution Architect
e49adf1c.description:
Lead Solution Architect – GenAI & Cloud  
**Job Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Gurgaon, Haryana  
**Work Mode:** Hybrid  
**Experience:** 10+ Years

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Lead Solution Architect – GenAI & Cloud to design and deliver scalable, secure, and reliable technology solutions across cloud computing, application architecture, and Generative AI.

The ideal candidate will have strong software development and solution architecture experience, with the ability to take proof-of-concepts (PoCs) and minimum viable products (MVPs) into production-ready enterprise solutions. The role requires hands-on technical expertise, architectural decision-making, and collaboration with cross-functional engineering and business teams.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and implement scalable, secure, and resilient application and cloud architectures.
* Lead the development and production deployment of PoCs, prototypes, and MVPs.
* Design solutions involving Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI agents.
* Provide hands-on technical guidance across application development, cloud infrastructure, APIs, integrations, and data platforms.
* Develop and guide the implementation of microservices, distributed systems, containerized applications, and serverless solutions.
* Establish CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), DevSecOps practices, automated testing, and application monitoring.
* Apply security, performance, scalability, reliability, and cost-optimization principles throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Develop reusable architecture patterns, engineering standards, and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with cloud, cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, and delivery teams to ensure production readiness.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend suitable solutions for enterprise adoption.
* Conduct architecture and code reviews and mentor developers and engineering teams.
* Support the transition of validated solutions to production and enterprise support teams.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* 10+ years of experience in software engineering, application architecture, cloud architecture, or solution design.
* Proven experience in hands-on software development and delivering PoCs or MVPs into production environments.
* Strong knowledge of AWS and/or Microsoft Azure cloud platforms.
* Experience with REST APIs, microservices, distributed systems, Docker, and Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, automated testing, and application security.
* Practical understanding of AI/ML and Generative AI architecture.
* Familiarity with Python, Java, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Understanding of cloud-native architecture, system integration, observability, and performance optimization.
* Strong problem-solving, technical leadership, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.

Preferred Skills

* Hands-on experience building LLM-based applications, RAG pipelines, AI agents, and vector database integrations.
* Knowledge of AI guardrails, responsible AI practices, and Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Experience with serverless architecture, infrastructure automation, and cloud security.
* Familiarity with React or Next.js.
* Experience with enterprise security, data privacy, risk management, and architecture governance.
* Experience establishing reusable engineering practices and mentoring technical teams.

Work Details

* **Employment Type:** Full-Time
* **Work Location:** Gurgaon, Haryana
* **Work Arrangement:** Hybrid
* **Experience Required:** 10+ Years
* **Compensation:** Up to ₹35,00,000 per annum, depending on relevant experience and suitability.

Candidates who can join immediately or are currently serving their notice period are welcome to apply. Previous experience working with multinational organizations is preferred.

Pay: Up to ₹3,500,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

c577b1ae.title: Solution Architect – Data & AI Solutions
c577b1ae.description:
**Key Responsibilities**
Presales & Client Engagement
  
  

* Partner with sales and industry teams to design client-ready demos, proof-of-concepts, and technical solution blueprints.
* Present complex architectures in a clear, business-outcome-driven manner to both executive and technical stakeholders.
* Contribute to RFP/RFI responses, solution proposals, and deal shaping.
* Act as a trusted advisor in client conversations, highlighting differentiators of Data & AI Solutions.

Solution Architecture & Demo Environments
  
  

* Architect distributed, scalable, and resilient data and AI platforms for presales demonstrations.
* Design abstraction layers for multi-model AI orchestration, including fallback logic, dynamic model switching, and cost control.
* Lead implementation of event-driven architectures using messaging frameworks (Kafka, Pulsar, SQS, etc.) and state machines.
* Build reusable, industry-specific demo environments leveraging hyperscaler services and data platforms.

Observability, Security & Compliance
  
  

* Define and enforce observability standards for demo and enterprise environments (logging, tracing, telemetry, real-time alerting).
* Implement zero-trust security models (RBAC/ABAC, IAM, OAuth2, encryption, API gateways).
* Ensure all demo and client environments meet compliance standards such as HIPAA, GDPR, SOC2.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Work with Product, Data Science, Engineering, and Governance teams to align demos with business/regulatory needs.
* Collaborate with IMUs (verticals) to build domain-specific demo templates (e.g., Insurance claims, Healthcare payment integrity, Banking KYC/fraud, Retail personalization).
* Provide hands-on support to engineering teams during delivery, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.

Innovation & Technical Leadership
  
  

* Stay ahead of hyperscaler advancements, AI/ML frameworks, and orchestration patterns.
* Drive technical due diligence, PoCs, and vendor/platform evaluations.
* Create technical artifacts (architecture diagrams, design patterns, runbooks).
* Mentor presales engineers and junior architects in solution design and client presentation skills.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Certifications preferred: - Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Kubernetes / CNCF ecosystem.
* Architecture frameworks (TOGAF, SAFe).

**Skills & Experience**
Must-Have Skills & Experience
  
  

* 15+ years in software architecture, presales engineering, or enterprise data/AI platform design.
* Hands-on expertise in at least two hyperscaler platforms: - Azure (Fabric, Synapse, Data Factory, Azure ML, Power BI).
* AWS (Redshift, Glue, S3, SageMaker, Lake Formation).
* GCP (BigQuery, Dataplex, Vertex AI, Pub/Sub).
* Proven experience architecting distributed systems, microservices, and scalable AI/ML platforms.
* Strong knowledge of Data Governance, Data Quality, Metadata, Lineage, and DataOps.
* Expertise in event-driven systems and asynchronous workflows.
* Hands-on with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK).
* Advanced programming with Python (async), TypeScript/JavaScript, or Go.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, service mesh (Istio), serverless design patterns.
* Experience with CI/CD automation, GitOps, Terraform, Helm.
* Strong presentation, storytelling, and client engagement skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with multi-tenant SaaS platforms and usage-based billing.
* Familiarity with data mesh, knowledge graphs, and semantic interoperability.
* Knowledge of frontend architecture patterns (micro-frontends, data visualizations).
* Experience building presales demo or sandbox environments.

Exposure to agentic AI concepts and LLM-based orchestration.

1aeda29c.description:
**We Breathe Life Into Data**
At Komodo Health, our mission is to reduce the global burden of disease. And we believe that smarter use of data is essential to this mission. That’s why we built the Healthcare Map — the industry’s largest, most complete, precise view of the U.S. healthcare system — by combining de-identified, real-world patient data with innovative algorithms and decades of clinical experience. The Healthcare Map serves as our foundation for a powerful suite of software applications, helping us answer healthcare’s most complex questions for our partners. Across the healthcare ecosystem, we’re helping our clients unlock critical insights to track detailed patient behaviors and treatment patterns, identify gaps in care, address unmet patient needs, and reduce the global burden of disease.
  
  
As we pursue these goals, it remains essential to us that we stay grounded in our values: be awesome, seek growth, deliver “wow,” and enjoy the ride. At Komodo, you will be joining a team of ambitious, supportive Dragons with diverse backgrounds but a shared passion to deliver on our mission to reduce the burden of disease — and enjoy the journey along the way.
  
  
**Leadership At Komodo Health**
Mavens is a Komodo Health company focused on delivering Salesforce-based solutions that drive workflow and digital engagement across the life sciences industry. The Mavens Managed Services team partners closely with our customers post initial implementation to support long term success with our solutions. Our managed services team serves as trusted advisors who understand both the evolving technology and the business challenges our customers face.
  
  
Managed Services Consultants are the primary long-term partners for our customers, acting as a fully integrated extension of the customer’s IT team. They balance day-to-day administrative support with complex release management, ensuring that applications are functioning properly to support business-critical processes. They play a strategic role in building and maintaining strong customer relationships and continuously seek opportunities to further assist customers with their evolving needs.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a goal-oriented and self-motivated individual who is comfortable working in fast-paced work environments. They demonstrate strong collaboration skills by working effectively across internal teams and with customers to drive shared outcomes. They hold themselves accountable to commitments and follow through with a high degree of ownership. They bring creativity and resourcefulness to problem-solving, finding practical solutions in ambiguous or complex situations. They approach interactions with empathy, fostering trust with both customers and colleagues.
  
  
**The Opportunity at Mavens**
**Communications & Project Management**

* Lead Stakeholder Engagement: Lead weekly status calls, third-party vendor alignments, and design reviews.
* Manage Project Documentation: Prepare status call content (dashboards, agendas) and manage the RAIL (Rolling Action Item Log) by creating and updating items in real-time.
* Release Planning: Create and maintain release timelines and support customers with release candidate prioritization.
* Governance & Business Planning: Provide technical recommendations and work in collaboration with customers to define a clear roadmap.
* Internal Collaboration: Maintain clear and proactive communication with internal stakeholders - including practice leads, consultants, developers, architects, and QA - to share customer context, coordinate delivery activities, and surface risks or escalations through the appropriate channels.

**Requirements & Build**

* Analyze Business Needs: Prepare for and lead requirements gathering sessions.
* Technical Implementation: Assess Level of Effort (LOE) for functional items and complete or delegate build/configuration changes.
* DevOps & Deployment: Manage repositories and promote completed build to higher environments.
* Maintain Documentation: Manage requirements, test cases, functional and technical guides, integration specifications, and other application documentation.

**Testing & Quality Assurance**

* Validation: Perform System Integration Testing (SIT) and provide guidance/support for User Acceptance Testing (UAT).
* Spot Checks: Validate deployments by checking changes in higher environments.

**Ongoing Support & Maintenance**

* User & Data Management: Handle user lifecycle (creation, deactivation, permissions) and maintain data integrity (duplicate management, record updates).
* Issue Management: Investigate reported issues, monitor error reports, and triage/escalate problems as needed to ensure resolution.
* Reporting: Create and update reports and perform data extractions/exports for the customer.

**Competencies**

* Platform Expertise: Strong knack for understanding how applications work and envisioning solutions on the Force.com platform.
* Functional Advisory: Ability to provide "how-to" technical assistance and advise customers on product features and enhancements.
* Communication Skills: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to seamlessly connect and translate between technical and non-technical audiences.
* Documentation Mastery: Experience authoring requirements, system specifications, and application guides.
* Project Management: Understanding of core project management concepts, including timeline management and LOE assessment.
* Industry Knowledge: Life Sciences or Pharmaceutical experience is a significant plus.
* Education & Certification: Bachelor’s degree preferred; Salesforce Certification is required.

**Values**
If you are wondering if this is the right role for you, ask yourself if you are already a Maven:
  
  

* A Maven is open to saying yes and shows good judgment in ambiguity
* A Maven takes accountability and is constantly learning
* A Maven is fearless, resourceful, and scrappy
* A Maven communicates with integrity, empathy, and humility
* A Maven brings energy into the room and gives more than they take
* A Maven in an entrepreneur who creates opportunity and momentum
* A Maven is a craftsman who uses technology to solve business problems
* A Maven makes our customer the hero

**Additional skills and experience we’d prioritize (nice to have)…**

* Salesforce Certification and consulting experience a plus
* Life Sciences experience, particularly Pharmaceutical is a plus
* Experience interacting with, managing, or building with AI agentic workflows

* This position involves rotational shifts.

**Komodo's AI Standard**
At Komodo, we're not just witnessing the AI revolution – we're leading it. This is a pivotal moment in time, where being first to market with AI transforms industries and sets the bar. We've already established industry leadership in leveraging AI to revolutionize healthcare, and we expect every team member to contribute. AI here isn't optional; it's foundational. We expect you to integrate AI into your daily work – from summarizing documents to automating workflows and uncovering insights. This isn't just about efficiency; it's about making every moment more meaningful, building on trust in AI, and driving our collective success.
  
  
***Join us in shaping the future of healthcare intelligence.*
Where You’ll Work**
Komodo Health has a hybrid work model with hubs in San Francisco, New York City, and Chicago. Roles vary — some can be performed from anywhere in the country, others are scoped to a specific region, and some are based near one of our hubs. For hub-based Dragons, we're building intentional in-office rhythms alongside the flexibility that's core to how we work. Whatever your setup, expectations will always be clear before you join.

d45061a7.title: Customer Engagement Manager
d45061a7.description:
**About Ema**
Ema builds AI Employees for HR, IT and Finance. Our AI Employees take on the busy work across the employee experience, from recruiting, onboarding and benefits to IT support, invoice processing and payroll, so people can spend their time on work that needs them. Founded by former executives from Google, Coinbase, Flipkart, and Okta, our team includes engineers from premier tech companies and graduates of Stanford, MIT, UC Berkeley, CMU, and IITs.
  
  
We are backed by industry leading investors including Accel, Naspers/Prosus, Creaegis, Section32, and angels like Sheryl Sandberg and Dustin Moskovitz. Headquartered in Silicon Valley and with offices in London, Bangalore and Vancouver, Ema is at the frontier of what Agentic AI can do in production. We ship real systems that run real business processes at scale.
  
  
**The Role**
The Customer Engagement Manager owns a portfolio of strategic enterprise accounts end-to-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship, every expansion opportunity. Think of this as the McKinsey Associate Partner model applied to enterprise AI delivery.
  
  
You are the single point of accountability for your accounts. The customer calls you — not your manager — when they have a problem. You staff delivery teams, oversee solution quality, run executive readouts, measure ROI, drive adoption, rebuild trust when things break, and grow the book through proven production value.
  
  
**This is not a project management role.**
This is an account ownership role that combines delivery orchestration, outcome ownership, customer leadership, and commercial growth.
  
  
**What You’ll Own**

* Account Ownership
* Own your accounts end-to-end: every engagement, every outcome, every relationship. Everything good or bad stops with you.
* Be the single point of contact the customer calls for any problem — delivery, quality, adoption, escalation, or expansion.
* Maintain a holistic view of each account: engagement status, risk exposure, opportunity pipeline, and the customer’s strategic priorities for the quarter.
* Run account planning: engagement roadmaps, resource forecasting, risk assessment, and growth strategy.
* Delivery Orchestration
* Staff and direct delivery teams (Engineering Leads, Product Managers) across your accounts.
* Oversee delivery quality across all engagements: review solution architectures, attend go-live rehearsals, ensure evaluation rigor.
* Manage cross-engagement dependencies within an account (e.g., shared integration infrastructure between parallel deployments).
* Serve as the delivery escalation point: join war rooms, coordinate fixes across Engineering and Product, and communicate resolution to the customer.
* You don’t write code — but you review architectures, challenge unrealistic scope, and ensure go-live readiness. Your leverage is orchestration and judgment.
* Outcome Ownership & Continuous Improvement
* Own post-go-live outcomes: adoption, ROI, accuracy, and user trust. This role absorbs the Outcomes Manager function for your accounts.
* Run regular usage readouts: AI deflection rates, false positive/negative trends, HITL escalation patterns, user bypass rates, and trust signals.
* Separate product gaps from process, training, or expectation gaps. Not everything that looks broken is an engineering problem.
* Drive continuous improvement cycles: readout → diagnose → prioritize → fix → re-measure.
* Communicate outcomes in business language: efficiency gains, cost savings, error reduction — not just dashboards, but diagnosis and action plans.
* Executive Stakeholder Leadership
* Run QBRs with VP/C-level stakeholders: present outcomes, risks, improvement plans, and the strategic roadmap.
* Navigate internal customer politics: when the VP of IT and VP of Business disagree on priorities, facilitate alignment around shared success metrics.
* Communicate bad news credibly: present the data, the diagnosis, and the recovery plan — without losing trust.
* Handle C-level escalations. When the CTO threatens to terminate or the CFO questions ROI, you are the person in the room.
* Commercial Growth
* Grow your book through outcome-driven expansion: deliver the first SOW excellently, measure ROI rigorously, present evidence to the C-suite, then propose the next SOW grounded in proven value.
* Identify new use cases by deeply understanding customer business processes and pain points — not by pushing a product catalog.
* Know when to push for expansion vs. when to stabilize. Premature expansion erodes trust. You earn the right to grow by delivering first.
* Co-sell with Sales: provide the delivery credibility and outcome evidence that makes expansion proposals close.
* Product & Platform Partnership
* Act as the voice of your customers to Product and Core Engineering. Translate field patterns into structured, actionable feedback — not one-off requests.
* Identify cross-customer patterns that signal platform gaps or opportunities.
* Partner with Product on customer-facing roadmap discussions: what’s coming, what’s not, and how to manage expectations.
* Team Development
* Coach Engineering Leads and Implementation Managers on architecture quality, customer communication, delivery discipline, and outcome thinking.
* Promote shared standards and best practices across engagements.
* Build reusable account-level assets: engagement playbooks, QBR templates, outcome tracking frameworks, and expansion qualification criteria.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 15+ years in enterprise technology delivery, consulting, account management, or customer leadership.
* 5+ years owning enterprise accounts end-to-end: delivery, outcomes, relationship, and growth — not individual projects within someone else’s account.
* Track record managing or directing delivery teams (Engineering Leads, TPMs, consultants) assigned to their accounts.
* Post-go-live outcome ownership: measured ROI, tracked adoption, driven continuous improvement, and rebuilt trust after production issues.
* Commercial accountability: grown account revenue through outcome-driven expansion, not just retention.
* Enterprise stakeholder management at VP/C-level across multiple concurrent accounts.
* Production track record — beyond POCs. Scale and accountability required.

**Preferred**

* Experience with AI, automation, or agentic workflow platforms in production.
* Background at a consulting firm (McKinsey, BCG, Deloitte) or enterprise SaaS PS org (ServiceNow, Salesforce, UiPath) in a delivery-heavy account leadership role.
* Experience with partner-mediated delivery (delivering through consulting partners to end clients).
* Familiarity with enterprise integrations (APIs, auth, CRM/HRIS/ITSM platforms) at a judgment level, not implementation level.
* Experience in a scaling startup ($5M–$50M ARR) where account management practices were being built, not inherited.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for variable compensation, equity, and benefits.
  
  
Ema Unlimited is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, or genetics.

**The role sits between sales and engineering, and is accountable to both**

  

A high-growth, VC-backed SaaS company is hiring its founding India team through Flexiple. Telling a sales lead the deal will not work as scoped. That happens, and the people who last in this role are the ones who do it early rather than letting a proof of concept quietly fail three weeks later.

* Composure in front of a sceptical technical audience

  

Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Delhi NCR, Mumbai or Chennai, or remote within India, with some travel to customer sites. A screening call, a technical conversation, a live scenario, then time with the founding team.

207e7389.description:
**Description**
Are you passionate about using technology, automation, and data to solve complex business problems at scale? The Books Risk Management (BRM) Automation team is seeking a Program Manager II to drive automation programs that improve operational efficiency, strengthen risk controls, and enhance the customer experience across Amazon's Books business.
  
  
In this role, you will partner with Product, Engineering, Risk, and Operations teams to identify opportunities, build scalable solutions, drive automation adoption, and deliver measurable business impact. You will lead high-visibility initiatives, investigate complex operational challenges, influence technical roadmaps, and ensure automation systems continue to operate effectively as the business scales. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, technical aptitude, ownership, and the ability to deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Partner with Product Managers, Software Engineers, Application Engineers, and Risk teams to define requirements and deliver scalable solutions.
* Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, quality, and operational scalability through automation and AI-enabled solutions.
* Use data and metrics to identify trends, evaluate business performance, and prioritize investments.
* Lead deep dives into operational issues, quality defects, and high-severity escalations, driving root cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Monitor automation performance, adoption, accuracy, and business impact through scalable reporting mechanisms.
* Build business cases, define success metrics, and measure realized benefits including productivity gains, quality improvements, and operational leverage.
* Translate business requirements into actionable technical requirements and work closely with engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle.
* Drive end-to-end execution of automation and process improvement programs supporting Books Risk Management workflows.
* Communicate program updates, risks, and recommendations to senior leaders and stakeholders across multiple organizations.
* Continuously evaluate emerging technologies and automation opportunities to improve risk detection, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.

A day in the life
  
  
You may start your day reviewing operational metrics and automation performance, investigating a production issue impacting a critical workflow, partnering with engineers on a new automation launch, conducting a deep dive into quality trends, or presenting program updates to senior leaders. You will regularly work across business, product, and technical teams to solve complex problems, prioritize opportunities, and deliver scalable solutions that create measurable business impact.
  
  
**About The Team**
The BRM Automation team is responsible for driving automation, AI adoption, and process transformation across Books Risk Management. Our mission is to improve operational efficiency, strengthen risk controls, and protect customer trust by building scalable solutions that reduce manual effort, improve decision quality, and enable the organization to scale effectively. We operate at the intersection of business, risk, and technology, partnering closely with engineering and product teams to solve some of the most complex challenges in the Books ecosystem.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- ADCI MAA 15 SEZ

940b8fc2.title: Consultant - CMC Program Manager
940b8fc2.description:
**At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!**
**As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets.**
**At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.**
**At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.**
**Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!**
CMC Program Manager, Technical Development
  
  
Role Description
  
  
The CMC Program Manager will oversee CMC (Chemistry, Manufacturing, and Controls) timelines and workstreams across projects within the Technical Development (TD) Functional Excellence framework. This role is pivotal for extracting information critical for resourcing, strategic decisions, and the annual Business Plan. The incumbent ensures that CMC timelines are consistent and integrated, and that resource/vendor allocation is clearly understood to meet budgetary targets.
  
  
Acting as the operational data "engine" that informs broader TD Functional Excellence scorecards and platforms, this role interfaces between TPLs, the Project Management (PM) group, and TD Functional Leaders. The incumbent leverages project management expertise and TD knowledge to drive accountability, increase transparency, and improve spending accuracy across the portfolio.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
CMC Timeline & Milestone Integrity
  
  

* Integrated Timeline Management: Harmonize comprehensive CMC project timelines to extract critical data on siting, resource requirements, and potential constraints, enabling data-driven strategic decisions.
* Critical Path & Clash Analysis: Identify dependencies and resourcing "clashes" in CMC development paths to facilitate proactive risk mitigation and siting prioritization.
* TD Functional Excellence Support: Collaborate across the TD Leadership (TPLs, Functional Leaders) to integrate CMC operational frameworks (e.g., milestone definitions, suitable KPIs, leading/lagging indicators) into broader TD standards and support initiatives as needed.

Resource Tracking
  
  

* Specific Resource Tracking: Define robust mechanisms to track resource utilization (FTEs/Capacity) at the project and functional levels to flag constraints or availability.
* Business Plan Support: Directly support the yearly Business Plan process by providing accurate resource forecasts and conducting "what-if" scenario modeling based on portfolio priorities or potential project accelerations.

Financial Stewardship & Budgetary Oversight
  
  

* Budget Alignment & Forecasting: Partner closely with TPLs and the PM group to improve the management of project-specific CMC budgets, ensuring accuracy in forecasting and strict adherence to financial targets.
* Audit & Variance Management: Proactively audit project-specific CMC spending against the Business Plan to flag variances, and improve future forecasting accuracy.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor or Master level degree in a scientific field (Chemistry, Biology, Pharmacy, or similar).
* Several years of Project Management experience specifically within an R&D environment, with a strong focus on CMC workstreams.
* Demonstrated understanding of the Technical Development (TD) space, including regulatory requirements and manufacturing interfaces.
* Proven exposure to resource planning and budget management for complex programs.
* Ability to work effectively and influence global, cross-functional teams with or without direct authority.

**Additional Skills / Preferences**

* Strong experience with portfolio-level metadata and resource tracking tools.
* Deep understanding of the Innovation Cycle, MR process, and Business Plan process.
* Lean/6sigma experience and a mindset for process optimization.
* Knowledge of R&D IT tools and an agile learner of new systems for data visualization.

Elanco is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status

d31319b1.title: Lead Infrastructure Architect (Network Design, LAN/WAN, RFP )
d31319b1.description:
**Overview**
***WELCOME TO SITA***
SITA is the leading specialist in air transport communications and information technology. We don’t just connect the global aviation industry, we apply decades of experience and expertise to address almost every core business, operational, baggage, and passenger process in air transport. As an organization, we cover 95% of all international air travel destinations and work with over 2,800 air transport and government customers in every corner of the globe. Immerse yourself in the dynamic world of technology while embracing our collaborative, and inclusive culture.
  
  
**Ready to redefine air travel? The journey starts here, with you at SITA.**
**About The Role & Team**
Architect and design the solution to meet the business requirements of SITA customers predominantly in the pre-sales phase (RFPs or unsolicited opportunities) with focus on deployment, infrastructure, network architecture, and cloud architecture.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Manage technical solution in response to an RFP or unsolicited case that can consist of multiple SITA products (and portfolios), which includes new or evolving technologies and SITA solution portfolios.
* Design the deployment architecture and infrastructure specifications- servers and networking(LAN and WAN) for a solution to the customer’s requirements.
* Design deployment architecture for SITA products, including runtime environment in various flavours – on premise servers, virtualized server environment, containerized application environment through Kubernetes, public cloud, etc., to meet functional and non-functional system requirements.
* Design the network solution – both LAN/WLAN (in the airport) and WAN.
* Develop the conceptual design, and high-level design, and provide suitable inputs for the low-level design.
* Develop Bill of Materials:
* Compute & Storage and Networking.
* Specifications for - Servers, Virtual Machines, Containers (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes), etc. based on guidance from SITA's product toolkits.
* Storage - including backup solution
* Networking – LAN/WLAN components including switches, firewalls, etc. and WAN components including telco circuits, and also SD-WAN.
* Software Licensing requirements – Operating System, Database, Virtualization, etc.
* Other Infrastructure – Power (UPS), Racks, Cabling, etc.
* Guides and contributes to the design coordination and development solutions working with multiple parties both internally and externally.
* Contributes to the transfer of projects for implementation.
* Interact with colleagues to gain knowledge and to share ideas.

**Qualifications**
***EXPERIENCE***

* Degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Information Technology and/or Engineering.
* 7- 10 years of experience in Information Technology, Air Transport, Telecom, or any other relevant industry in a technical Pre-Sales role
* Proven track record in producing communicating and documenting successful technical customer solutions
* Proven track record in managing solution proposals, costing, and customer presentation with great level of details.
* Expert in Network design WAN/Campus LAN, Cisco SDA, WLC, ISE, ACI, Nexus or similar technologies
* Solid experience in designing compute, storage, and networking solutions in all possible deployment scenarios – on premise, virtualized environment, private cloud, public cloud, or a mix.
* Solid experience in Security: IPSEC, Access-lists, NAT, understanding of Firewall functions
* Understanding of Cloud Connectivity such as Azure Express Route, AWS Direct Connect, is a great plus
* Understanding of Cloud Security such as Zscaler, Cisco umbrella is a great plus
* Understanding of Systems Monitoring – Network Monitoring, Security Monitoring (SIEM), etc.
* Understanding of Versa (or Cisco) SDWAN architecture, Salesforce and Service Now is a great plus
* Adept at drawing technical diagrams - good knowledge of Visio, competence in Excel and PowerPoint.
* Network design and standard vendor products
* Server sizing (virtualized environment and cloud) and software licensing
* Commercial Acumen

**What We Offer**
SITA’s workplace is all about diversity, many different countries and cultures are represented in our workforce. We collaborate in our impressive offices, embracing a hybrid work format. As part of our global benefits, we offer:
  
  
🏡
**Flex-week:**
Work from home up to 2 days/week (depending on your Team's needs).
  
  
⌚
**Flex-day:**
You may wish to flex your arrival time at the office, to beat the rush hours or you may want to leave the office earlier to pick up your kids from school or to go to your favorite game: We support you in being open about your needs and routine with you manager.
  
  
🌎
**Flex-location:**
Benefit for 30 working days from anywhere around the world each year!
  
  
🙌🏽
**Competitive benefits**
according to the local market
  
  
*SITA is an Equal Opportunity Employer and values a diverse workforce. In support of our Employment Equity Program, women, aboriginal people, members of visible minorities, and/or persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply and self-identify in the application process*

3b7b45ea.description:
The Commercial Architect plays a critical role in shaping Convatec’s global commercial technology ecosystem across DXP platforms, CMS, enterprise eCommerce, D365 CRM, ServiceNow and related commercial applications. The role is responsible for designing scalable, secure, and future-ready architectures that enable personalised digital experiences, global product catalogues, marketing activation, sales excellence, and customer support operations.
  
  
The Commercial Architect operates as a senior solution architect, partnering closely with business stakeholders across Marketing, Digital, eCommerce, Sales, IT and external technology partners.
  
  
**Key Duties & Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end solution architecture for DXP, CMS, eCommerce, CRM, PIM, DAM and customer support platforms, ensuring coherent integration across Convatec’s commercial ecosystem.
* Design scalable, API-led architectures using REST, GraphQL, middleware, microservices and event-driven patterns.
* Produce high-quality HLA and HLD documentation and oversee adherence throughout project delivery.
* Work closely with product owners, engineering leads and vendors to define architectural runway for digital and commercial products.
* Evaluate existing solutions and identify gaps related to scalability, security, performance or alignment with business strategy.
* Lead architectural governance for commercial platforms including Optimizely, Sitecore, Acquia, CommerceTools, Optimizely Commerce, D365 CRM, ServiceNow and associated MarTech systems.
* Facilitate vendor selection, RFP responses, and total cost of ownership (TCO) analysis for new digital and commercial technologies.
* Ensure robust integration patterns across enterprise systems including PIM, DAM, SAP, Hyperion, D365, ODP, CDP, analytics platforms and third-party integrations.
* Advocate and embed privacy-by-design, security-by-design and AI-by-design principles.
* Support global digital experience and eCommerce transformation initiatives by ensuring architecture alignment and best practices.
* Provide architectural guidance to delivery teams and act as Technical Design Authority (TDA) for commercial solutions.
* Contribute to maturity assessments and future-state models for Convatec’s digital and commercial technology landscape.

**About You**
**Essential experience**

* Proven experience in solution architecture across enterprise Commercial, Digital Experience, CRM, and eCommerce technologies.
* Expertise with DXP and CMS platforms such as Optimizely, Sitecore, Acquia, Adobe Experience Manager.
* Good understanding of enterprise eCommerce platforms including CommerceTools, Optimizely Commerce, BigCommerce Enterprise or similar.
* Hands-on experience architecting and integrating D365 Sales/CRM, Customer Service, CDPs and marketing automation systems.
* Knowledge of ServiceNow for customer service, case management and workflow automation.
* Strong understanding of commercial data flows including PIM, DAM, pricing, product catalogues, SPQ (Sales Pricing & Quoting).
* Deep understanding of APIs, GraphQL, microservices, middleware, ESB patterns (Azure Integration Services preferred).
* Experienced in creating HLAs and HLDs to a very high standard, operating independently and proactively.
* Strong communication skills working with PMs, BAs, engineering teams, C-suite, and business leaders globally.
* Experience with enterprise cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or GCP.

**Technical competencies**

* Architecture modelling (C4, ArchiMate or equivalent).
* Understanding of DevOps practices, CI/CD, cloud hosting models and containerization
* Good understanding of web technologies, headless architecture, Jamstack, React, Next.js, or similar.
* Familiarity with enterprise data governance, privacy, security controls and compliance frameworks.
* Knowledge of databases including SQL and NoSQL.
* Understanding of SDLC methodologies: agile, SAFe, waterfall, DevOps.

At Convatec, we’re pioneering trusted medical solutions to improve the lives we touch. If you’re ready to make a real impact, apply today and help us bring our Forever Caring promise to life.

**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics – Senior Manager - Databricks Architect**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. **The opportunity**
Senior Data & AI Architect with 13+ years of experience in data engineering and data architecture, strong hands-on expertise in Databricks, Hadoop, Spark/PySpark, and cloud data platforms.
  
  
This role combines deep technical ownership of enterprise Lakehouse and data platform architecture with hands-on experience building Agentic AI and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions on Databricks. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable designing large-scale, production-grade data pipelines, architecting modern AI-driven solutions, and engaging directly with clients on strategic proposals and solution design.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Architect, design, and deliver scalable Data & AI solutions on the Databricks Lakehouse platform, covering ingestion, transformation, storage, governance, and consumption layers.
* Design and optimize large-scale distributed data processing pipelines using Hadoop, Apache Spark, and PySpark.
* Build reusable, production-grade Python frameworks and pipelines for batch and streaming data engineering workloads.
* Define and implement cloud data architecture on AWS and/or Azure, covering storage, IAM, networking, security, and monitoring, with native Databricks integration.
* Own end-to-end ETL/ELT design, data ingestion, transformation, orchestration, and data quality frameworks across the platform.
* Design dimensional data models (star/snowflake schemas, fact/dimension tables, SCD) to support analytical and reporting use cases.
* Design and build Agentic AI solutions on Databricks, including LLM integration, tool/function calling, agent workflows, guardrails, and enterprise data integration.
* Architect and implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) solutions using Databricks — document ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector search, retrieval, grounding, and evaluation.
* Establish and enforce engineering best practices for Git-based version control, code reviews, and CI/CD across development, test, and production environments.
* Lead performance optimization and production deployment of Databricks jobs, workflows, and pipelines at scale.
* Participate in strategic RFP/RFI responses, technical proposals, solution shaping, effort estimation, and architecture presentations.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor in customer workshops, translating business requirements into robust technical architectures.
* Mentor engineering teams on Databricks, Spark, cloud architecture, and modern AI/RAG engineering practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

c9e126bb.title: S4 BTP Consultant (SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud)
c9e126bb.description:
Role Overview:

We are looking for an experienced SAP BTP Technical/Functional Consultant to drive cloud extension, integration, and automation initiatives for our SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud landscape. You will help maintain a "Clean Core" strategy by decoupling custom logic from the standard Public Cloud core through SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).

Key Responsibilities

\* Side-by-Side Extensibility: Design and build cloud extensions using the SAP Cloud Application Programming Model (CAPM), RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP), or SAP Build low-code/no-code tools.

\* Public Cloud Integration: Configure and manage integrations between SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud and third-party or on-premise systems using SAP Integration Suite / Cloud Platform Integration (CPI).

\* Clean Core Governance: Follow SAP Activate methodology and Fit-to-Standard principles to ensure custom code stays off the Public Cloud core.

\* Fiori & UI Development: Develop custom SAP Fiori (FreeStyle SAPUI5 / Fiori Elements) applications deployed via SAP Business Application Studio (BAS) and the HTML5 Repository.

\* Security & Connectivity: Configure BTP global accounts, subaccounts, SAP Cloud Connector, Identity Authentication Service (IAS), and OAuth 2.0 / JWT security protocols.

\* Testing & Deployment: Execute Unit Testing, SIT, UAT, performance testing, and manage Multi-Target Application (MTA) deployments across subaccounts.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Experience:
4 plus years experience.

\* Public Cloud Exposure: Practical implementation experience with SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, Central Business Configuration (CBC), and SSCUI/In-App vs. Side-by-Side extensibility boundaries.

\*S4 EWM enhancements on public cloud

\*Experience with Personas and SAP GUI and HTML

e4f1a01c.title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Moveworks
e4f1a01c.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Moveworks)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Strong understanding of the Move works platform, including enterprise search, conversational AI, natural language understanding (NLU), employee support automation, and AI-driven workflow orchestration.
* Knowledge of Move works integration capabilities with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Slack, HR systems, identity platforms, and enterprise applications
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of ServiceNow applications (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD).

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.
