064a40cb.title: Senior Product Manager - Cloudera Manager
064a40cb.description:
**Business Area:**

Product Mgmt.

**Seniority Level:**

Mid-Senior level

**Job Description:**

At Cloudera, we empower people to transform complex data into clear and actionable insights. With as much data under management as the hyperscalers, we're the preferred data partner for the top companies in almost every industry. Powered by the relentless innovation of the open source community, Cloudera advances digital transformation for the world’s largest enterprises.

Cloudera is seeking a Senior Product Manager for the Cloudera Manager product. This role owns the product strategy and roadmap for one of the key lifecycle management tools serving the largest global enterprises across all industries including finance, manufacturing, tech and federal. Cloudera Manager is responsible for the lifecycle of mission critical clusters with thousands of nodes and petabytes of data.

In this role, you will lead and execute on a strategy to ensure Cloudera Manager provides enterprise capabilities with the ease of data SaaS products from on-premises to cloud. You will grow Cloudera Manager to be a tool once used by engineers to an experience that is straight forward for any data platform manager. You will partner closely with Engineering, PMO, Product Marketing, and Field organizations to deliver a market-leading experience in hybrid cloud.

**As a Senior Product Manager you will:**

* **Drive Intelligent Product Experiences:** Shift the product strategy from infinite customization to a simplified user experience that provides optimal settings no matter the cluster configuration and active guardrails to eliminate operational fragility to prevent self-inflicted outages. Incorporate configuration recommendations, actionable health alerts, and actionable bad-configuration warnings directly into the product using AI trained on Cloudera’s knowledge base and real-time observability telemetry.
* **Simplify Accessibility for IT Generalists:** Design intuitive workflows and self-guided administrative tools tailored for IT generalists with minimal big data expertise, making documentation a secondary resource and lowering the barrier to platform management.
* **Embed Intelligence:** **Execute Hybrid Architecture Modernization:** Lead the long-term evolution of Cloudera Manager into an orchestrator of clusters across multiple clouds allowing customers to deploy use cases in a hybrid cloud topology.
* **Achieve Uninterrupted Core Operations at Scale:** Optimize fundamental cluster lifecycle operations to manage environments up to 10,000 nodes, ensuring refresh and maintenance operations on 1,000+ node clusters execute within customer approved SLAs.
* **Define Predictable Lifecycle & API Guarantees:** Establish and enforce structured release lifecycle policies that guarantee public API stability and backward compatibility to remove upgrade friction for enterprise customers.
* **Track Operational Success Metrics:** Monitor and continuously improve key performance indicators, specifically focusing on increasing operational velocity, boosting prescriptive feature adoption rates, and reducing support escalation volumes.

**We are excited if you have:**

  

* Bsc/Msc in related field or equivalent experience
* **Enterprise Platform Experience:** 5+ years of experience in the enterprise software space with at least 2 years of Product Management experience. Strong foundational understanding of open datalakes, data movement, enterprise data governance, and big data architecture.
* **On-Premise Knowledge:** Basic technical understanding of virtualization, data center networking
* **Public Cloud Knowledge:** Basic technical understanding of VM-based public cloud deployments (IaaS/PaaS), object storage architectures (S3, ADLS, GCS), and network architectures for at least one major hyperscaler (AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform).
* **Simplification & UX Modernization:** Demonstrated success in transforming complex, developer-centric platforms into intuitive, "opinionated" products with active guardrails that eliminate manual operational friction.

**You might also have:**

* **CSP Partner Ecosystem Experience:** Direct experience working with or within major cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), including partner co-development, cloud marketplace programs, or cloud-native integrations.
* **Competitive Landscape Awareness:** Strong knowledge of modern cloud data platforms and competitive solutions, such as Databricks, Snowflake, Google BigQuery/Bigtable, Amazon EMR/Redshift, or Azure Synapse.
* **Modern Datalakehouse Formats:** Familiarity with open table formats (e.g., Apache Iceberg) and multi-cloud data architecture strategies.
* **Data Platform Administrative Experience:** Strong background with managing enterprise platforms or supporting customers running enterprise scale deployments with over 100 Terabytes of data.

**What you can expect from us:**

* Generous PTO Policy
* Support work life balance with Unplugged Days
* Flexible WFH Policy
* Mental & Physical Wellness programs
* Phone and Internet Reimbursement program
* Access to Continued Career Development
* Comprehensive Benefits and Competitive Packages
* Paid Volunteer Time
* Employee Resource Groups

57100c08.title: IBMi Strategic Solution Architect
57100c08.description:
Apply
  
  

* Role: IBMi Strategic Solution Architect
* Employment: Full Time
* Experience: 10 to 19 Years
* Salary: Not Disclosed
* Location: Jaipur

Programmers.IO is currently looking to hire
**IBMi Strategic Solution Architect**
on
**IBMi**
Technology. If you think you are a good fit and willing to work from
**Jaipur**
location.Please apply with you resume or share your resume at Nidhi.Joshi@programmers.ai
  
  
**Experience Required:**
10 to 19 Years
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are looking for a highly experienced
**IBM i Strategic Solutions Architect**
based in the United States who can serve as a senior technical advisor for some of our largest and most strategic IBM i clients.
  
  
This person will work closely with client technology and business teams, spend time onsite with strategic accounts, understand their IBM i landscape and future priorities, and identify opportunities where we can provide additional value.
  
  
The role will also work closely with our offshore IBM i teams, providing architectural guidance, technical direction, and ensuring that our delivery teams remain aligned with the client's technology strategy.
  
  
This is not just an architecture or delivery role. We are looking for someone who can build strong relationships with clients, understand their technology challenges, proactively recommend solutions, and help us
**grow strategic IBM i accounts**
.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategic Client Engagement
  
  

* Act as a senior IBM i technical advisor and trusted partner for selected strategic accounts.
* Develop strong working relationships with client architects, technology leaders, and key stakeholders.
* Visit strategic clients approximately once per quarter and work onsite for 3-4 days.
* Understand the client's IBM i environment, applications, architecture, technical challenges, roadmap, and business priorities.
* Participate in architecture discussions, technical discovery sessions, and modernization planning.
* Proactively bring ideas and recommendations to clients instead of waiting for requirements.

IBM i Architecture & Modernization
  
  

* Assess existing IBM i application architecture and recommend improvements.
* Provide architectural guidance around application modernization, integration, APIs, DevOps, databases, performance, security, and maintainability.
* Help clients evaluate modernization opportunities while protecting their existing investment in IBM i.
* Provide technical leadership for complex IBM i initiatives and architecture decisions.
* Guide teams on modernization of legacy RPG and COBOL applications where appropriate.

Offshore Team Leadership
  
  

* Work closely with offshore architects, technical leads, developers, and delivery teams.
* Translate client strategy and onsite discussions into clear technical direction for offshore teams.
* Conduct architecture and solution reviews with the offshore team.
* Mentor senior IBM i developers and technical leads.
* Help offshore teams better understand the client's business, architecture, and long-term technology direction.
* Act as a bridge between client stakeholders and offshore engineering teams.

Technical Background
  
  
The ideal candidate should have strong experience across the IBM i ecosystem, including:
  
  

* IBM i / AS400 architecture
* RPG, RPGLE, ILE RPG and Free-Format RPG
* DB2 for i / SQL
* CL / CLLE
* COBOL experience or good architectural understanding of COBOL applications
* IBM i application architecture and integration
* APIs, REST services and modern integration patterns
* IBM i modernization strategies
* DevOps and CI/CD concepts for IBM i
* Application analysis, impact analysis and dependency understanding
* Security, performance and system architecture concepts
* Integration of IBM i applications with distributed/cloud applications

Experience with modern UI, Java/.NET integration, cloud integration, AI-assisted modernization, or IBM i modernization products/tools would be an advantage.
  
  
What We Are Looking For
  
  
**Beyond Technical Expertise, The Individual Must Be**

* Strongly client-facing and comfortable interacting with senior client technology leaders.
* Able to communicate complex IBM i concepts in simple business language.
* Consultative rather than purely delivery-focused.
* Proactive in finding problems and opportunities.
* Comfortable conducting technical discovery sessions independently.
* Capable of challenging existing approaches constructively and recommending alternatives.
* Strong at working with distributed US and offshore teams.
* Comfortable mentoring architects, leads, and developers.
* Commercially aware and able to recognize account-growth opportunities without behaving like a salesperson.
* Willing and able to travel within the US regularly.

Ideal Profile
  
  
We are looking for someone who has spent significant time in the IBM i ecosystem but has also evolved beyond traditional RPG development.
  
  
The right person should be comfortable having conversations such as:
  
  

* Where is the client going with IBM i over the next 3–5 years?
* What applications should remain on IBM i?
* What should be modernized?
* Where can APIs replace tightly coupled integrations?

25273fbc.title: Global GTM & Sales Program Manager
25273fbc.description:
**About Payoneer**
Founded in 2005, Payoneer is the global financial platform that removes friction from doing business across borders, with a mission to connect the world’s underserved businesses to a rising global economy. We’re a community with over 2,500 colleagues all over the world, working to serve customers, and partners in over 190 countries and territories.
  
  
By taking the complexity out of the financial workflows–including everything from global payments and compliance to multi-currency and workforce management, to providing working capital and business intelligence–we give businesses the tools they need to work efficiently worldwide and grow with confidence.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This is a strategic programs role at the center of Global Sales HQ. You own the portfolio of sales-development programs and strategic sales initiatives that turn strategy into repeatable, measurable motions across regions — and you are the connective tissue between Sales and Product, between demand generation and closure, and between global standards and on-the-ground execution.
  
  
In a matrixed organization where regional heads own their reps and delivery, you own the standard, the operating rhythm, and the cross-functional programs that make the whole sales engine more effective. It is a builder-strategist role: you design the programs, orchestrate the launches, instrument them, and scale what works.
  
  
**What You'll Own**
**SALES DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS & STRATEGIC SALES INITIATIVES**

* Own the portfolio of sales-development programs and strategic initiatives that raise the productivity and consistency of the global sales organization, from skills and plays to new sales motions.
* Translate the annual sales strategy into a sequenced program roadmap with clear owners, milestones, and success metrics.
* Stand up initiatives as time-boxed programs with scale / iterate / kill decision gates, plus the governance rhythm — interlocks, exception desks, QBR cadences — that keeps regions on one standard.

**SALES – PRODUCT INTERLOCK**

* Own the operating interlock between Sales and Product: a structured, two-way loop that turns field signal into roadmap input and turns roadmap into sales readiness.
* Represent the voice of the field in prioritization, packaging, and pricing discussions, and carry product context back into the field.
* Ensure every material product change lands with the sales org through readiness, positioning, and enablement — nothing ships to market unsold internally.

**CAMPAIGNS — DEMAND & CLOSURE ALIGNMENT**

* Orchestrate integrated GTM campaigns that align top-of-funnel demand generation with the sales closure motion, so demand converts to pipeline and pipeline to revenue.
* Partner with Marketing and RevOps to define targeting, messaging, and the handoff and follow-up SLAs that connect demand to closure.
* Instrument campaigns end to end (demand → qualified pipeline → closed revenue) and drive continuous, data-led improvement.

**NEW PRODUCT INTRODUCTION (NPI) INTO MARKETS**

* Own the sales side of new-product introductions: the launch playbook, market-readiness criteria, and sequencing for introducing products into markets, countries, and corridors.
* Coordinate the cross-functional launch (Product, Marketing, Enablement, regional sales) so each introduction has clear ownership, ramp targets, and measurement.
* Define go / no-go gates and post-launch review so the organization scales winners and retires what doesn't land.

**COUNTRY & CORRIDOR SALES STRATEGY**

* Define where-to-play / how-to-win by country and corridor — grounded in market, revenue, and account data.
* Build and maintain the market and corridor tiering and prioritization that focuses sales investment on the highest-value opportunities.
* Partner with regional Sales heads to translate corridor strategy into coverage, targeting, and sequenced motions on the ground.

**What Success Looks Like — First 6–12 Months**

* A published, sequenced program roadmap tied to the sales strategy, with governance live and adopted across regions.
* A functioning Sales–Product interlock running on a regular cadence, with measurable roadmap and readiness outcomes.
* Integrated demand-to-closure campaigns live, with clean end-to-end metrics leadership uses to steer.
* A repeatable NPI launch model and an active country / corridor sales strategy directing prioritized investment.

**Required**
**What You Bring**

* 8+ years in GTM strategy, sales programs, sales enablement / excellence, or strategic sales initiatives, including running cross-functional programs at scale.
* Proven experience owning a Sales–Product interlock or equivalent alignment between the field and the product roadmap.
* A track record designing and launching go-to-market campaigns that connect demand generation to sales closure.
* Experience leading new-product introductions and / or market and corridor launch strategy.
* Strong analytical foundation — comfortable in the data, building market / corridor prioritization, and instrumenting funnels end to end.
* A record of operating in a matrixed, multi-region organization and driving alignment without direct authority; excellent executive communication.

**Preferred**

* Hands-on fluency with the modern sales stack — Salesforce, Gong, BI / SQL (BigQuery a plus), and campaign tooling.
* Familiarity with corridor-based, multi-currency GTM and with SMB / marketplace / platform segments.
* Experience standing up governance rhythms — interlocks, QBRs, and forecast operating models — across regions.

**Fintech / Payments Experience Strongly Preferred**

* Background in fintech, payments, or cross-border B2B financial services.
* Understanding of how compliance, trust, long sales cycles, and multi-stakeholder buying committees shape GTM in regulated financial services.
* Comfort translating product complexity (multi-currency, FX, working capital, stablecoin rails) into simple, sellable, market-ready motions.

**Who You'll Work With**
Product, Marketing, RevOps, regional sales heads (EMEA, APAC, LATAM), Sales Enablement & Excellence, Customer Retention & Expansion, and Strategic Accounts. You'll be a core member of the Global Sales HQ leadership team, reporting to the VP of Global Sales.
  
  
**Why Join**
You'll own the programs and cross-functional interlocks that a global sales organization runs on — the layer where strategy, product, demand, and execution meet. You'll build, not just maintain, in a company at the frontier of cross-border payments, with the data, tooling, and executive support to make GTM measurably better across three regions.
  
  
**The Payoneer Ways of Working**
**Act as our customer’s partner on the inside**
*Learning what they need and creating what will help them go further.*
**Do it. Own it.**
*Being fearlessly accountable in everything we do.*
**Continuously improve**
*Always striving for a higher standard than our last.*
**Build Each Other Up**
*Helping each other grow, as professionals and people.*
If this sounds like a business, a community, and a mission you want to be part of, apply today.
  
  
*We are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. Payoneer is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment no matter your race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any stage of the hiring process, please speak to the recruiter managing the role for any adjustments. Decisions about requests for reasonable accommodation are made on a case-by-case basis.*

* Strong hands-on Node.js and React; MERN experience preferred.
* Solid cloud architecture experience on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Background in healthcare, fintech, payments, insurance, or another security-critical domain.
* Deep understanding of distributed systems, API design, databases, and reliability engineering.
* The ability to explain and defend technical decisions clearly to engineers and stakeholders.

**Bonus Points**

* Hands-on HIPAA, PHI, or PCI-DSS compliance experience.
* Familiarity with Stripe, Braintree, or tokenization.
* Experience with high-availability, event-driven, or microservices systems.
* Exposure to SaaS, consulting, or venture-studio environments.

**Why You’ll Like It Here**

* Your architecture decisions go straight to production, with real impact.
* Define engineering standards for an 80+ person team.
* Work at a profitable, stable company with minimal bureaucracy.

**About Flam**

Flam builds AI models and products for interactive content, taking the internet beyond videos. We've raised a $40M Series B led by QED Investors, with Shah Rukh Khan among our backers.

**Our products (three AI-native interactive formats):**

**Flicks:**
one video that holds multiple variations. Viewers can swap the character, product or scene with under 10ms switching latency, and AI compression cuts asset size by about 60%.

**Airboards:**
high-fidelity 3D streamed like video through the camera interface. Viewers interact by touch, voice and haptics, with no app download and about 300ms to first buffer.

**Visual Agents:**
photoreal talking avatars created from a single image, conversing with natural expressions in 60+ languages at about 800ms latency.

**About the role**

You’ll turn client briefs into working solutions. Using Airboards, Flicks, and Visual Agents, you’ll design, prototype, and present proofs of concept that show clients what’s possible, quickly. You’ll sit between sales, product, design, and engineering.

A portfolio of shipped POCs or prototypes, not just polished mockups.

Strong written and verbal communication.

Strong visual design, UI/UX, and creative problem-solving skills.

* Lead the India Presales engine. Set the strategy, operating rhythm, standards, resource model, and talent agenda for a 10-15-member organization; build capability and future leaders.

* Turn the market into product insight. Bring customer and competitive intelligence into Product, influence roadmap discussions, and ensure market needs are represented in product decisions.

* Build AI-native presales. Use AI and modern tooling to improve research, discovery, solutioning, demos, POCs, and presales productivity—and help the organization operate differently as Darwinbox becomes AI-native.

* Raise the talent bar. Build a high-performing team through coaching, capability building, succession planning, and strong standards for enterprise solution consulting.

**Why this role is different**

Darwinbox

is Asia's fastest-growing HR technology platform, designing the future of work by building the world's best HR tech, driven by a fierce focus on employee experience and customer success, and continuous, iterative innovation. We are the preferred choice of 1400+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million+ employees across 130+ countries.

59956e38.title: Platform Solution Architect
59956e38.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they are doing!
  
  
*We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.*
**Job Description**
We are looking for a hands-on Solution Architect to own the end-to-end architecture of our platform and drive its evolution as we scale. You will design, build, and maintain a multi-service application spanning backend, frontend, AI/ML services, and cloud infrastructure, while ensuring the platform is secure, scalable, and maintainable. As we move deeper into client conversations, this role also requires you to represent engineering in client discussions and lead the design of integrations between our platform and external HRMS (Human Resource Management System) or ATS (Applicant Tracking System) products.
  
  
**Role Details**

* Own the technical architecture of the platform end-to-end, including backend services, frontend applications, data stores, and cloud infrastructure.
* Design and evolve a scalable, secure, and maintainable microservices architecture using Java and Spring Boot, deployed on AWS (with a growing footprint on GCP and Azure).
* Guide and review the development of Python FastAPI-based AI services, including integration with OpenAI and Vapi for conversational/voice AI use cases.
* Define data architecture and access patterns across MongoDB and Redis, ensuring performance, consistency, and cost efficiency at scale.
* Architect and oversee real-time communication features using WebSockets, and asynchronous messaging workflows via MSG91 (email/SMS) and WhatsApp.
* Set technical direction for the Angular, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS frontend, and the Electron-based desktop application, ensuring consistency, performance, and code quality.
* Establish and enforce standards for observability and monitoring using Grafana (backend/infra) and Sentry (frontend), including alerting and incident response practices.
* Own authentication and identity architecture across Microsoft SSO and related identity providers, ensuring secure access management for enterprise clients.
* Guide secure use of Microsoft Graph API for email-based workflows in staffing scenarios, and Judge0 for code-execution/assessment use cases.
* Drive build vs. buy and tooling decisions, manage technical debt, and maintain architecture documentation (system diagrams, ADRs, data flow diagrams).
* Set up and maintain CI/CD pipelines and build processes (Maven and related tooling) to support reliable, frequent releases.
* Participate in client discussions and solutioning calls, translating client requirements into technical designs and realistic delivery estimates.
* Lead the design and delivery of integrations between our platform and third-party HRMS/ATS systems (e.g., data sync, SSO, webhooks, candidate/employee data exchange, API-based or file-based integrations).
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for prospective and existing clients on integration feasibility, data security, and architecture questions during pre-sales and onboarding.
* Mentor engineers across backend, frontend, and AI teams, and conduct architecture/design reviews for major features.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**
**Backend & Cloud**

* Java and Spring Boot for building production-grade microservices
* AWS: strong hands-on experience across compute, storage, networking, and managed services; working knowledge of GCP and Azure is a plus (platform is moving toward a broader multi/all-AWS setup)
* MongoDB and Redis: schema/data modeling, indexing, caching strategies, and performance tuning
* Python and FastAPI for AI-service development
* WebSocket-based real-time systems
* Maven-based build and dependency management
* Grafana for metrics, dashboards, and alerting

**Frontend**

* Angular and TypeScript for enterprise web applications
* Tailwind CSS for scalable, consistent UI styling
* Electron for cross-platform desktop application development
* Sentry for frontend error monitoring and performance tracking

**Integrations, Messaging & AI**

* MSG91 (email and SMS) and WhatsApp Business API for transactional/notification workflows
* Vapi for voice bot/conversational AI integrations
* OpenAI APIs for AI-assisted product features
* Judge0 for code execution/assessment workflows
* Microsoft Graph API for email-specific staffing workflows
* Microsoft SSO and enterprise identity/authentication protocols (OAuth2, SAML, OIDC)
* Jupyter for prototyping and validating AI/data workflows

**Mandatory Non-Technical Skills**

* Experience with additional cloud platforms (GCP, Azure) beyond AWS.
* Familiarity with conversational AI/voice bot platforms and prompt engineering for LLM-based features.
* Exposure to DevOps practices: containerization, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD pipeline design.
* Relevant certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure/GCP equivalents) are a plus.

**Education Qualification and Certifications**
required, If any
  
  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field.
* 8-14 years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 3+ years designing and owning system architecture for production applications at scale.
* Demonstrated experience architecting systems that combine backend services, frontend applications, cloud infrastructure, and third-party integrations.
* Prior experience in HR-tech, staffing, recruitment, or workforce-management platforms is strongly preferred.
* Experience presenting technical solutions directly to clients or in pre-sales/solutioning contexts.

540fa329.title: Solution Architect - Senior
540fa329.description:
The Solution Architect – Senior is responsible for defining and developing solution architectures that align with enterprise architecture strategies, principles, policies, standards, and business requirements. This role evaluates and applies solution designs for specific systems in collaboration with project and product teams and ensures solutions meet business, technical, security, governance, compliance, scalability, and performance requirements. The role involves translating complex business and technical requirements into scalable solution designs, evaluating multiple architectural options, conducting cost-benefit analysis, and recommending optimized solutions. The Solution Architect – Senior also stays current with emerging technologies and supports pilots and proof-of-concept initiatives to validate new technology capabilities.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Define solution and system architectures in alignment with enterprise architecture strategies, standards, reference architectures, and technology principles.
* Decompose systems into components, perform functional allocation, and establish interfaces between systems and system components.
* Develop and evaluate multiple solution options, conduct cost-benefit analysis, and recommend optimized solutions based on business and technical requirements.
* Design scalable architecture solutions for cloud-based platforms, enterprise applications, data and analytics platforms, and integrated systems.
* Develop and maintain architecture deliverables, including conceptual and logical models, solution diagrams, architecture patterns, and technical documentation.
* Apply enterprise architecture standards, frameworks, technology stacks, architecture patterns, and reference models to solution designs.
* Architect and integrate enterprise applications, data platforms, APIs, and other technology systems to deliver end-to-end solutions.
* Translate complex business requirements, industry requirements, and governance considerations into practical and scalable technical solutions.
* Ensure solution designs address security, governance, compliance, performance, scalability, buildability, and operational requirements.
* Collaborate with project, product, engineering, data, security, and business teams to drive successful solution development and delivery.
* Provide technical leadership and influence architecture decisions across cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Facilitate and support pilots, proof-of-concept activities, and technology evaluations to validate emerging technologies and architectural approaches.
* Analyze infrastructure and technology capacity and provide recommendations to support current and future business needs.
* Maintain awareness of emerging technologies, software trends, tools, and industry practices and assess their applicability to business solutions.
* Support the adoption of Agile, DevSecOps, CI/CD, automation, and modern software delivery practices.
* Identify, assess, and manage technical risks and issues and drive appropriate mitigation actions.
* Build strong relationships with customers, business stakeholders, technology teams, and peers to promote effective solution development and delivery.
* Apply effective Business Relationship Management practices to ensure technology solutions deliver measurable business value.
* Drive changes in technical architecture and standards into solution designs when business or technology needs evolve.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Enterprise Architecture and Solution Design
* Cloud Architecture – AWS, Azure, or GCP
* Solution and System Architecture
* Strong proficiency in Python and SQL
* Data Architecture, Data Modeling, Data Warehousing, ETL, and Data Pipeline Design
* System Integration and API Architecture
* Enterprise Application Architecture
* Analytics and AI/ML Platform Architecture
* Machine Learning Lifecycle Management / MLOps
* CI/CD, Build Automation, and Version Control
* Security, Governance, and Compliance in Architecture Design
* Architecture Documentation, Design Patterns, and Reference Architectures
* Stakeholder Management and Technical Leadership
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and influencing skills

**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* Experience with IoT technologies and connected systems.
* Experience with Agile software development methodologies.
* Knowledge of DevSecOps practices and automation frameworks.
* Experience with cost optimization and performance engineering.
* Experience architecting and integrating complex enterprise systems and data platforms.
* Experience designing AI/ML-enabled solutions and modern analytics platforms.
* Experience with agentic lifecycle management / AIOps.
* Familiarity with architecture frameworks, enterprise technology reference models, and architecture governance.
* Experience working with cross-functional and geographically distributed teams.

**Nice to Have**

* Hands-on experience with Databricks, Snowflake, or Neo4j.
* Experience designing Azure-native solutions.
* Familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch.
* Knowledge of advanced analytics, predictive modeling, and AI-driven decision systems.
* Experience with IoT and connected product ecosystems.
* Experience with modern cloud-native application and data platform architectures.

**Experience**

* Intermediate to advanced experience in solution architecture, enterprise systems, cloud architecture, or a related technical discipline.
* Demonstrated experience designing architectures for cloud-based platforms and enterprise applications.
* Proven ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and sustainable technical solutions.
* Experience designing enterprise data, analytics, AI/ML, and integration solutions.
* Experience architecting integrations across enterprise applications, APIs, and data platforms.
* Experience developing solution designs, architecture models, technical documentation, and reference patterns.
* Experience evaluating technology options and recommending solutions based on technical feasibility, business value, cost, performance, and scalability.
* Experience leading or influencing cross-functional technical teams and architecture decisions.
* Experience managing technical risks, issues, dependencies, and architectural trade-offs.
* Experience working in Agile and/or DevSecOps environments is preferred.

**Key Competencies**

* Collaborates Effectively
* Communicates Effectively

* Persuades and Influences
* Strategic Mindset
* Change Management
* Values Differences
* Architecture System Design
* Solution Design

b1d59085.description:

Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
The Senior Technical Architect is responsible for successfully designing and managing the successful delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards while leading code reviews during projects to ensure quality, using tools like GitHub Copilot and AI coding assistants to enforce design patterns, optimize performance, and accelerate the delivery of custom code, integrations, and data migrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**You're Our Person If...**

* Degree or equivalent relevant experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core competencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 14+ years of overall experience with a minimum of 8 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Data Cloud, Industry Clouds, Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, and familiarity with Agentforce
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

**Preferred Certifications**

**Company Description**  
ETG Digital is a global technology partner that helps organizations unlock the full potential of their digital investments through tailored, results-focused solutions. By aligning technology with business objectives, ETG Digital streamlines operations, improves customer engagement, and drives revenue growth for clients across industries. ETG Digital focuses on simple, outcome-driven engagements that include ongoing optimization to ensure peak system performance.Key Responsibilities

* **Serve as the principal technical authority responsible for designing and overseeing end-to-end, enterprise-scale ServiceNow architectures tailored to global Telecommunications, Media, and Technology (TMT) clients.**
* Lead technical discovery, translate complex operational requirements into scalable architecture roadmaps, and configure core and industry-specific ServiceNow modulesincluding **Telecommunications Network Inventory (TNI)**, **Telecommunications Service Operations Management (TSOM)**, **Telecommunications Provider / Service Management (TPSM)**, **CSM**, **ITOM**, and **ITSM**.
* Architect physical, logical, and virtual network topologies (L1L3, equipment, cards, ports, optical paths, circuits, VRFs, and IP pools) within TNI, fully synchronizing them with the **Common Service Data Model (CSDM 4.0+)** to establish lineage from infrastructure elements up to customer-facing services and business applications.
* Design topology-based alert correlation, automated root-cause analysis (RCA), and proactive impact-assessment workflows within TSOM to drive automated event remediation and reduce MTTR across network and digital service operations.
* **Design, build, and review production-grade client-side and server-side platform logic utilizing ES6 JavaScript, Glide API, Script Includes, Business Rules, Flow Designer actions/subflows, and UI Builder components.**
* Architect and implement bidirectional REST/SOAP web services, webhooks, and Integration Hub spokes to federate data between ServiceNow, Network Management Systems (NMS/EMS), SDN controllers, and carrier eBonding gateways.
* Implement **TM Forum Open API standards** (e.g., TMF622 Product Ordering, TMF641 Service Ordering,TMF628 Performance Management, TMF642 Alarm Management, and TMF638 Service Inventory) to enable automated cross-platform interoperability.
* Formulate data staging, ingestion, and reconciliation architectures using the Robust Transform Engine (RTE) and Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE) to migrate legacy telecom data (e.g., Netcracker, Amdocs,Oracle MetaSolv, Granite) cleanly into the CMDB.
* **Enforce architectural governance, instance health best practices, and security/compliance standards (role-based access controls, Domain Separation, data encryption, and auditability).**
* Lead technical sprint ceremonies within Agile/Scrum delivery frameworks; conduct rigorous code reviews, establish technical Definitions of Ready (DoR) and Done (DoD), and mentor engineering teams on maintainable, low-technical-debt design.
* Partner with pre-sales and sales engineering teams to construct technical solution proposals, response narratives for RFIs/RFPs, high-level architecture blueprints, and Statements of Work (SOWs) for prospective TMT engagements.

  

**Qualifications**

* **10+ years** of hands-on software development and technical architecture experience within the ServiceNow ecosystem, with substantial delivery experience supporting Telecommunications, Media, or Technology (TMT) environments.
* Proven track record architecting complex multi-product implementations across **ITOM** (Event Management, Service Mapping, Discovery), **CSM**, and ServiceNow Telecommunications solutions (**TNI**, **TSOM**,**TPSM/TSM**).
* Deep functional and technical knowledge of **TM Forum Frameworx, SID data models, and Open APIs**, combined with an understanding of multi-layer network topologies (Optical/DWDM, IP/MPLS, 4G/5G,FTTx, SD-WAN).
* Strong consulting background in client-facing roles, with proven success leading architecture design works.

19d65226.description:

MTX Group Inc. (MTX) is currently hiring for the position of
**Senior Presales Consultant**
with strong multi-cloud expertise and hands-on Salesforce knowledge. The ideal candidate will design and propose scalable, secure, and cost-efficient technical solutions across diverse technology ecosystems—including Salesforce, AWS, Azure, and integration/middleware platforms—without vendor bias.
  
  
This role bridges sales, delivery, and engineering, bringing deep technical insight, excellent communication skills, and strong solution-design capabilities to the RFx process.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
The Senior Pre-Sales Consultant is expected to lead large-scale/complex project(s), executing the following responsibilities:
  
  
Client, Sales & RFx Engagement:
  
  

* Lead the analysis of RFI/RFP/Tender documents to understand customer pain points, objectives, technical landscape, and constraints.
* Summarize bid details: agency background, contract duration, contract value, scope of work, user journeys, and design-critical considerations.
* Participate in internal stakeholder/client meetings, discovery/business domain understanding workshops, requirement-gathering sessions and existing client portal research..
* Collaborate with internal sales (including Salesforce PSS) and delivery teams to align solution direction and ensure feasibility.
* Support creation of Functional & Technical Requirement Traceability Matrices.

Solution Design & Architecture (Platform-Agnostic):
  
  

* Architect multi-cloud, hybrid, and on-premise solutions that meet functional, technical, security, and compliance requirements.
* Recommend best-fit technology stacks—Salesforce or otherwise—based purely on customer needs and evaluation criteria.
* Create high-level and detailed technical architecture diagrams, data flow models, and integration patterns.
* Translate requirements into epics, modules, feature lists, and high-level solution blueprints.
* Apply modern architectural principles: microservices, API-led integration, event-driven frameworks, serverless, containerization, and cloud-native patterns.

Technical Expertise & Ecosystem Knowledge:
  
  
The ideal candidate brings broad technical versatility, including:
  
  
Salesforce Ecosystem:
  
  

* Core technologies: Apex, Visualforce, Lightning (Aura/LWC), SOQL/SOSL, Salesforce APIs.
* Clouds: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, CPQ, Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud, Einstein.
* Integration: MuleSoft (API-led connectivity), Dell Boomi, Informatica, Jitterbit, and other middleware platforms.
* DevOps & CI/CD: Copado, Gearset, Bitbucket/Jenkins/GitHub Actions.
* Security & governance: OAuth, SSO, profiles/permissions, event monitoring.
* Salesforce PSS engagement for deep technical validation & alignment with product roadmap.

Third Party Integrations:
  
  

* Document generation: Adobe DocGen, Conga, DocuSign Gen, Nintex.
* E-signature: DocuSign, Adobe Sign, Zoho Sign.
* Storage/Content: SharePoint, Google Drive, AWS S3, OneDrive, Box.
* SMS/Communication: AWS End User Messaging, Twilio, Whatsapp APIs, Netcore.
* Monitoring/Logging: Splunk, Datadog, ELK.
* Analytics/BI: Tableau, Power BI, CRM Analytics.

Cloud & Application Stack:
  
  

* AWS, Azure, GCP (optional) cloud services.
* Databases: SQL, NoSQL.
* Programming: Java, Python, Node.js (advantage).
* Containerization: Docker, Kubernetes.
* AI/ML model usage & LLM-based solutioning.

Estimation, Planning & Financial Modelling
  
  

* Prepare accurate estimates for functional work, integrations, data migration, and system complexity.
* Develop implementation timelines, resource/staffing plans, and project roadmaps.
* Create margin analysis, cost breakdowns, and pricing models.
* Collaborate with sales and delivery leadership for approvals and validation.

Technical Proposal & Documentation
  
  

* Draft and refine technical sections for RFIs, RFPs, proposals, and solution decks.
* Convert customer requirements into compelling technical narratives and business value propositions.
* Document design assumptions, architectural decisions, and solution trade-offs.
* Ensure solutions meet scalability, security, compliance, and performance standards.

**What you will bring:**

* 5–8 years of experience in Pre-Sales, Solution Design, or Architecture roles.
* Strong multi-cloud and Salesforce experience, including deep hands-on understanding of integrations and ecosystem tools.
* Ability to convert requirements into modular solution components and architectural blueprints.
* Excellent communication skills to simplify complex concepts for business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Experience with technical writing, prompt engineering, and AI-assisted solutioning.
* Proven experience participating in large-scale RFx processes and cross-functional collaboration.

**What we offer:**

* Group Medical Insurance (Family Floater Plan - Self + Spouse + 4 Dependent Children)

+ Sum Insured: INR 5,00,000/-
+ Maternity cover upto two children
+ Cashless & Reimbursement facility
+ Access to free online doctor consultation

* Personal Accident Policy (Disability Insurance) -

+ Sum Insured: INR. 25,00,000/- Per Employee
+ Accidental Death and Permanent Total Disability is covered up to 100% of Sum Insured
+ Permanent Partial Disability is covered as per the scale of benefits decided by the Insurer
+ Temporary Total Disability is covered

* Optional Food Wallet (up to Rs. 2500 per month)

+ Offered as a tax saver component
+ Part of the special allowance component in the CTC

* Monthly Internet Reimbursement of upto Rs. 1,000
* Professional Development opportunities through various MTX-sponsored certifications on multiple technology stacks, including Salesforce, Microsoft, Google Cloud, AWS & other

d655976d.title: Sap Presales Expert
d655976d.description:
**Company Description**
Promantu INC is a technology services company specializing in enterprise solutions and SAP implementations for clients across diverse industries. The organization focuses on delivering high-quality consulting, integration, and support services that help businesses optimize their processes and systems. Promantu INC encourages innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, providing team members with opportunities to work on complex, impactful projects. The company values integrity, customer success, and professional growth, creating an environment where individuals can develop their skills and advance their careers.
  
**Role Description**
The SAP Presales Expert role at Promantu INC is a full-time, hybrid position based in Chennai, with flexibility for partial work from home. In this role, the individual will collaborate with sales teams to understand client needs, design appropriate SAP solutions, and prepare compelling proposals and presentations. Day-to-day activities include analyzing business processes, demonstrating SAP capabilities, creating solution architectures, and supporting RFP and RFI responses. The SAP Presales Expert will engage with prospective clients, conduct product demos, address technical and functional queries, and coordinate with delivery teams to ensure solution feasibility and alignment. The role also involves staying current with SAP product updates, industry trends, and best practices to provide informed recommendations and drive successful presales engagements.
  
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
The SAP MDG Pre-Sales Consultant / Solution Architect acts as the bridge between prospective enterprise clients, the sales/account team, and delivery/technical delivery teams. They translate complex business data governance challenges into compelling SAP MDG and S/4HANA solutions.
  
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
• Opportunity Qualification & Discovery: Lead discovery sessions with client stakeholders (CIOs, Data Owners, Business Process Leads) to uncover pain points in master data quality, governance, and lifecycle management.
  
• Solution Architecture & Design: Formulate high-level SAP MDG target architectures (covering Central Governance, Consolidation, Mass Processing, and Data Quality Management for domains like Material, Customer, Supplier, and Finance).
  
• Demos & Proof of Concepts (PoCs): Plan, build, and deliver tailored software demonstrations, scoping workshops, and PoCs to showcase SAP MDG capabilities.
  
• RFP/RFI & Proposal Management: Lead the technical and functional response to Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and Requests for Information (RFIs), including effort estimation, commercial scoping, and resource planning.
  
• Risk Assessment & Estimation: Identify delivery risks early in the sales cycle and collaborate with delivery/offshore centers to align proposed timelines, budgets, and milestones.
  
• Sales Enablement & Handoff: Educate account teams on SAP data products and ensure a smooth transition of won projects from sales to the delivery/implementation teams.
  
  
  
Required Qualifications & Skills
  
  
• Experience: Typically 10 to 15+ years of total SAP experience, with hands-on or architectural background in SAP MDG and prior pre-sales/solutioning exposure.
  
• Functional & Technical Depth:
  
• Deep understanding of SAP MDG (Central Governance, Consolidation, Mass Processing, Workflow design, Data Quality Management).
  
• Familiarity with SAP S/4HANA, SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform), and broader enterprise data migration/governance tools.
  
• Knowledge of core/advanced ABAP concepts related to MDG workflow and UI configurations is a strong plus

05d2ad7d.title: Solution Engineer : Mumbai
05d2ad7d.description:
**About DevRev**
At DevRev, we're building the future of work with
*Computer*
– your AI teammate. Unlike traditional tools,
*Computer*
unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers – updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are looking for
**domain-first, systems-oriented engineers**
who understand how real-world systems (in renewable energy
**,**
automotive, manufacturing, IoT, etc.) generate and use data — and can translate that into meaningful AI-driven workflows using DevRev.
  
  
As a Solutions Engineer, you will act as a
**trusted advisor**
, combining
**domain expertise, engineering depth, and problem-solving**
to help customers unlock value from their data through DevRev’s AI platform.
  
  
You will work closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering to design solutions that go beyond demos — enabling
**real-world automation, intelligence, and agentic workflows**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with customers to deeply understand domain workflows, systems, and data flows (e.g., connected vehicles, factory systems, IoT environments)
* Translate real-world signals (sensor data, logs, events) into insights, workflows, and automated actions
* Build and showcase AI-driven workflows, automations, and agentic use cases
* Design and articulate end-to-end solutions (data ingestion → processing → decision → action)
* Act as a technical advisor, guiding customers on how DevRev can integrate into and enhance their existing systems
* Deliver tailored demos, PoCs, and solution walkthroughs grounded in real-world use cases (not generic SaaS demos)
* Support integrations with external systems via APIs, webhooks, and data pipelines
* Contribute to technical proposals, RFP/RFI responses, and solution architectures
* Stay current on industry trends (renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, IoT, AI) and bring insights into customer conversations

**Qualifications & Skills**
**Domain Expertise**

* Experience in renewable energy, automotive, manufacturing, industrial systems, or IoT environments
* Strong understanding of:
* Connected systems (vehicles, machines, robotics, embedded systems)
* Sensor ecosystems (CAN, telemetry, vision systems, IoT devices)
* Real-world data (signals, logs, time-series)
* Familiarity with manufacturing workflows (inspection, defect detection, production cycles).
* Ability to explain data flow from system → processing → business outcomes

**Engineering Depth**

* Strong system-level thinking
* Experience with:
* Data pipelines, APIs, integrations, distributed systems
* Experience in Python / TypeScript / JavaScript (or similar)
* Understanding of system design, reliability, and failure handling
* Exposure to AI/ML in industrial use cases (vision systems, predictive maintenance, log-stream analysis, etc.)

**Problem Solving & Use Case Thinking**

* Ability to translate data → insights → workflows → actions
* Experience designing end-to-end systems
* Strong analytical mindset to identify automation opportunities from real-world signals

**AI & Tools**

* Exposure to LLMs, RAG, AI agents
* Familiarity with prompt design and AI workflows
* Tools: Postman, GitHub, Jira, Cursor, Claude Code

**How do we work?**
Whatever your role, our values describe what we ask of each other.
  
  
**Be a bridger**
Look beyond your own role. Ask questions, share context and help others get unstuck. That may mean bringing the right people together or picking up a problem that doesn’t necessarily fit neatly into your job description.
  
  
**Care loudly**
We want your perspective, not just your agreement. Speak up when something isn’t working or someone needs support. Give honest feedback with respect for the person receiving it. Don’t let an uncomfortable conversation become an unspoken problem.
  
  
**Own the outcome**
Take responsibility for the result, not just your part in the process. Use AI to move the work forward, not to outsource your judgment. Make the call, check whether it worked and change course when it didn’t. If something goes wrong, own it and help fix it.
  
  
That’s DevRev!
  
  
*DevRev is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition, or any other basis protected by law.*

afdab2ed.description:
Date: Oct 25, 2026

Job Requisition Id: 66693

Location:
Pune, IN Pune, MH, IN

YASH Technologies is a leading technology integrator specializing in helping clients reimagine operating models, enhance competitiveness, optimize costs, foster exceptional stakeholder experiences, and drive business transformation.

  

At YASH, we’re a cluster of the brightest stars working with cutting-edge technologies. Our purpose is anchored in a single truth – bringing real positive changes in an increasingly virtual world and it drives us beyond generational gaps and disruptions of the future.

  

**We are looking forward to hire Project Management Professionals in the following areas :**

  

**Experience Range**
--------------------

15+ years

**Job Description**
-------------------

Key Responsibilities

Program & Delivery Management

* Own end-to-end delivery of complex data platform programs, ensuring scope, timeline, budget, and quality commitments are met.

* Define program governance, delivery frameworks, milestones, KPIs, and success metrics.

* Manage cross-functional dependencies across data engineering, Data Analytics, Modelling and Testing teams.

* Track risks, issues, and dependencies; drive mitigation plans and escalation as needed.

Technical Leadership & Coordination

* Act as a technically informed program leader with deep understanding of:

o Azure data services (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake Storage, Azure SQL, MS Fabric). Snowflake architecture, usage patterns, and integration with Azure ecosystems.

* Collaborate with architects and engineers to ensure solutions align with best practices for scalability, performance, cost optimization, and security.

* Translate technical concepts into clear updates for senior and non-technical stakeholders.

Cloud Migration & Modernization

* Lead or support programs involving migration of data platforms from on premises to cloud.

* Oversee migration planning, sequencing, data validation, cutover strategies, and post-migration stabilization.

Stakeholder & Communication Management

* Drive regular program status reviews, steering committee updates, and executive reporting. Align business priorities with technical execution across internal teams and external partners.

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

* 15+ years of overall experience with at least 3 years in Program or Technical Program Management roles.

* Strong technical expertise in Microsoft Azure, particularly in data and analytics platforms.

* Working knowledge of Snowflake concepts, data modelling, and Lakehouse architecture.

* Strong understanding of Agile, SAFe, or hybrid delivery models.

Preferred Experience

* Prior experience managing managed services or AMS (Application Managed Services) engagements.

* Hands-on involvement in on-premises to cloud data platform migrations.

* Azure certifications (e.g., Azure Solutions Architect, Azure Data Engineer) or PMP / PgMP certifications.

**Required Technical/ Functional Competencies**
-----------------------------------------------

**Change Management:**

* Specialized in overcoming resistance to change and helping organizations achieve their Agile goals.
* Able to guide teams in driving the change management projects or requirements.

**Customer Management:**

* Specialized knowledge of customers' business domain and technology suite.
* Use latest technology, communicate effectively, demonstrate leadership, present technical offerings, and proactively suggest solutions.

**Delivery Management:**

* Specialized knowledge of deal modeling, commercial and pricing models.
* Create an integrated pricing model across service lines.
* Guide team members to apply pricing techniques.
* Grow the account, forecast revenues and analyze complex internal reports.
* Manage at least 1 complex account (>10m) or multiple small account independently.

**Domain/ Industry Knowledge:**

* Specialized knowledge of customers' business processes and relevant technology platform or product.
* Able to forecast business requirements and market trends, manage project issues, and validate customer strategy roadmap.

**Product/Technology Knowledge:**

* In-depth knowledge of platform/product and associated technologies.
* Review various product-specific solutions for a specific project/client/organization and conduct product demos, walkthroughs and presentations to prospects if required.

**Profitability Management:**

* In-depth proficiency in profitability and cost management.
* Can analyze project financial data, identify trends, and proactively address budgetary issues.
* Have deep understanding of cost drivers and can provide accurate cost forecasts.
* Look for opportunities to optimize costs and enhance profitability.

**Project Management:**

* Extensive experience in managing projects and can handle complex projects with minimal supervision.
* Deep understanding of project management concepts and methodologies and can apply them effectively to achieve project goals.

**Scheduling and Resource Planning:**

* Prepare independent global delivery models covering skill levels, skill mix and onsite/offshore work allocation.
* Create an accurate resource plan for people, space and infrastructure for the given requirements.
* Forecast people and skill requirements to align with plans.
* Optimize the schedule for complex projects.

**Service Support and Maintenance:**

* Plan and execute transition for large/ complex activities.
* Define standards in transition management based on industry trends and contribute to building tools and accelerators for KT process.
* Optimize resource utilization based on demand from customers.
* Select and define SLAs; track service levels and analyze impact of SLA on complex processes and deliverables.

**Risk Management:**

* Specialized level of expertise in risk management.
* Proactively identify risks, assess their probability and impact, and develop comprehensive risk management plans.
* Effectively communicate risk-related information to stakeholders, recommend appropriate risk response strategies, and monitor risk throughout the project lifecycle to maximize results and meet deadlines.

* Being a role model for taking initiative and ensuring others take initiative, removing obstacles for others, taking ownership for results and deadlines for self and others, and acting as a role model for being responsible.

**Collaboration:**

* Leads team activities that support collaboration. Determines common goals and shares responsibilities for results; begins to build partnerships across groups.

**Customer Focus:**

* Understands the client, market and economic trends to establish ways of creating value of existing and new customer aligned to organizational imperatives.

**Leadership Competencies as Applicable:**

**Vision Alignment:**

* Create action plan based on Business objectives.
* Manages all the internal and external issues that may affect the organization's vision, mission and objectives.
* Leads & directs a strategic planning team to address & outline the future direction of Department.
* Prioritize the work based on Department’s priority.
* Demonstrates a "can do" attitude and is willing to stretch self to achieve and exceed defined goals/targets.

* Considers impact on the directly involved parties while making decisions.
* Knows how to analyze difficulties down to their root.
* Demonstrated ability to take timely decisions when clear guidelines & process are defined.
* Takes ownership for and ensures accuracy of own work, meets deadlines, and asks questions about possible gaps to ensure clarity of ownership.

* identify opportunities for improving his own performance and capability.

f721f8f6.description:
**Rust Architect / Backend Developer**

Job Type :- Freelance

Work Mode :- Fully Remote

Availability :- Approximately 20 Hours/Week

Compensation :- ₹4,500–₹6,500/Hour

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Rust Architect / Backend Developer for a project focused on production-grade Rust development, backend architecture, and reliable software systems. The role involves designing and evaluating backend services, developing concurrent systems, debugging complex technical issues, and validating software solutions for correctness, scalability, performance, and maintainability.

The ideal candidate will have strong Rust programming skills, experience with backend engineering, and the ability to independently solve complex software development challenges in a remote environment.

Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and validate Rust-based backend systems, APIs and services.

Build and evaluate asynchronous and concurrent applications.

Analyze backend architecture, system performance, reliability and scalability.

Develop testing workflows and reproducible implementation processes.

Configure Rust crate workspaces, databases, dependency services and containerized environments.

Perform technical debugging and resolve complex backend engineering issues.

Evaluate data persistence, API behavior, fault handling and service reliability.

Ensure code quality, maintainability and production readiness.

**Department**
: IT

**Position Purpose:**
As a member of the IS Architecture team, you will be in charge of helping projects define their Solution Architecture while migrating the Information System of Wealth Management into BNPP group Cloud platform. You will review their proposals with Enterprise Architects as well as Engineering/Production teams and Security teams to ensure that solutions proposed are aligned and compliant with BNPP policies and BNPP Cloud offering.

* IT system diagrams (Division level, or per sub-block)
* Application referential (with the help of Application Owners)
* Division level principles and related non-conformities and remediation plans
* Obsolescence KPIs
* Lead the Cloud solution architecture on the projects they are assigned to:

* Presenting their projects in architecture validation committee
* Being the reference point on a set of applications for support/evolution activities
* Supporting the architecture process till the go-live
* Bringing Cloud and architecture awareness to application teams

* Collaborate with following roles:

* Division heads to align domain objectives and roadmaps
* Business analysts to understand the business needs and design solution that are functionally consistent
* Ensure the reference documentation is updated all along the changes brought by projects:
* Application referential
* IT architecture diagrams and documents
* Application non-conformities and remediation plans
* Architecture principles, checklist, guidelines

**Technical & Behavioral Competencies**
**Mandatory**

* Experience on designing and developing Cloud-native solutions

* Experience with Java/Spring/Angular, Oracle/PostgreSQL DB, Linux, API, Kafka etc.
* Functional/Business knowledge (current/past companies), ideally on core banking or portfolio management systems. Interest in Financial & Banking industry

* Strong analysis skills with problem solving attitude

**Plus**

* Knowledge of a Wealth Management Core Banking System such as Temenos Transact, ERI Olympic or Avaloq
* SCRUM/Agile experience
* Experience running Request for Proposal and assessing solutions

**Specific Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Engineering
* 3+ years of experience architecting or developing solutions in a Cloud environment
* 5+ years of experience in IT either as an Enterprise Architect or Solution Architect
* Architecture certification (TOGAF) or Cloud Architect certification (AWS, IBM Cloud)

**Technical Skills**
**Skills Referential**
**(Required knowledge, skills and abilities)**




+ Software Architecture / Cloud Architecture - architecting or designing solutions in a Cloud environment (AWS, IBM Cloud)
+ Architecture patterns / Design principles / Problem solving / Solutioning
+ Architecture certification (TOGAF) or Cloud Architect certification (AWS, IBM Cloud)

**Behavioral Skills**

* Ability to collaborate / Teamwork


+ Communication skills - oral & written

* Ability to synthetize / simplify

**Education Level:**
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or Engineering

Chennai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Business Solutions Consultant

Field Sales & Closing | Calicut (Kozhikode), Kerala | Full-time | 9:00 AM–5:00 PM

The mission

Turn relevant inbound enquiries into paid Emilda engagements. Meet business owners in person, diagnose operational bottlenecks, shape a practical solution with our team, close the commercial agreement, and hand over a clear, committed project to our Engagement Lead.

Why this role exists

Emilda helps established, owner-led businesses become less dependent on the owner through better processes, accountability and the right software. We do not sell an off-the-shelf product first and look for a problem later. Our marketing brings enquiries from Calicut businesses; this role turns the right enquiries into trusted relationships and signed projects.

What you will own

• Respond to inbound enquiries from Meta, Google Ads, referrals and other inbound sources. Contact quickly, confirm business context and identify the actual decision-maker.

• Qualify for fit: company size, business type, owner involvement, urgency, decision process and willingness to invest. Politely disqualify poor-fit leads.

• Travel and meet the owner at offices, warehouses, distribution businesses and institutions in and around Calicut.

• Discover the operational problem: owner dependency, visibility, collections, inventory, handovers, employee accountability. Capture real examples and business impact rather than jumping into a demo.

• Develop the proposed solution with Emilda’s Engagement Lead and technical team (you are not expected to code).

• Present, negotiate and close: lead the solution discussion, manage approved commercials, obtain written acceptance and coordinate collection of the initial payment.

• Hand over without information loss to Vishnu, the Engagement Lead.

• Keep evidence in the CRM every working day.

Who will succeed here

• Personally influenced and closed meaningful B2B service or solution deals.

• Builds trust with a business owner, asks strong discovery questions, discusses money with confidence.

• Comfortable travelling locally for frequent face-to-face meetings; fluent spoken Malayalam and usable written English.

• Organized with follow-ups, CRM hygiene and clear handovers.

• Consultative B2B selling preferred (roughly 2+ years); proof of relevant deals matters more than title or degree.

Compensation

Indicative fixed pay: ₹40,000–₹45,000 per month, subject to demonstrated experience. Approved local travel reimbursement and performance-linked closing incentives are additional.

To apply: share your resume and a short example of one B2B deal you personally helped close—who the buyer was, what problem they had, what you did, and what happened. Shortlisted candidates complete a practical business-owner discovery and closing exercise.

This is an inbound-led, field-first closing position. Dedicated cold outreach and large-scale prospecting are not the primary responsibility at launch.

Trusted by 2,500 organizations and over 3.5 million users around the globe, Seismic is headquartered in San Diego with offices across North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. Learn more at seismic.com.
  
  
Seismic is committed to building an inclusive workplace that ignites growth for our employees and creates a culture of belonging that allows all employees to be seen and valued for who they are. Learn more about DEI at Seismic here.
  
  
**Overview:**
Join us on an exciting journey as a Technical Account Manager. We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Account Manager/Solution Architect to own and elevate the end-to-end technical experience for our enterprise and mid-market customers. As a trusted advisor, you will pair hands-on solution design—including custom API integrations, SSO authentication, and MCP setup—with strategic guidance to accelerate adoption of critical capabilities and turn platform data into actionable business insights. This role blends deep product expertise with strategic advisory work, and it requires someone who can build trust with both technical practitioners and executive stakeholders.
  
  

* No. of Open Positions : 4
* Location : Hyderabad
* Mode of work : Hybrid

**Who you are:**
Experience: 5+ years in a client-facing technical role (Technical Account Manager, Solution Architect, Solutions Engineer, or Systems Integrator) within a SaaS environment.
  
  
Technical Expertise: Proven experience designing and implementing integrations using RESTful APIs, Web Services, MCPs, and data flow modeling.
  
  
CRM & SSO: Hands-on experience with enterprise CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics 365), SOQL/SQL queries, and SSO authentication standards (SAML/OAuth).
  
  
Project & Stakeholder Management: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex client engagements concurrently while effectively communicating with both technical leads and executive stakeholders.
  
  
Problem Solving: Exceptional analytical, troubleshooting, and critical thinking skills with a track record of driving strategic customer outcomes.
  
  
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  
  
**Nice-to-Have Qualifications**

* Prior experience within Sales Enablement or Enterprise Content Management SaaS platforms (e.g., Highspot, Seismic).
* Relevant certifications in Salesforce, AWS, or enterprise architecture frameworks.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* 1. Technical Architecture & Integration Design

+ Lead discovery and requirement-gathering sessions with enterprise customers to define business goals, technical requirements, and integration architecture.
+ Design and implement scalable integration solutions using RESTful APIs, Web Services, MCP, and custom connectors.
+ Translate complex requirements into detailed solution design documents, architecture diagrams, and data flow specifications.
+ Serve as the technical lead across concurrent onboarding and implementation projects, ensuring high-quality, SLA-compliant delivery.

* Technical Account Management & Strategic Advisory

+ Serve as the primary technical liaison between clients and internal teams (Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and Support).
+ Provide ongoing strategic technical guidance, proactive health checks, and best practices to drive customer adoption and retention.
+ Guide customers toward high adoption of AI-powered product capabilities.
+ Lead regular customer alignment meetings and executive reviews to present updates, technical roadmaps, and strategic recommendations.
+ Manage client technical escalations, troubleshoot complex issues, and oversee risk mitigation across key accounts.

* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Advocacy

+ Act as the voice of the customer to Product and Engineering teams, advocating for feature enhancements and platform optimizations.
+ Conduct technical enablement, onboarding workshops, and training sessions for client technical teams and internal stakeholders.
+ Mentor junior team members and contribute to the continuous improvement of internal technical frameworks and documentation.

**What we have for you:**
