548aced8.title: Solutions Engineer
548aced8.description:
Broadcasters and streaming partners each want the content delivered slightly differently, and every one of those differences currently becomes a conversation with engineering. This role exists to absorb that.

  

A global media company building its India operations is hiring through Flexiple for a solutions engineer to sit with the partner and distribution teams. You would design how a new partner integrates — formats, metadata, delivery schedules, the rights constraints that make all of it more complicated than it looks — and then make the first delivery work. Flexiple is a managed marketplace that helps global companies build high-performing teams and GCCs in India.

  

Roughly 4 to 8 years in a technical customer-facing role, comfortable with media formats and delivery pipelines or willing to learn them quickly, able to script your way around a problem, and calm when a partner's launch date is fixed and their systems are not ready.

  

Mumbai, Bengaluru, Delhi NCR, Chennai or Hyderabad, with remote flexibility within India and occasional partner visits. Send an application; we keep them in view for related roles on the distribution side.

5f72b34e.title: FBS SR Solutions Engineer (Guidewire)
5f72b34e.description:
FBS - Farmer Business Services is part of Farmers Insurance operations with the purpose of building a global approach to identifying, recruiting, hiring, and retaining top talent. By combining international reach with US expertise, we build diverse and high-performing teams that are equipped to thrive in today's competitive marketplace.
  
  
We believe that the foundation of every successful business lies in having the right people with the right skills. That is where we come in—helping Farmers build a winning team that delivers consistent and sustainable results.
  
  
Since we don't have a local legal entity, we've partnered with Capgemini, which acts as the Employer of Record. Capgemini is responsible for managing local payroll and benefits.
  
  
**What to expect on your journey with us:**

* A solid and innovative company with a strong market presence
* A dynamic, diverse, and multicultural work environment
* Leaders with deep market knowledge and strategic vision
* Continuous learning and development

This position collaborates with business stakeholders, solution engineers, architects and Agile teams to deliver Guidewire configuration and integration solutions that support complex insurance initiatives. The role serves as a subject matter resource for the Guidewire platform, providing system level perspectives and implementing technical solutions aligned with business and architectural objectives.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Optimizing Guidewire configuration, building reliable integrations using APIs and messaging frameworks
* Improving development and deployment processes through CI/CD and DevOps practices.
* Ensures successful technology delivery across lines of business and the enterprise
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and version control systems
* Actively participates in Agile and SAFe ceremonies including PI Planning, Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, daily stand ups, system demos, and retrospectives, delivering committed sprint and PI objectives. No certification required

**Requirements**

* Over 9 years of experience required in a similar role
* Data Architecture & Governance Experience (PLUS)
* Full English Fluency
* 2Hrs Overlap with US Time zone (Pacific Time) Flexibility

Technical Skills
  
  

* Guidewire policy center 9.0.5 and 10 development and GOSU language Experience (MUST);
* Policy center Specialization certificate PLUS
* Cloud Policy Center (PLUS)
* PolicyCenter Data model; Guidewire Rating Engine; PolicyCenter Product Model and PolicyCenter integration in GOSU and PCF
* Web Service; Batch and Plugin; - Advanced (7+ Years)
* Java (MUST); J2EE; Hibernate; Spring; Spring JPA; SpringBoot; DB2; SQL Server; Oracle; - Advanced (7+ Years)
* Production experience, E2E, document gathering, process,

Soft Skills
  
  

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate and influence
* Demonstrated problem solving skills and resolve complex technical issues
* Ability to simultaneously handle multiple priorities
* In-depth knowledge of software architecture principles and design patterns

**Benefits**
This position comes with competitive compensation and benefits package:
  
  

* Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Career development and training opportunities
* Flexible work arrangements (remote and/or office-based)
* Dynamic and inclusive work culture within a globally renowned group
* Private Health Insurance
* Pension Plan
* Paid Time Off
* Training & Development

**Important Hiring Conditions and Disclosures**
By applying for this position, candidates acknowledge and agree that:
  
  

* Personal Data Processing: The personal data provided during the recruitment and selection process will be collected, processed, and retained for legitimate recruitment and compliance purposes, in accordance with applicable data protection and privacy laws and FBS internal policies
* Legal Authorization to Work: Employment with FBS is conditional upon the candidate having valid, local legal authorization to work in the country where the role is based at the time of hire. FBS does not sponsor or obtain work authorization unless explicitly stated
* Exclusivity of Employment and Conflict of Interest: Upon acceptance of an offer and during employment with FBS, employees will not be permitted to engage in parallel employment, professional activities, or paid work for other entities. Any ownership, partnership, directorship, or participation in other businesses or companies must be fully disclosed and formally reviewed in accordance with FBS internal conflict‑of‑interest and external engagement policies prior to the start date or as soon as such circumstances arise

Failure to comply with these conditions may impact the hiring decision or employment continuation.

8eb357b3.title: Sr IT Architect
8eb357b3.description:
**Job Description**
Sr. IT Architect – Salesforce The future is what you make it. When you join Honeywell, you become a member of our global team of thinkers, innovators, dreamers, and doers who make the things that make the future. That means changing the way we fly, fueling jets in an eco-friendly way, keeping buildings smart and safe and even making it possible to breathe on Mars. Working at Honeywell isn't just about developing cool things. That's why all our employees enjoy access to dynamic career opportunities across different fields and industries. Are you ready to help us make the future
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Job Description:**

* Build and work on solution design, solution architecture, roadmaps, prototypwa & proof of concepts for current and future projects.
* Work on the end-to-end implementation life cycle of the CPQ global design model on projects across all SBG’s.
* Showcase strong technical expertise in the Salesforce platform, related objects & Integrations.
* Work with Enterprise Architecture Review Board for Architecture Governance across architecture domains and ensure solution alignment with Architecture standards.
* Perform the overall technical lead role on projects - Conduct Solution and Design with Enterprise Architecture and project teams prior to development activities.
* Convert business requirements into Conceptual and Integration Design specifications and ensure solution is flexible & scalable and meets business requirements.
* Advise and create methods to improve technical solution processes.
* Align with enterprise-wide Agile teams and strong adherence to Agile cadence.

**Qualifications**
**Must Have:**

* Overall 7+ years of IT experience with 4+ years of experience on the Salesforce platform and QTC processes.
* Good understanding of integration touch points with SAP CPQ, SAP ECC, PROS
* Familiarity in using Data Analysis tools and techniques for data mapping, transformation and integration.
* Demonstrated experience leading all technical deliverables with large transformational programs.
* Experience architecting end to end solutions in the Opportunity to Quote, Quote to Cash & CPQ domains
* Strong communication skills to be able to articulate solutions to IT/business stakeholders and conduct show and tell sessions

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

838f2a5d.title: Sr Enterprise Technical Architect (Planning) - GPTS Consulting
838f2a5d.description:
**Overview**

* Leading AI-driven Global Supply Chain Solutions Software Product Company and one of Glassdoor’s “Best Places to Work”
* We are seeking an astute and enthusiastic individual who has a strong technical foundation with the additional ability to be hands-on with the Professional Services team as part of the development/deployment cycle, and deep knowledge of industry best practices, with the ability to lead and implement independently working with both the platform, and the solution teams.

**Scope**

* The Professional services team within Blue Yonder operates globally and is growing rapidly.
* Blue Yonder Enterprise Technical Architect (Planning) will be responsible for services delivery of product implementation and related integration.
* This role will provide the associate to be hands-on with the Professional Services team as part of the development/deployment cycle, and deep knowledge of industry best practices, with the ability to implement them working with both the platform, and the solution teams.
* Core responsibilities include Strategy, Architecting, Design/Development (along with counterparts, customer, and Architects) and leading the technical team on projects and delivery initiatives catered around Supply Chain Planning solution and capabilities implementation.

**Desired Skills And Experience**

* Knowledge on
* OS – Windows, Unix
* DB – RDBMS Concepts, Oracle, MS SQL Server, SQL/ PL SQL
* Implementation experience using SCPO Platform or any other relevant enterprise planning product and platforms.
* Enterprise Architecture frameworks certifications or awareness is an added advantage.
* Next Gen Skills - Data Science, Data Analytics, Agile, Python, AI/ML, Cloud Fun, Azure, Google Cloud Platform, AWS, Databases/Data Platforms(emerging) – Snowflake, MongoDB, NoSQL, etc
* Reporting Skills – MS PowerBI
* Professional Attributes:
* Excellent communication, Inter-personal, Stakeholder management, Analytical and Problem-solving skills
* Excellent organization and project documentation skills
* Meticulous planning with attention to detail and multi-tasking skills
* Domain knowledge: Understanding of Supply Chain Planning and how it integrates with other systems. Any industry specific experience is a big plus.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead and mentor team of technical associates on Solution implementation, enhancement, managed services, integration, custom projects either at the customer site or offshore.
* Estimate the workload of implementation activities that are within the scope of their skills; assess business needs that fall outside the standard solution, assess integration complexity, architecture.
* Able to work and own initiatives for the technical planning team (Professional Services) and demonstrate good skills in leading the strategy and contribute towards complex customer assessment and sales cycle.
* Collaborate with Global Team/Partners and Customers or internal stakeholders.
* Conduct technical analysis sessions with customers and/or the project team to understand the functional and technical needs of the customer and develop technical solutions to meet those needs. Configure and implement Blue Yonder software solutions according to the client's specific requirements.
* Documentation Support - Technical aspects of Blue Yonder Solutions, including technical specifications, configuration details, and user manuals.
* Implementation and steady state support, contribute on internal development projects and activities.
* Contribute to the growth of the technical professional services practice by developing and maintaining practice aids, databases, best-practice collateral, assets, and accelerators.
* Continuously upskill Blue Yonder’ s product suite and technology innovation to convey relationships and touchpoints to the customer. Incumbent should be up to date on the Product Roadmap and strategy and need to have a synergy with cross functional team(s).
* Ready to travel to customer sites based on business needs.
* Identify areas of improvement and scope of automation on routine tasks or activities
* Handle activities with a diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors.
* Accelerate Time-to-Value for customer by iteratively delivering in short cycles.
* Recognize and highlight incremental revenue opportunities within existing customer projects.
* Ensures compliance with the internal and external company policies and procedures.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree and 14+ years of experience in Software industry; ideally a candidate who has started as a Consultant and has worked his/her way to leading the technical team on 5+ complete implementation cycles.
* Demonstrable understanding of software engineering fundamentals and design principles
* Experience working with large customers in challenging environments and having design/implemented enterprise application solutions and integration architectures.
* Demonstrable experience leading, building, deploying and maintenance of enterprise solutions (cloud or on-premises)
* Excellent communication, Inter-personal, Analytical and Problem-solving skills
* Strong programming experience and problem-solving skills
* Supply Chain Planning Industry Experience
* Expertise on performance tuning techniques and ability to assist other team members with benchmarking and sizing exercises.
* Possess technical expertise on emerging technologies and integration with different database and scripting languages like Python, SQL/PLSQL, Linux, etc
* Good understanding of Web Technologies and API fundamentals
* Strong understanding on Cloud and Architectural design (Azure or equivalent, Microservices Architecture, Multi-Tenant)
* Demonstrable experience with Blue Yonder SCPO Platform.
* Hands-on development skills; should not have moved away from development activities.
* Passionate about working with new and emerging technologies, products and demonstrates the ability to learn quickly, and have good interpersonal & communication

**Our Values**
If you want to know the heart of a company, take a look at their values. Ours unite us. They are what drive our success – and the success of our customers. Does your heart beat like ours? Find out here: Core Values
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

da35f5d6.title: Architect, Apps & AI
da35f5d6.description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Industry Solutions - Global Center Innovation and Delivery Center (GCID) delivers end-to-end solutions by enabling accelerated adoption and productive use of Microsoft technologies. An organization of well over 1000+ exceptional people, GCID presents a great opportunity for highly skilled services professionals to make a foray into consulting, solution development and delivery roles.
  
  
The Architect is a senior leader responsible for the successful technical execution and delivery of complex client projects across diverse domains. This role acts as a strategic anchor between clients, senior leadership, delivery managers, project managers, and delivery teams. In the AI-first GCID organization, Architect(s) are expected to embed AI-native thinking into delivery models, ensuring solutions are intelligent, scalable, and aligned with business outcomes. The ideal candidate is passionate about technology, demonstrates breadth of expertise, and advocates for solutions that deliver true client value.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**AI-First Delivery Leadership**

* Embed AI-first principles into delivery workflows, leveraging automation and intelligent orchestration where applicable.
* Own the Architecture and drive end-to-end delivery of complex projects, ensuring solutions are scalable, robust, and aligned with client business outcomes.
* Drive engineering excellence through reusable components, accelerators, and scalable architecture.
* Oversee technical execution across multiple projects, ensuring adherence to best practices, quality standards, and compliance requirements.
* Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to define strategies, delivery plans, milestones, and risk mitigation approaches.
* Act as a technical point of contact for clients, translating business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ensure delivery models are optimized for modern, AI-native execution, including integration of automation and intelligent processes.
* Ability to step into at‑risk projects, quickly assess issues, and establish a credible path to recovery or exit.

**Engineering Excellence**
Promote high-quality engineering throughout all projects. Enforce coding standards, architectural integrity, and performance goals. Establish secure coding, TDD, and observability practices. Support ongoing learning and certifications. Advance modern methodologies like Agile, DevOps, and CI/CD for scalable solutions. Build a team culture of technical rigor, innovation, and accountability.
  
  
**Innovation & Thought Leadership**
Track new technologies to guide strategy. Drive innovation in delivery, assets, and tools for better efficiency. Promote best practices and continuous improvement across teams.
  
  
**Client Engagement & Solutioning**
Apply design thinking to develop user-centric solutions that also support business objectives, architecture, and project delivery. Collaborate with clients to identify their needs and provide guidance throughout each stage of the project. Participate in pre-sales and solutioning activities by preparing estimates, proofs-of-concept, and technical proposals. Additionally, maintain strong client relationships to ensure satisfaction and ongoing value.
  
  
**Team Management & Mentorship**
Lead cross-functional teams, promote learning and collaboration, and uphold technical standards. Review work, offer feedback, and support team growth.
  
  
**Quality & Compliance**
Ensure secure, compliant, and reliable solution delivery through secure coding, test‑driven development, observability, design reviews, and quality gates across all engagements.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* 16+ years of experience in software/solution engineering, with at least 8-12 years as Architect and delivery leadership roles.
* Proven experience in leading delivery of complex, multi-disciplinary projects.
* Strong understanding of modern delivery methodologies (Agile, Scrum, DevOps, etc.).
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and team leadership skills.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* Relevant certifications are a plus.

**Areas of Expertise**
**Full Stack Application Engineering**




+ End-to-end design and development of modern web and mobile applications using React, Angular, Next.js, Blazor, or equivalent frameworks
+ Strong backend expertise using .NET / Java / Node.js / Python, with clean architecture, domain-driven design, and API-first principles
+ Experience building microservices and distributed systems using REST, gRPC, event-driven patterns, and asynchronous processing
+ Hands-on expertise with relational and NoSQL databases (Azure SQL, PostgreSQL, Cosmos DB) and performance tuning
+ Strong understanding of state management, scalability, resiliency, and application security

**AI Driven Application Development**

* Proven expertise in AI‑driven application development, embedding intelligence directly into modern, cloud‑native applications.
* Extensive hands‑on experience using GitHub Copilot as a core engineering capability to accelerate solution design, coding, refactoring, testing, and documentation across delivery teams.
* Demonstrated ability to foster a Copilot‑assisted engineering culture (“vibe”) - enabling rapid iteration, AI pair‑programming, explain‑as‑you‑build workflows, and high‑velocity delivery without compromising engineering quality.
* Strong experience modernizing application landscapes using GitHub Copilot‑assisted approaches, including rapid codebase comprehension, dependency analysis, large‑scale refactoring, and migration to cloud‑native and AI‑enabled architectures.
* Effective use of GitHub Copilot across the entire SDLC, from solutioning and scaffolding through CI/CD automation, test generation, production readiness, and operational excellence.
* Ability to coach and enable teams and customers on effective Copilot usage patterns, prompt strategies, and safe AI‑assisted engineering practices in enterprise environments.
* Apply Responsible AI principles across design and delivery, incorporating security, privacy, governance, and compliance controls into production‑grade engineering workflows.

**AI-Enabled Application Development**

* Ability to translate business scenarios into production‑grade AI solutions using Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services, Azure AI Foundry, and custom ML models, with hands‑on delivery of RAG architectures leveraging Azure AI Search, vector databases, enterprise data grounding, and integration patterns.
* Strong expertise in prompt engineering, context management, grounding strategies, and LLM integration for copilots, conversational interfaces, intelligent workflows, and decision‑support applications.
* Proven experience designing and implementing single‑agent and multi‑agent AI systems, including task boundaries, tool invocation, memory management, collaboration, delegation, and coordination, using frameworks such as Semantic Kernel, LangChain, and LangGraph.
* Deep understanding of agentic workflows, combining LLM reasoning with external tools, APIs, and enterprise data sources, alongside agent lifecycle management - planning, execution, retries, failure handling, and human‑in‑the‑loop patterns.
* Designs enterprise‑ready AI solutions with built‑in observability and operational excellence, including telemetry, prompt tracing, agent behavior logging, model metrics, experimentation, drift monitoring, and cost/performance optimization, while applying Responsible AI principles across security, privacy, governance, and compliance - balancing speed, quality, and enterprise constraints at scale.

**Cloud-Native Architecture (Azure)**




+ Deep experience designing cloud‑native, PaaS‑first solutions on Azure, prioritizing managed services over IaaS to improve scalability, resilience, security, and operational efficiency.
+ Proven expertise in architecting and delivering solutions using Azure App Service, Azure Container Apps, AKS, Azure Functions, and API Management, selecting the right compute model based on workload characteristics and business needs.
+ Strong working knowledge of identity, security, and networking architectures, including Microsoft Entra ID, RBAC, Managed Identity, Key Vault integration, private endpoints, and VNET‑integrated application deployments.
+ Design and implementation of architectures that support high availability, horizontal scalability, disaster recovery, and fault tolerance, including multi‑region deployment patterns and resiliency strategies.
+ Experience in cost‑aware architecture design, applying cost optimization strategies such as right‑sizing, autoscaling, consumption‑based services, and proactive cost governance.
+ Apply Microsoft Well‑Architected Framework principles across reliability, security, performance efficiency, operational excellence, and cost optimization, incorporating architecture reviews and continuous improvement into delivery.
+ Hands‑on experience building cloud‑ready landing patterns, integrating application architectures with enterprise networking, security baselines, and platform standards.

**DevOps, Platform & Developer Productivity**




+ Strong expertise in designing and operating CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions, enabling automated build, test, security scanning, and deployment workflows across environments.
+ Proven hands‑on experience with Infrastructure‑as‑Code (IaC) using Bicep, ARM, and Terraform, leveraging GitHub Copilot to scaffold modules, generate templates, and propose secure configurations aligned with enterprise standards.
+ Deep understanding of observability and reliability engineering, including centralized logging, metrics, distributed tracing, SLOs, and proactive alerting for production systems.
+ Demonstrated ability to enhance developer productivity and delivery velocity through inner‑source practices, reusable components, reference implementations, accelerators, and automation.
+ Experience embedding DevSecOps practices into delivery pipelines, including secure coding checks, dependency scanning, secrets management, policy enforcement, and compliance validation.
+ Effective use of GitHub Copilot across the DevOps lifecycle, including authoring pipeline definitions, generating runbooks and release notes, assisting with PR summaries, and accelerating troubleshooting and incident response.
+ Strong grasp of platform engineering principles, building paved‑road solutions and self‑service capabilities that balance speed, governance, and operational excellence.
+ Ability to continuously improve engineering throughput, quality, and system reliability, while maintaining enterprise security and compliance expectations.

**Solutioning, Pre-Sales & Technical Leadership**




+ Lead technical solutioning, estimations, and support architecture design during pre-sales and delivery shaping
+ Translate business outcomes into clear architecture, execution plans, and risk mitigation strategies
+ Influence technical direction across multiple teams and engagements
+ Act as a trusted advisor to clients and internal leadership

**Frontier Engineering & Customer Enablement Skills**




+ Lead rapid prototyping, pilots, and early-stage deployments for enterprise customers
+ Ability to go from whiteboard to production with minimal friction
+ Strong troubleshooting and production support expertise, including performance, reliability, and security issues
+ Side‑by‑side coding with customer engineering teams to unblock deployments and accelerate time to value
+ Outcome‑driven engineering focused on business impact, not activity
+ Building reusable assets, accelerators, and reference implementations
+ Comfortable operating in ambiguous, high-pressure environments with C-Level customer stakeholders

**Personal Attributes**

* Passion for technology and innovation.
* Ability to interact confidently with senior leaders and clients.
* Strong decision-making skills and a consultative mindset.
* Flexibility to manage in a fast-moving, ambiguous consulting environment.
* Commitment to continuous learning and professional growth.

**Other**

* Embody our culture and values

We are looking for an experienced **Node.js Architect** to lead the design and development of scalable, high-performance, secure, and cloud-native applications. Core Backend & Architecture

* Strong expertise in **Node.js, JavaScript (ES6+), and TypeScript**.

* Extensive experience in **Microservices Architecture, Distributed Systems, Design Patterns, Domain-Driven Design (DDD), and Event-Driven Architecture**.
* Strong expertise in **REST APIs, GraphQL, API Security, Authentication & Authorization**.
* Experience with API Gateways and enterprise integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of **Scalable System Design and Performance Engineering**.

Agentic AI & GenAI (Mandatory)

* Hands-on experience with **LangChain and LangGraph**.
* Experience building **AI Agents, Multi-Agent Systems, Agent Orchestration, and Autonomous Workflows**.
* Experience integrating **LLMs** such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or open-source models.

* Experience with observability tools, logging, monitoring, distributed tracing, and production support.

Data & Messaging

* Experience with **PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis**, or other relational/NoSQL databases.

Security

Preferred Skills

* Exposure to **Python-based AI ecosystems** (preferred but not mandatory).
* Experience with **Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, or Google Vertex AI**.

* Strong stakeholder management and technical leadership capabilities.

  

Candidate Profile

* **12+ years** of software engineering experience with significant expertise in **Node.js architecture and enterprise application design**.
* Proven experience designing and delivering large-scale, cloud-native applications.
* Hands-on experience with **LangChain and LangGraph is mandatory**.
* Strong experience in **GenAI, AI Agents, Multi-Agent Systems, and LLM-based application development**.

7ed7abc4.title: Technical Program Manager, Stores Application Security
7ed7abc4.description:
**Description**
Amazon Application Security is looking for a security-focused Technical Program Manager who wants to make a difference and support Amazon builders to ensure that protecting customer data is at the forefront of all development.
  
  
Our team approaches security challenges with empathy and curiosity to help Amazon builders identify areas of improvement and learn how to navigate the highly dynamic space of application security. Amazon Application Security focuses on enabling our builders to provide a secure and trustworthy experience to our customers without compromising the overall customer experience.
  
  
In this role you will work directly with security teams and Amazon builders providing direct front line support and security expertise to Amazon teams.
  
  
You’ll also find this role will routinely challenge your background in technical product ownership, process development, operational and management skills, project management, critical thinking, relationship-building, and problem-solving. You’ll also find yourself challenged in unique ways when operating at the massive scale of Amazon, unique to a select few corporations in the world. You must be self-directed and open to new challenges, adept at prioritization, innovation, and collaborating with others.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Plan, organize, and manage all phases of the project lifecycle ensuring successful delivery. This includes defining success criteria, developing and managing project governance plans, project schedules, team goals, communication strategies and project milestones.
* Collaborate with internal customers (senior business leaders, development teams, application security engineering teams and other partner security teams) to understand their needs, their business and how we can improve their security posture.
* Architect and manage internal scope of work documents with the customer clearly defining success criteria and timelines. Hold all stakeholders accountable to these documents through the project lifecycle, escalating as necessary.
* Build and manage relationships with key internal stakeholders and security teams and while advocating on behalf of our customers to deliver on their security goals.
* Guide the evolution and adoption of internal security support solutions, at times with complex priorities, prioritizing the work most beneficial to Amazon builders.
* Use knowledge of software system design to scope architecture, review associated threat models, educate customers on potential severity of security findings and guide developer and security engineering teams through remediation.
* Define and implement best practice methods, processes, tools and continuous improvement initiatives aimed at scaling and increasing the efficiency of Amazon’s security guidance and builder support processes.
* Own the creation and delivery of business proposals (growth, new areas of focus, etc) and metrics to security leadership.
* Proactively identify and manage program risk, identifying paths to overcome risks, and escalating when necessary
* Work effectively and make sound decisions in a dynamic environment with changing priorities.
* Influence, negotiate, resolve conflicts and achieve results through others who are not direct reports.
* Foster a positive work environment leveraging existing skills in active listening, encouraging diverse perspectives and adapting to a variety of personality types.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why Amazon Security
  
  
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.
  
  
Mentorship and Career growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of technical product or program management experience
* 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
* Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
* 5+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working with security teams

cd38b6c8.title: ORACLE - Solution Architect
cd38b6c8.description:
**About The Role**
As an Oracle Solution Architect, you will make an impact by solutioning Oracle and Oracle AI opportunities and leading pre-sales for the EMEA region, shaping AI-enabled transformation propositions and translating business priorities into secure, scalable and value-led solution roadmaps. You will be a valued member of the Oracle Centre of Excellence for Global Growth Markets team and work collaboratively with Oracle SLS teams, market CP/CRMs, and clients.
  
  
In this role, you will
  
  

* Lead initial customer conversations for Oracle modernization and AI-enabled transformation, identifying priority business outcomes, high-value use cases and adoption considerations.
* Lead Oracle and AI readiness assessments to build a phased modernization roadmap covering applications, data, integration, cloud platform, security, governance and change adoption.
* Design differentiated Oracle solutions that embed AI into business workflows across ERP, HCM, SCM and CX, with clear value realization, architecture and delivery plans.
* Lead multi-disciplinary teams across Testing, Legacy Integrations, Cloud Enablement and Change Management as solution lead for RFPs, bringing Oracle AI capabilities and Cognizant accelerators to customer opportunities.
* Establish responsible AI and security-by-design guardrails covering identity and access, data privacy, model risk, prompt and output controls, auditability and regulatory requirements.

Work model
  
  
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role's business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Pan India.
  
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
  
What you must have to be considered
  
  

* Experience leading mid to large-size Oracle programs as a Solution Architect in transformation programs, with a deep understanding of the customer journey to Oracle and the various options available.
* Experience in pre-sales activities, including leading RFP/RFI responses as Solution Lead, and managing multiple streams within a program such as functional, integration, data migration and change management.
* Breadth of understanding of the overall Oracle landscape, interdependencies between modules and cross-functional integration, with strong awareness of the Oracle product roadmap and market trends across Fusion Cloud Applications, OCI, data platforms, generative AI and agentic AI.
* Hands-on understanding of Oracle Fusion Cloud embedded AI capabilities and Oracle AI Agent Studio, including agent design, orchestration, tools, security and lifecycle management.
* Working knowledge of OCI AI services and enterprise AI architecture patterns, including generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation, vector databases, APIs and integration services.

These will help you succeed
  
  

* Ability to act as a trusted advisor to customer program teams, represent Cognizant during Steering Committee meetings and engage with CXOs and department heads.
* Ability to assess AI use-case feasibility, data readiness, risk, operating model and total cost, and convert findings into a prioritized roadmap and business case.
* Experience defining responsible AI, security, privacy, compliance, observability and human-in-the-loop controls for enterprise solutions.
* Ability to create and present AI-enabled solution demonstrations, reference architectures and executive-level value propositions for business and technology stakeholders.
* Strong industry domain and process leadership skills, building trust in customer conversations.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

17048ac5.description:
**Job Title: Architect (Junior)**

**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana (India)  
**Department:** Engineering  
**Reports To:** Yash Jain (yash.jain@jainallc.com)

**About Orchestra Life Sciences**

Orchestra Life Sciences, a leading technical consultancy, provides strategic support and scientific expertise to accelerate the development of pharmaceutical therapies for cancer and rare diseases. Specializing in nuclear medicine, radiation oncology, cell and gene therapies, regenerative medicines, and biotechnology, we offer unparalleled expertise to help clients navigate the complexities of these advanced therapeutic areas. By collaborating closely with our clients, we aim to speed time to market, driving innovation and ensuring the success of cutting-edge medical solutions. **To learn more about Orchestra Life Science, visit our website at www.orchestralifesciences.com**

**Position Summary**

**Role Overview**

A Junior Architect supports interior planning, layout design, and visual mockups for client/vendor facilities, including laboratory, manufacturing, and office environments. Working under the direction of senior design staff who guide the full concept-to-execution process, this role collaborates directly with leadership to ensure facilities are both functional and visually compelling. You will assist with layout standards, develop construction drawing sets, support code and ADA compliance, and help create visual materials for both internal stakeholders and external partners. Work is performed in a support role and is closely guided by the supervising architect.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Assist with the architectural vision, layout planning, and design standards for facilities and locations.
* Develop and manage architectural drawing sets, including floor plans, equipment layouts, interior elevations, and finish plans.
* Coordinate with engineers, general contractors, and vendors on design and construction details.
* Be present for site evaluations, field verifications, and progress oversight during buildouts.
* Ensure all designs meet applicable codes, standards, accessibility and life-safety requirements, and company design guidelines.
* Maintain an organized library of equipment standards, templates, and layout best practices.

**Required Qualifications**

* Professional Degree in Architecture (B.Arch or M.Arch)
* 2+ years of experience in commercial architecture or interior planning
* Proficiency and speed with Revit, SketchUp, or comparable rendering and modeling software
* Working knowledge of ADA and relevant accessibility and life-safety codes
* Portfolio demonstrating both technical documentation and 3D visualization capabilities.
* Ability to travel locally and/or fly out for site visits as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in life sciences, laboratory, healthcare, cleanroom, or other regulated or high-traffic environments
* Familiarity with cGMP-regulated facility design, ISO cleanroom classifications, or GMP building requirements.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including engineering and external partners.

**Why Join Orchestra Life Sciences**

* Be part of a mission-driven organization advancing innovative therapies.
* Gain hands-on experience in architecture and facility design within a growing biotech company.
* Work alongside experienced leaders and cross-functional teams.
* Opportunities for professional growth and development

**EEO Statement**

Orchestra Life Sciences, LLC herein Orchestra, provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Orchestra complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

Orchestra Life Sciences expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with the ability of Orchestra’s employees to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge.

**Equal Opportunity Employer**

Experience:

0ad0298e.title: Salesforce Technical Architect
0ad0298e.description:
**Description**
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include—but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution, including knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality and accelerate design cycles. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API's as well as a strong development background.
  
  
What You'll Actually Be Doing
  
  

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform, including identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI capabilities using Agentforce
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering methodology by utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed, utilizing AI coding assistants to help enforce standards and optimize code performance
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation, championing the team's use of tools like GitHub Copilot to accelerate the generation of Apex classes, mock data, and REST integrations
* Focus on Performance Evaluation & ROI by collaborating with customers to develop evaluation frameworks to measure AI performance and business value for their specific use cases
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues, leveraging AI diagnostics to interpret system logs and isolate performance bottlenecks quickly
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects using AI tools to build prototypes rapidly
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

You're Our Person If...
  
  

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Community, Marketing, and Community Clouds, as well as an understanding of Agentforce architecture
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions, including using AI platforms to evaluate architectural scaling and load limits
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices, with experience using AI tools to model data distribution and analyze potential data skew risks
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth) and how to configure them securely
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.), utilizing AI platforms to parse third-party REST API documentation and map complex data schemas
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Practical fluency using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems (e.g., Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to accelerate delivery, document technical architecture, and maintain a high standard of code quality
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire.

f36db3c3.title: Salesforce Technical Architect

The Technical Architect will support the full implementation lifecycle, from scoping to deployment in an evolving ecosystem consisting of clients and partners. The Technical Architect will be responsible for successfully designing and building the Salesforce industry-specific solutions.
  
  
The Technical Architect maintains an ongoing comprehensive understanding of the cloud-computing ecosystem. As a Technical Architect, you will have strong focus on salesforce platform (e.g. Sales, Service, Community, and Einstein Clouds) and work closely with our sales and delivery teams to ensure customer success.

This includes a lead role in project discovery and definition workshops, contributing to creating scope and development estimates, and documenting requirements and designs.
* Effective in understanding business needs and distilling the information into business and technical requirements

* Designing transformational technology solutions and working directly with customers to meet their business requirements in accordance with industry best practices.

* Through the use of UML diagrams, design documentation, and best-practice methodologies; the candidate will be responsible for the detailed design of Salesforce-related projects from inception through production support.
* Responsible for ensuring that the system accurately meets the defined expectations of the business unit, ensuring that proper testing is implemented, and performance requirements are closely monitored by working with the development teams.
* Responsible for creating, delivering, in a timely and accurate fashion, CRMs and workflow solutions using Salesforce/Apex, Visualforce, Lightning, LWC, and J2EE technologies.
* Advocate and implement best practice development methodology to drive quality delivery of enterprise solutions.
* Develop POCs or help customers and partners with complex coding tasks.
* Identify and lead internal initiatives to grow the consulting practice; contribute to the overall knowledge base and expertise of the community.

**Experience**

* 10+ years of experience in Salesforce ecosystem developing technology solutions.
* Extensive experience and understanding of the Education/Real-estate/Travel Sector.
* 10+ years of experience working on deployment teams, ideally using Agile development techniques.
* Proven track record of successful delivery of customer projects, preferably enterprise CRM implementations.

e91a28a5.description:
Job Description ? End User Support Lead (Windows & Mac Support)
  
  
**Experience**
**6?10 Years**
Role Summary
  
  
We are seeking an experienced
**End User Support Lead**
to manage and support end-user computing services across Windows and Mac environments. The candidate will be responsible for providing technical leadership, ensuring high-quality user support, managing escalations, maintaining endpoint compliance, and driving continual improvements in end-user experience and service delivery.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Technical Support & Operations
  
  

* Provide L2/L3 support for desktops, laptops, mobile devices, printers, and peripherals.
* Lead support activities for both Windows and macOS environments.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, operating system, and network connectivity issues.
* Manage user onboarding, offboarding, and asset lifecycle activities.
* Support collaboration tools including Microsoft 365, Teams, Outlook, OneDrive, and SharePoint.
* Configure and support Mac devices integrated with Windows-based enterprise environments.
* Manage software deployment, patching, and endpoint security compliance.
* Coordinate with infrastructure, network, security, and application teams for issue resolution.

Mac Support Responsibilities
  
  

* Install, configure, and troubleshoot macOS devices.
* Support Apple hardware including MacBook Pro, MacBook Air, iMac, and peripherals.
* Manage device enrollment through MDM solutions such as Jamf, Intune, or similar tools.
* Support access to corporate resources, VPNs, file shares, printers, and Microsoft 365 applications from Mac devices.
* Troubleshoot Mac performance, authentication, storage, and connectivity issues.
* Support integration of Mac systems with Active Directory / Entra ID environments.

Leadership & Service Management
  
  

* Lead a team of End User Support engineers.
* Manage ticket queues and ensure adherence to SLAs.
* Handle major incidents and executive escalations.
* Monitor service performance and implement process improvements.
* Provide mentorship, training, and technical guidance to team members.
* Maintain knowledge articles, SOPs, and technical documentation.
* Participate in governance reviews and service improvement initiatives.

Vendor & Asset Management
  
  

* Coordinate with vendors for warranty, hardware replacement, and procurement activities.
* Manage endpoint inventory, asset tracking, and audit compliance.
* Ensure software licensing compliance and optimization.

**Required Skills**
Technical Skills
  
  

* Strong experience supporting Windows 10/11 and macOS environments.
* Hands-on experience with:

+ Microsoft 365 Administration
+ Entra ID (Azure AD)
+ Active Directory
+ Intune and/or Jamf
+ SCCM/MECM
+ VPN and Remote Access Technologies
+ Endpoint Security Platforms
+ Printer and Peripheral Support

* Knowledge of networking fundamentals (DNS, DHCP, TCP/IP, Wi-Fi).

Service Management
  
  

* ITIL Foundation preferred.
* Experience in Incident, Request, Problem, and Change Management processes.
* Strong understanding of ServiceNow or similar ITSM platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ITIL Foundation Certification.
* Microsoft Modern Desktop Administrator certification.
* Jamf Certified Associate/Admin certification.
* Apple Device Support Certification.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to manage executive and VIP user support.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting abilities.
* Team leadership and mentoring capabilities.
* Customer-centric mindset with a focus on user experience.

**Support Coverage:**
Global / Regional support operations, including VIP and executive user support.
  
  
ITIL, OS Administration

239db48d.title: Delivery Manager - School Platform Rollouts
239db48d.description:
We build a school management platform and smart-board teaching content used by schools across India. We're hiring a Delivery Manager to run large multi-school rollouts from start to finish. You'll coordinate between our product team and our implementation partners, and make sure schools go live on schedule and lessons arrive on time.

This role is based in Jaipur, with regular travel to client sites.

What you'll do

- Own the rollout schedule: which schools onboard in which batch, and what has to be ready before each one.

- Run the lesson production calendar: track lessons from authoring through review to publishing, and report weekly against target.

- Collect issues from schools and partners, sort them, and get them to the right person with enough detail to act on.

- Prepare progress reports for partners and clients.

- Visit schools now and then to see how teachers actually use the system.

You should have

- 3-6 years running delivery for school, ed-tech or other multi-site programmes, with a track record of hitting dates across several parties.

- Fluent Hindi and English, spoken and written.

- Comfort with spreadsheets and trackers. You don't need to write code.

- Experience with institutional or public-sector clients is a plus.

When you apply, include a few lines on a rollout you ran.

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹900,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Commuter assistance
* Flexible schedule
* Internet reimbursement
* Paid time off
* Work from home

Work Location: Remote

15+ years

05e2c9bc.title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Moveworks
05e2c9bc.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Moveworks)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The Moveworks Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the successful implementation, adoption, and ongoing evolution of the Moveworks platform across the enterprise. The role is responsible for evaluating new Moveworks features and innovations, assessing their applicability to business needs, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption, and prioritizing implementation initiatives that maximize value realization. The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Strong understanding of the Move works platform, including enterprise search, conversational AI, natural language understanding (NLU), employee support automation, and AI-driven workflow orchestration.
* Knowledge of Move works integration capabilities with ServiceNow, Microsoft Teams, Slack, HR systems, identity platforms, and enterprise applications
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of ServiceNow applications (ITSM, ITOM, HRSD).

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

53bbebd9.title: SAP Signavio Architect (REMOTE)
53bbebd9.description:
**SAP Signavio Architect / Techno-Functional Consultant**

**Location:**
Remote

**Budget:**
₹25–35 LPA

**Notice Period:**
Immediate / 1-2 weeks

**Experience:**
10 years overall experience preferred, with at least 5 years of hands-on SAP Signavio implementation experience.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead the implementation of SAP Signavio solutions, focusing on Business Process Management (BPM) and Process Mining.
* Utilize Process Manager, Process Insights, and Process Intelligence tools to provide actionable insights and improve business processes.
* Develop and implement BPMN 2.0 and DMN standards for process modeling and decision management.
* Conduct data integration and technical implementation using SAP BTP and SAP Integration Suite.
* Engage in ETL/ELT development, data profiling, data cleansing, and event-log transformation.
* Work with REST/SOAP APIs and JDBC/ODBC connectors to facilitate data exchange between systems.
* Design and manage RDBMS, data warehousing, and schema to support business intelligence needs.
* Integrate SAP Signavio with non-SAP platforms such as Salesforce, ServiceNow, and Oracle.
* Support SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA migrations by utilizing process mining insights.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Approximately 10 years of relevant professional experience, including 5-10 years in Business Process Management and Process Mining.
* At least 5 years of hands-on experience with SAP Signavio implementations.
* Strong practical experience with SAP Signavio tools, including Process Manager, Process Insights, and Process Intelligence.
* Proficiency in Advanced SQL and SIGNAL query language.
* SAP Signavio certification is preferred.
* Familiarity with Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), or Record-to-Report (R2R) processes.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience supporting SAP ECC to SAP S/4HANA migrations using process mining insights.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a remote environment.

f8b4ed53.title: Cloud Migration Engineer
f8b4ed53.description:
**Project Role :**
Cloud Migration Engineer
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Provides assessment of existing solutions and infrastructure to migrate to the cloud. Plan, deliver, and implement application and data migration with scalable, high-performance solutions using private and public cloud technologies driving next-generation business outcomes.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Infrastructure As Code (IaC)
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
Equivalent education
  
  
**Summary**
As a Cloud Migration Engineer, a typical day involves evaluating current infrastructure and solutions to determine the best approach for transitioning to cloud environments. This role includes planning and executing the migration of applications and data, ensuring that the solutions implemented are scalable and high-performing. The position requires coordinating with various stakeholders to align migration strategies with business goals, while continuously monitoring progress and addressing any challenges that arise during the migration process. The engineer plays a key role in enabling organizations to leverage both private and public cloud technologies to achieve advanced business outcomes.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Expected to be an SME, collaborate and manage the team to perform.
* Responsible for team decisions.
* Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
* Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
* Lead the development and implementation of cloud migration strategies to ensure seamless transition.
* Facilitate communication and coordination between cross-functional teams to optimize migration efforts.
* Monitor migration progress and proactively identify risks or issues, proposing effective mitigation plans.

**Professional & Technical Skills**

* Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Infrastructure As Code (IaC).
* Experience with cloud platforms and automation tools related to Infrastructure As Code.
* Strong knowledge of cloud architecture principles and best practices for migration.
* Ability to design scalable and secure cloud infrastructure using Infrastructure As Code methodologies.
* Familiarity with scripting and configuration management to automate deployment processes.
* Understanding of network, storage, and security considerations in cloud environments.

**Additional Information**

* The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Infrastructure As Code (IaC).
* This position is based at our Gurugram office.
* Equivalent education is required.

e48524af.title: DevOps Architect
e48524af.description:
**Project Role :**
DevOps Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Assess, design, and engineer DevOps solutions in complex technology environments. Design and build DevOps technical solutions for cloud-native, cloud-enabled, and on-prem infrastructure with microservices or traditional application patterns.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Cloud Automation DevOps
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 7.5 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
**Summary**
We re looking for a Infrastructure Auotmation and DevOps Engineer who combines software development expertise with strong DevOps and cloud infrastructure skills. You ll be responsible for designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining scalable web applications while implementing CI/CD pipelines, automating infrastructure, and ensuring high system reliability and performance. You ll work closely with developers, QA engineers, and operations teams to streamline deployment processes and enhance development workflows.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
IaC Development
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain Infrastructure Automation using IaC principals and DevOps Skills.
* Develop Predictive automation using Monitoring and Observability tools.

DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure
  
  

* Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or CircleCI.
* Manage infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible, Pulumi and CrossPlane.
* Deploy and monitor applications in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Set up automated monitoring, logging, and alerting (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Datadog).
* Enhance system reliability, security, and scalability through automation and best practices.

Operations & Collaboration
  
  

* Participate in code reviews and DevOps strategy discussions.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues with a focus on uptime and performance.
* Implement security best practices and assist with compliance standards.
* Mentor junior developers and contribute to improving development workflows.

**Professional & Technical Skills**
DevOps & Automation Tools
  
  

* CI/CD Pipelines: Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI, Travis CI, ArgoCD
* Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Terraform, Ansible, AWS CloudFormation, Pulumi
* Configuration Management: Chef, Puppet, Ansible, SaltStack
* Monitoring & observability: Splunk, DataDog, Prometheus.

Cloud & Infrastructure
  
  

* Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
* Compute & Networking: EC2, Lambda, VPC, Load Balancers, Route 53, DNS, VPNs
* Storage & Databases: S3, RDS, DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB
* Containerization: Docker, Podman
* Container Orchestration: Kubernetes (K8s), Helm, OpenShift

System Administration & Networking
  
  

* Operating Systems: Linux (Ubuntu, CentOS, Alpine), Bash scripting, basic Windows Server knowledge
* Networking Fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, SSL/TLS, HTTP/HTTPS, VPN, firewalls
* Security & Compliance: IAM, Secrets Management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager), SSH, encryption, vulnerability scanning

Observability & Incident Response
  
  

* Monitoring: Application and system performance metrics
* Alerting & Incident Management: PagerDuty, Opsgenie, Slack integrations
* Logging: Centralized log management (ELK, Fluentd, Splunk)

Bonus / Emerging Skills
  
  

* Serverless architectures (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions)
* GitOps (Flux, ArgoCD)
* AIOps and observability automation
* SRE principles (Service Level Indicators/Objectives)

Cloud Observability Skills: Multi-cloud monitoring, Cloud cost optimization, Cloud performance analysis, Cloud-native troubleshooting, Cloud security observability
  
  
Tools: Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, Azure Application Insights, AWS CloudWatch, AWS X-Ray, GCP Operations Suite, Datadog Cloud Monitoring, Dynatrace Cloud Automation
  
  
Skills: Network flow analysis, Packet analytics, WAN observability, SD-WAN monitoring, Network performance management, Network anomaly detection
  
  
Tools: ThousandEyes, SolarWinds NPM, Cisco AppDynamics Network Monitoring, Riverbed
  
  
Observability: SCOM, SolarWinds, Datadog Infrastructure Monitoring, Dynatrace Infrastructure, VMware Aria Operations, Turbonomic
  
  
**Additional Information**

* Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
* Collaboration with developers, QA, and IT teams
* Understanding agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban)
* Continuous learning and adapting to new tools and cloud services
* Flexible to work in 24\*7 environment

574a40be.title: Enterprise Technology Architect
574a40be.description:
**Project Role :**
Enterprise Technology Architect
  
  
**Project Role Description :**
Architect complex end-to-end IT solutions across the enterprise. Apply the latest technology and industry expertise to create better products and experiences.
  
  
**Must have skills :**
Network Operations & Service Management
  
  
**Good to have skills :**
NA
  
  
**Minimum 15 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :**
15 years full time education
  
  
**Summary**
As a Network Architect, you will design, deploy and manage global enterprise networks, automation, observability, reliability engineering, and manage large-scale transformation programs. You will work within defined operating model and processes, implementing technology at the network level across data center, cloud and network areas. This role requires envisioning and articulating a clear and compelling architecture vision, establishing a target state for the enterprise, and developing a detailed transformation roadmap. The position demands continuous engagement with various stakeholders to ensure the architecture supports business objectives and adapts to evolving technological landscapes. The Network Architect plays a pivotal role in guiding the organization through complex changes by fostering innovation and ensuring cohesive integration across multiple domains.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
* Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
* Execution of the project setup (project scheduling, stakeholder analysis, risk assessment, etc.)
* Coordination of project resources.
* Project quality assurance.
* Monitoring of quality, time and costs in the project.
* Participation in project meetings and coordination.
* Advice and support of the responsible IT infrastructure managers or stakeholders of the client.
* Ensuring compliance with guidelines, e.g. documentation of the project.
* Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
* Ensure timely resolution of technical issues.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot and resolve system issues.
* Document troubleshooting steps and solutions for future reference.
* Provide training and guidance to junior team members.
* Stay updated on industry trends and best practices.

**Professional & Technical Skills**

* Mandatory Basic Networking skills : Routing & Switching, Firewalls, Data Center & Cloud Networking (AWS/Azure) (CCNA, JNCIA & Cloud equivalent)
* Must Have Skills (Minimum 3): Enterprise Network Management (Solarwinds, HP NNM,etc), Observability & AIOps (Splunk, Grafana, Dynatrace/AppDynamics), Network Automation, RCA, Incident & Problem Management
* Good to have Skills : Python, Ansible, Terraform, Git, REST APIs, CI/CD
* Good to have knowledge on Skills : Wireless, SDWAN, SDN
* Proficiency in designing and deployment of Network Management, Observability tools and Log Management. Customizing metrics/ alerts/ log analysis.
* Strong understanding of network management protocols and technologies.
* Knowledge of Network Reliability Engineering (NRE), SRE, SLI/SLO, Error Budgets preferred
* Knowledge of cloud computing concepts and platforms.
* Hands-on experience with troubleshooting hardware and software issues.

**Additional Information**

* Flexible to work in 24x7 rotational shifts, including weekend
* Excellent communication skills
