By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Principal Azure Platform Architect owns the technical design of the Azure Cloud platform, defining the reference architectures, patterns and standards that make solutions secure, scalable and consistent, and guiding engineering teams in applying them. The role provides design assurance across the Azure Cloud and Edge services, architects for reliability and resilience rather than treating them as later additions, and designs AI into the platform through reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and intelligent operations.

The role sets standards and assures designs; it does not build. Engineering delivery sits with the platform engineering teams, backlog order sits with the Product Owner, domain target architecture and the architecture team sit with the Platform Architecture Director, and enterprise-level standards sit with Enterprise Architecture. Solution designs for major cross-domain initiatives sit with the Solution Architect in Enterprise Architecture.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define reference architectures, patterns and standards for the platform, aligned to DPTF strategy and to enterprise architecture.
* Design AI into the platform, producing reference patterns for AI-assisted delivery and for intelligent, self-healing operations.
* Architect for reliability and resilience by design, so that platform SLOs and error budgets are achievable rather than aspirational.
* Provide design assurance and technical guidance to engineering teams, reviewing designs against the standards before build rather than after.
* Ensure platform solutions are secure and compliant, including GxP requirements where the platform supports regulated activity.
* Evaluate and introduce new technologies, measuring the result against architecture OKRs rather than adopting on vendor claim.
* Set architecture standards that supplier and managed-service solutions must meet, and assure their designs to the same bar as internal work.
* Partner with Enterprise Architecture and Information Security on standards, roadmaps and exceptions.
* Increase pattern reuse across the platform, tracking where teams have adopted a pattern and where they have diverged and why.
* Reduce rework by intervening early in design, and evidence the reduction rather than asserting it.
* Advise the Product Owner and Platform Manager on the architectural consequence of roadmap choices, including technical debt being accepted.
* Hold the boundaries with the Platform Architecture Director on domain target architecture, the Solution Architect on cross-domain initiative designs, and the engineering teams on build.

**Professional Qualifications**

* Degree in a technology or engineering discipline, or equivalent practical experience (e.g., Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems).
* Architecture certifications desirable (e.g., TOGAF, or recognised cloud or network architecture certification relevant to the platform).

**Area of Specialisation**

* Platform architecture in the relevant domain, covering reference architecture, patterns, standards and design assurance.
* Security and resilience by design, including AI reference patterns and GxP considerations where applicable.

**Related Experience Required**

* Overall 15 years and typically 6-8 years in technology architecture or senior engineering, including at least three years producing reference architectures or standards others build to.
* Proven experience as an Azure Cloud Architect
* Knowledge of networking, security, and compliance in cloud environments
* Experience deploying, configuring and managing services in Azure Cloud Platform including AI Services
* Experience running design assurance or architecture review, including declining designs that did not meet the standard.
* Track record of architecting for reliability and resilience, working to SLOs and error budgets.
* Experience designing secure and compliant solutions, ideally including GxP or another regulated context.
* Experience setting architecture standards that supplier or managed-service solutions had to meet.
* Awareness of AI reference patterns for assisted delivery and intelligent operations.

**Skills/Background**

* Ability to influence engineering teams without line authority, so that patterns are adopted rather than circumvented.
* Judgement about when to grant an architectural exception and when to hold the standard.
* Clear design documentation, since patterns are only reusable if others can follow them.
* Comfort challenging vendor claims and evaluating technology on measured outcome.
* Pragmatism about technical debt, making the cost visible rather than blocking delivery outright.
* Collaborative habit with Enterprise Architecture and Security, whose standards constrain the platform.

**Skills**

API Management, Automation Technology, Cloud Architectures, Cloud Financial Operations, Containerization, Database Management, Design Assurance, DevOps, Disaster Recovery (DR), Edge Computing, Infrastructure As Code (IaC), Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure Architecture, Networking Concepts, Performance Optimizations, Reference Architectures, Security Compliance, Serverless Computing, System Monitors, Virtualization

**Why GSK?**

**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

**Inclusion at GSK:**

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

**Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies**

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

**GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.**

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

5ec5337b.title: Cloud Migration Lead Engineer
5ec5337b.description:
**Req ID:** 395338
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Cloud Migration Lead Engineer to join our team in HR, Haryāna (IN-HR), India (IN).
  
  
Cloud Migration Engineer – AWS / Azure
  
  
**Experience:** 6+ years in IT infrastructure, including 2+ years of hands-on cloud migration or cloud infrastructure experience.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for hands-on Cloud Migration Engineers to execute enterprise workload migrations, primarily to AWS, with Microsoft Azure experience considered an advantage.
  
  
This is an execution-focused engineering position. The successful candidate must have practical experience migrating production servers or applications from on-premises or virtualized environments to public cloud platforms.
  
  
We are particularly interested in engineers with strong Windows/Linux infrastructure backgrounds who have participated directly in migration projects.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
•
  
  
Execute server and workload migrations from on-premises, VMware, and other cloud environments to AWS.
  
•
  
  
Configure and operate AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) and other migration tools.
  
•
  
  
Perform source server assessments, agent installation, replication configuration, and migration readiness checks.
  
•
  
  
Execute test migrations, validate replicated workloads, and troubleshoot migration issues.
  
•
  
  
Participate in migration wave planning and technical cutover preparation.
  
•
  
  
Perform production cutovers, post-migration validation, and hypercare activities.
  
•
  
  
Troubleshoot operating system, networking, storage, DNS, Active Directory, and application connectivity issues.
  
•
  
  
Support migration runbook creation, technical documentation, and rollback procedures.
  
•
  
  
Collaborate with Technical Leads, Cloud Foundation Engineers, and customer application owners.
  
•
  
  
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive migration activities and improve migration efficiency.
  
  
Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  
•
  
  
Hands-on experience migrating Windows and/or Linux servers to AWS or another public cloud.
  
•
  
  
Practical experience with AWS EC2, EBS, VPC, security groups, and basic IAM.
  
•
  
  
Experience with AWS MGN, Azure Migrate, VMware HCX, RiverMeadow, or comparable server migration technologies.
  
•
  
  
Strong Windows Server and/or Linux administration and troubleshooting experience.
  
•
  
  
Knowledge of VMware vSphere or similar virtualization technologies.
  
•
  
  
Understanding of DNS, TCP/IP, routing, firewalls, and basic network troubleshooting.
  
•
  
  
Familiarity with server replication, testing, cutover, rollback, and post-migration validation.
  
•
  
  
Experience troubleshooting infrastructure and operating system issues.
  
•
  
  
Ability to follow migration runbooks and execute production changes safely.
  
  
Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  
•
  
  
Microsoft Azure VM migration experience and Azure Migrate.
  
•
  
  
AWS Transform, RiverMeadow, CloudHedge, or other migration accelerators.
  
•
  
  
PowerShell, Bash, Python, or automation scripting.
  
•
  
  
Terraform, Ansible, or basic Infrastructure as Code experience.
  
•
  
  
Active Directory, Group Policy, and Windows infrastructure services.
  
•
  
  
SQL Server, Oracle, or other database migration exposure.
  
•
  
  
AWS networking, VPN, Direct Connect, or hybrid connectivity.
  
•
  
  
AWS IAM, cloud security, or operational monitoring.
  
•
  
  
Experience with application dependency mapping and migration discovery.
  
•
  
  
AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps Administrator, or equivalent certification.
  
  
Expected Outcomes
  
  
•
  
  
Independently execute assigned migration tasks and migration waves.
  
•
  
  
Deliver successful server migrations with minimal rework.
  
•
  
  
Identify and resolve replication, cutover, and post-migration issues.
  
•
  
  
Contribute to reusable migration procedures and automation.
  
•
  
  
Support predictable, repeatable, high-volume migration delivery.
  
  
**Critical selection criterion:** Candidates must demonstrate direct involvement in real server or workload migrations. General cloud operations, monitoring, or infrastructure support experience alone is insufficient.
  
  
About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience with software development in one or more programming languages (e.g., Python, C, C++, Java, JavaScript).
* 3 years of experience in technical leadership role; overseeing projects.
* 3 years of experience in a people management, supervision/team leadership role.

* Master's degree or PhD in Computer Science or related technical field.

-----------------

Like Google's own ambitions, the work of a Software Engineer goes beyond just Search. Software Engineering Managers have not only the technical expertise to take on and provide technical leadership to major projects, but also manage a team of Engineers. You not only optimize your own code but make sure Engineers are able to optimize theirs. As a Software Engineering Manager you manage your project goals, contribute to product strategy and help develop your team. Teams work all across the company, in areas such as information retrieval, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, distributed computing, large-scale system design, networking, security, data compression, user interface design; the list goes on and is growing every day. Operating with scale and speed, our exceptional software engineers are just getting started - and as a manager, you guide the way.  
  
With technical and leadership expertise, you manage engineers across multiple teams and locations, a large product budget and oversee the deployment of large-scale projects across multiple sites internationally.

  

We are seeking an experienced software engineering manager to build and lead a high-performance computing organization in India. This is a critical role that will contribute to enabling Compute/AI/ML/HPC workloads for our customers. In this role, you will communicate with multiple teams in various geographic locations to develop this expertise and deliver this time-to-market-sensitive program.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

--------------------

* Scale the team to develop the world's most performant and reliable compute and AI infra.
* Provide long-term vision to build VM performance to provide high computing VM families. Own end to end responsibility of enabling the technology to deliver these cutting edge VM families, ensuring their availability, reliability, and performance.
* Grow the team to expand new capabilities that extend beyond the immediate project.
* Set and communicate team priorities that support the broader organization's goals. Align strategy, processes, and decision-making across teams. Evolve the technical roadmap to meet anticipated future requirements and infrastructure needs.
* Design, guide and vet systems designs within the scope of the broader area to solve ambiguous problems. Review code developed by other engineers and provide feedback to ensure best practices (e.g., style guidelines, checking code in, accuracy, testability, and efficiency).

10003c79.title: Senior Principal - Portfolio Manager, Cloud Platforms
10003c79.description:
Business Introduction
  
  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
  
  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
  
  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The Portfolio Manager manages the Cloud & Hosting Platforms demand and portfolio of work, sequencing delivery against strategy, capacity and dependencies, and giving domain leaders a clear view of what is being delivered and when. The role runs lean portfolio management across Cloud, Edge and Modern Engineering platforms, steers with flow metrics and OKR progress rather than fixed plans, and tracks benefits realisation after delivery.
  
  
The role orchestrates rather than decides. It owns the portfolio process, the prioritisation framework, the reporting and the transparency, and it coaches and challenges on delivery discipline. Prioritisation calls, roadmap content and value commitments remain with the Platform Manager and the Product Owners. Enterprise portfolio consolidation sits with the Investment Planning & Performance Director, and domain cost and forecasting sit with the Tech Finance Manager.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Run lean portfolio management for the domain, managing incoming demand through a single route rather than several informal ones.
* Own the prioritisation framework the domain applies, so that decisions taken by the Platform Manager and Product Owners are made on a consistent basis.
* Sequence delivery against strategy, capacity and cross-platform dependencies, surfacing conflicts early enough to be resolved.
* Link every item of work in the portfolio to strategy and to domain OKRs, and track the outcome with a named metric.

* Experience managing demand intake and holding a single route against pressure to bypass it.
* Track record sequencing work against capacity and dependencies, and surfacing conflicts before they became delivery failures.
* Experience steering with flow metrics and OKR progress rather than percentage complete.
* Experience tracking benefits realisation after delivery, including where benefits did not materialise.

**Skills/Background**

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking a Payroll Transformation Solution Owner to lead the delivery and continuous improvement of enterprise payroll solutions. **Who You Are**
You have strong implementation experience in SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll, including responsibility for end-to-end delivery.You bring payroll implementation experience covering Germany, Portugal and South Africa, together with an understanding of country-specific statutory and payroll requirements.You have demonstrated leadership and people-management capability, including coaching, work allocation, performance support and delivery governance.You understand end-to-end payroll processes and their dependencies on Employee Central, Time and Attendance, Benefits, Finance and external service providers.You can manage stakeholders, negotiate effectively and support decisions within complex, multi-market environments.You can translate business needs into clear requirements and practical solution outcomes while maintaining appropriate controls and compliance.You have experience managing delivery partners and cross-functional teams through testing, cutover, go-live, stabilisation and continuous improvement.You are proficient in JIRA and have working knowledge of SAFe Agile or comparable delivery methodologies.You bring strong analytical, problem-solving, planning and risk-management skills.You hold a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Human Resources, Business, Finance or a related discipline.You have experience leading teams or managing a significant payroll solution or transformation workstream.You have worked within enterprise-scale, multi-country HR or payroll transformation programmes.

You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**
The opportunity to shape a multi-country payroll transformation and influence future-state payroll services.Ownership across the full solution lifecycle, including design, implementation, go-live, stabilisation and continuous improvement.Collaboration with payroll, HR, Finance and Technology specialists, market teams and implementation partners.Exposure to enterprise-scale SAP SuccessFactors Employee Central Payroll delivery in a complex international environment.The opportunity to lead teams, guide senior stakeholder decisions and deliver measurable improvements through standardisation and automation.

Advanced product ownership and backlog prioritisation within an enterprise payroll environment.Multi-country payroll solution design and statutory requirement management.Practical application of SAFe Agile, sprint planning and Program Increment planning.Enterprise payroll controls, integration governance, data quality and operational-readiness management.Cross-market stakeholder engagement and delivery-partner governance.Leadership across testing, cutover, go-live, early-life support and continuous improvement.Approaches for simplifying, standardising and automating global payroll services.

At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.

97cfc311.title: Senior Systems Engineer (Pre Sales)
97cfc311.description:
**Company Description**
Arista Networks is an industry leader in data-driven, client-to-cloud networking for large data center, campus and routing environments. Arista is a well-established and profitable company with over $9 billion in revenue. Arista’s award-winning platforms, ranging in Ethernet speeds up to 800G bits per second, redefine scalability, agility, and resilience. Arista is a founding member of the Ultra Ethernet consortium. We have shipped over 20 million cloud networking ports worldwide with CloudVision and EOS, an advanced network operating system. Arista is committed to open standards, and its products are available worldwide directly and through partners.
  
  
At Arista, we value the diversity of thought and perspectives each employee brings. We believe fostering an inclusive environment where individuals from various backgrounds and experiences feel welcome is essential for driving creativity and innovation.
  
  
Our commitment to excellence has earned us several prestigious awards, such as the Great Place to Work Survey for Best Engineering Team and Best Company for Diversity, Compensation, and Work-Life Balance. At Arista, we take pride in our track record of success and strive to maintain the highest quality and performance standards in everything we do.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Who You'll Work With**
When you join Arista as part of the Sales Engineering team, you're not just stepping into a role, you're becoming part of a team of industry experts and technical leaders. Typically reporting to the System Engineering Manager, you'll be working alongside some of the most skilled field engineers in the industry. Our team prides itself on not just understanding the technology but also the business impact and aligning our solutions with the larger goals of our clients. In collaboration with our Product Management and Software Development teams, you will play a pivotal role in steering product developments, offerings, and strategic direction to best serve our customers and prospects. Supported by the expertise of our world class Arista TAC, cutting-edge proof-of-concept resources, and support of the executive team, you are well-positioned to lead and innovate within the industry.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
We are experiencing tremendous growth and have an immediate need for a collaborative, self-motivated Senior Systems Engineer to partner with our Account teams to provide pre-sales technical systems engineering support for our enterprise/commercial customers in the Northern India area.
  
  

* The Systems Engineer is a critical component of the Arista Sales team with the key responsibility of acting as a trusted advisor for our customers to gather requirements and identify opportunities with existing and new customers.
* You will partner with the Arista Account Managers to understand customer pain points and conduct white board network architectural reviews in addition to conducting Arista product presentations of Arista’s Open Networking Data Centre and Cognitive Campus (including Wi-fi) networking solutions, CloudVision (Network Automation), Security (Network Detection & Response), Endpoint Security and Real-time Fabric Monitoring solutions.
* You will architect, design and propose Arista Data Centre & Campus network solutions using leaf-spine architectures (VxLAN, EVPN) and network overlays to capture additional sales.
* Perform hands-on tests to validate customer proof-of-concept setups, Data Centre and/or Campus network designs, and network deployments using new products and features
* Put together design guidelines and recommend improvements to customers for the networks they support
* Partner with Sales Team to respond to RFP/RFQs
* Provide feedback to Product Management and Engineering
* Represent Arista at SDN and Open Networking industry events and conferences
* Keep up-to-date on competitive solutions, products, and services
* Author white papers on technology and product.

**Qualifications**

* BE/BS/CS/CE technical degree required
* Network Industry Certification preferred (e.g. CCIE (R&S), JNCIE)
* You possess a minimum of 10+ years of L2/L3 networking design and implementation experience with a focus on Data Centre and Campus networks.
* You possess expert level expertise in routing and switching including L2/L3 protocols (Cisco, Juniper, Extreme, Aruba)
* Demonstrated work experience as either a Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Pre-Sales SE or Network Consulting Engineer preferred
* Previous experience with network overlays preferred.
* Expert knowledge in three or more of the following areas: Ethernet, RSTP/ MSTP, VLANs, IP Routing, TCP/IP, BGP, eBGP, VxLAN, EVPN, Multicast, Spanning Tree, QoS
* Expert-level knowledge of industry-standard CLI
* Experience with SDN and Network Function Virtualization (NFV) highly desired.
* Previous experience building network automation using Python and Ansible desired.
* Knowledge of competitive products, solutions, and services
* Ability to write white papers a plus.

**Additional Information**
Arista stands out as an engineering-centric company. Our leadership, including founders and engineering managers, are all engineers who understand sound software engineering principles and the importance of doing things right.
  
  
We hire globally into our diverse team. At Arista, engineers have complete ownership of their projects. Our management structure is flat and streamlined, and software engineering is led by those who understand it best. We prioritize the development and utilization of test automation tools.
  
  
Our engineers have access to every part of the company, providing opportunities to work across various domains. Arista is headquartered in Santa Clara, California, with development offices in Australia, Canada, India, Ireland, and the US. We consider all our R&D centers equal in stature.
  
  
Join us to shape the future of networking and be part of a culture that values invention, quality, respect, and fun.

ed4e6bf9.title: Mainframe SAS Architect
ed4e6bf9.description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a Mainframe SAS Architect at Kyndryl, you will lead the design and modernization of SAS solutions on IBM Mainframe platforms, helping clients transform and optimize their business-critical data environments. You will architect scalable and secure analytics solutions, drive performance and automation initiatives, and integrate SAS with core mainframe technologies such as DB2, IMS, VSAM, JCL, and COBOL.

  

Working closely with business and technical stakeholders, you will provide architectural guidance, ensure operational excellence, and support the delivery of reliable, high-performing enterprise solutions. You will also champion governance, security, and best practices while mentoring teams and leading modernization initiatives for some of the world's largest organizations.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Lead the architecture and design of SAS solutions on IBM Mainframe (z/OS) platforms.
* Drive modernization, automation, and performance improvement initiatives for SAS environments.
* Design integrations with DB2, IMS, VSAM, COBOL, and JCL to support enterprise data processing.
* Optimize batch workloads, scheduling, and production operations for reliability and efficiency.
* Ensure compliance with security, governance, and regulatory requirements.
Partner with business and technical teams to deliver scalable, business-critical analytics solutions.  

  

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here. You’ll also get the chance to share your expertise by recommending modernization options, identifying new business opportunities, and cultivating relationships with other teams and stakeholders. Does the work get challenging at times? Yes! But you’ll collaborate with a diverse group of talented people and gain invaluable management and organizational skills, which will come in handy as you move forward in your career.

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

  

**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

  

* 10+ years of hands-on experience in SAS development, administration, and production support environments.
* Strong expertise in IBM Mainframe technologies including z/OS, JCL, TSO/ISPF, SDSF, RACF, DB2, IMS, VSAM, and COBOL.
* Proven experience leading Mainframe architecture, technical solution design, and large-scale batch processing environments.
* Advanced knowledge of SAS technologies including Base SAS, SAS Macro, SAS SQL, SAS/ACCESS, Enterprise Guide, and SAS Management Console.
* Strong understanding of enterprise data architecture, ETL frameworks, data warehousing, governance, metadata management, and performance tuning.
* Strong expertise in IBM Mainframe technologies and SAS architecture.
Proven experience supporting large-scale batch processing environments.  

  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

  

* Experience with SAS Viya migration, platform modernization, and cloud integration initiatives.
* Exposure to Mainframe modernization programs, API enablement, and hybrid architecture solutions.
* Knowledge of automation technologies including Python, Shell Scripting, and Ansible.
* Experience integrating Mainframe-based data assets with cloud and enterprise analytics platforms.
Demonstrated leadership in production support, incident management, stakeholder engagement, risk management, and team mentoring.  

  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

c3a6d65d.title: Cloud Migration Lead Engineer
c3a6d65d.description:
**Req ID:** 395337
  
  
NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.
  
  
We are currently seeking a Cloud Migration Lead Engineer to join our team in BR, Bihār (IN-BR), India (IN).
  
  
Senior Cloud Migration Technical Lead
  
  
**Experience:** 10+ years in IT infrastructure and cloud technologies, including 5+ years in cloud migration delivery.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Cloud Migration Technical Lead to lead enterprise migration engagements, primarily to AWS, with Microsoft Azure experience considered a strong advantage.
  
  
The successful candidate must combine hands-on technical expertise with the ability to lead migration teams, own technical decisions, manage customer expectations, and deliver migrations from discovery through cutover and hypercare.
  
  
This is a delivery-focused technical leadership role, not a pure solution architecture, consulting, or project management position.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
•
  
  
Own the technical delivery of cloud migration projects, from discovery and assessment through planning, execution, cutover, and stabilization.
  
•
  
  
Design and validate migration strategies for VMware, physical and virtual servers, Windows/Linux workloads, and enterprise applications.
  
•
  
  
Lead application dependency assessments, migration wave planning, sequencing, rollback planning, and technical risk management.
  
•
  
  
Define workload migration approaches, including rehost, replatform, and selective modernization.
  
•
  
  
Lead technical discussions with customers and coordinate Cloud Foundation, Migration Execution, Networking, Security, and application teams.
  
•
  
  
Review AWS Landing Zone readiness, connectivity, IAM, networking, security, and operational requirements.
  
•
  
  
Troubleshoot complex migration failures and support critical production cutovers.
  
•
  
  
Act as the customer-facing technical anchor across multiple delivery PODs.
  
•
  
  
Maintain architecture decisions, migration runbooks, technical documentation, and stage-gate acceptance criteria.
  
•
  
  
Mentor engineers, validate technical estimates, and improve migration automation and repeatability.
  
  
Mandatory Technical Skills
  
  
•
  
  
Demonstrated hands-on experience leading production migrations to AWS, preferably across multiple enterprise customers.
  
•
  
  
**Strong AWS infrastructure expertise:** EC2, EBS, VPC, IAM, Route 53, CloudWatch, AWS Backup, and related services.
  
•
  
  
Practical experience with AWS Application Migration Service (MGN) and workload migration tooling.
  
•
  
  
Strong knowledge of VMware vSphere, Windows Server, Linux, DNS, Active Directory, storage, and networking.
  
•
  
  
Experience with migration discovery, dependency mapping, migration wave planning, testing, and rollback strategies.
  
•
  
  
Ability to diagnose connectivity, performance, replication, operating system, and application-related migration issues.
  
•
  
  
Understanding of AWS security, hybrid connectivity, IAM, routing, and network segmentation.
  
•
  
  
Experience leading engineers and communicating technical risks to customers and stakeholders.
  
  
Nice-to-Have Skills
  
  
•
  
  
Microsoft Azure migration experience, including Azure Migrate and Azure Site Recovery.
  
•
  
  
AWS Transform, RiverMeadow, CloudHedge, or comparable migration accelerators.
  
•
  
  
Azure VMware Solution (AVS), VMware HCX, or NSX.
  
•
  
  
Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, or CI/CD automation.
  
•
  
  
AWS Direct Connect, Azure ExpressRoute, VPN, firewalls, and advanced hybrid networking.
  
•
  
  
Database migrations using AWS DMS or native database migration technologies.
  
•
  
  
Experience with regulated environments, security compliance, or complex enterprise transformations.
  
•
  
  
AWS Solutions Architect Professional or AWS Certified Advanced Networking certification.
  
  
Expected Outcomes
  
  
•
  
  
Independently lead customer migration engagements with minimal technical supervision.
  
•
  
  
Coordinate delivery across shared PODs without losing customer context or technical accountability.
  
•
  
  
Reduce migration failures, technical escalations, and cutover risks.
  
•
  
  
Improve migration repeatability, delivery quality, and engineering productivity.
  
  
**Critical selection criterion:** Candidates must demonstrate real production migration experience, including examples of migration challenges, failures, cutovers, and lessons learned.
  
  
About NTT DATA
  
  
NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in RD.
  
  
Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.

8f0d9e77.title: Senior Partner Platform Architect
8f0d9e77.description:
**Job Description**
**About Us:**
Zendesk is a leader in customer experience solutions, dedicated to delivering innovative technology and exceptional service. Our Contact Center Center of Excellence (CoE) focuses on optimizing customer support platforms, including Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS-based solutions, to enhance customer interactions and operational efficiency.
  
  
**Position Overview**
We are seeking a seasoned Contact Center Partner Solutions Consultant with deep expertise in contact center technologies and CX Suites—preferably Zendesk, Amazon Connect, and AWS—with a strong focus on partner onboarding, technical enablement, and co-selling support. This role will lead partner technical enablement efforts, ensuring partners are fully equipped and supported to resell and implement Zendesk Contact Center solutions effectively. The ideal candidate will provide strategic direction, technical leadership, and hands-on expertise to drive partner success and seamless integration of contact center solutions.
  
  
**Core Daily Activities**

* Partner Onboarding and Enablement: Drive the technical onboarding process for partners, ensuring they acquire the skills and knowledge necessary to successfully implement and resell Zendesk Contact Center solutions.
* Co-Sell Technical Support: Collaborate closely with partners during co-sell engagements, providing expert technical guidance and solving complex implementation challenges.
* Architect and Optimize Contact Center Solutions: Design scalable and efficient architectures leveraging Amazon Connect, AWS, and Zendesk to support partner deployments.
* Lead Technical Strategy and Partner Roadmap: Define technical enablement strategies aligned with partner needs and evolving business goals.
* Provide Technical Leadership and Mentorship: Coach partners, internal teams, and presales specialists on best practices in solution design and deployment.
* Drive Innovation and Emerging Technology Adoption: Stay updated on AI, ML, and automation trends in contact centers to continuously improve partner technical capabilities.
* Support Pre-Sales and Post-Sales Activities with Partners: Support technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, PoCs, and ongoing partner support.
* Develop Enablement Materials: Create technical documentation, playbooks, and training content tailored for partner consumption.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner Success Focus: Own the technical onboarding and enablement process for partners, reducing onboarding friction and accelerating time to market.
* Strategic Leadership: Define and execute the architectural vision for partner-facing contact center solutions within the CoE framework.
* Technical Oversight: Support and guide partners and internal teams to adhere to architectural best practices, security standards, and delivery excellence.
* Collaboration: Work with partner sales leads, sales, and engineering teams to align on technical requirements, scope, and co-sell strategies.
* Innovation Advocacy: Promote adoption of the latest contact center technologies and best practices with partners.
* Governance and Compliance: Ensure partner solutions meet compliance, security, and governance requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or Business Administration.
* Experience: Minimum of 10 years in solution architecture, with at least 5 years focused on contact center technologies including Amazon Connect and Zendesk, with partner-facing or customer enablement experience preferred.
* Technical Expertise: Proficient designing solutions using Zendesk, Amazon Connect, AWS services (Lambda, Lex, IAM, DynamoDB, S3, API Gateway). Experience with Python and/or NodeJS is a plus.
* Enablement Skills: Demonstrated ability to deliver technical training and enablement to partners or customers.
* Leadership: Experience leading technical engagements involving multiple stakeholders including partners, internal teams, and vendors.
* Communication: Exceptional verbal and written skills with the ability to translate complex technical information for diverse audiences.
* Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills and ability to devise creative technical solutions in partner-centric contexts.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Certifications: Zendesk certifications, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or equivalent.
* Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with omnichannel contact center solutions, AI-driven automation, workforce engagement management, and reporting tools.
* Agile Experience: Working knowledge of Agile and DevOps methodologies.

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.
  
  
Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration - while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.
  
  
**The Intelligent Heart Of Customer Experience**
Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.
  
  
Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.
  
  
As part of our commitment to fairness and transparency, we inform all applicants that artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision systems may be used to screen or evaluate applications for this position, in accordance with Company guidelines and applicable law.
  
  
Zendesk is an equal opportunity employer, and we’re proud of our ongoing efforts to foster global diversity, equity, & inclusion in the workplace. Individuals seeking employment and employees at Zendesk are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition, ancestry, disability, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an AA/EEO/Veterans/Disabled employer. If you are based in the United States and would like more information about your EEO rights under the law, please click here.
  
  
Zendesk endeavors to make reasonable accommodations for applicants with disabilities and disabled veterans pursuant to applicable federal and state law. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to submit this application, complete any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participate in the employee selection process, please send an e-mail to peopleandplaces@zendesk.com with your specific accommodation request.

Our

9d60df2c.description:
**We're Hiring: AWS Cloud Engineer**

  

**Company:** Jnanasethu IT Labs Private Limited  
**Job Title:** AWS Cloud Engineer  
**Location:** Bengaluru, Karnataka, India  
**Experience:** 58 Years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Work Mode:** 100% On-site  
**Department:** Cloud Engineering & DevOps

  

**About the Role**

Jnanasethu IT Labs Private Limited is looking for an experienced **AWS Cloud Engineer** with strong hands-on expertise in cloud infrastructure, architecture, automation, and DevOps practices.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and managing scalable, highly available AWS cloud environments. The role requires practical experience with AWS services, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD automation, containerization, cloud security, and infrastructure monitoring.

If you are passionate about cloud technologies, automation, and building reliable cloud infrastructure, we would love to hear from you!

Key Responsibilities

* Design, deploy, and manage scalable, secure, and highly available AWS cloud infrastructure.
* Configure and manage AWS services, including EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, RDS, Lambda, Route 53, Elastic Load Balancing, Auto Scaling, and CloudWatch.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and configuration using Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.
* Develop, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodePipeline.
* Deploy and manage containerized applications using Docker, Kubernetes, Amazon ECS, and Amazon EKS.
* Implement cloud security best practices, access controls, and IAM policies.
* Monitor cloud infrastructure, troubleshoot production issues, and optimize system performance.
* Implement backup, disaster recovery, high availability, and business continuity strategies.
* Monitor cloud resource utilization and implement cost optimization measures.
* Work with Linux systems, cloud networking, and scripting for infrastructure automation.
* Collaborate with development, DevOps, and security teams to deliver reliable cloud solutions.
* Maintain infrastructure documentation and follow cloud governance and operational best practices.

  

**Required Technical Skills**

**1. AWS Cloud Services**

* Strong hands-on experience with AWS cloud infrastructure and architecture.
* Proficiency in EC2, S3, VPC, IAM, RDS, Lambda, Route 53, ELB, Auto Scaling, and CloudWatch.
* Understanding of high availability, scalability, fault tolerance, and cloud networking.

**2. Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**

* Experience with Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.
* Knowledge of automated infrastructure provisioning and configuration management.

**3. DevOps & CI/CD**

* Experience developing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
* Familiarity with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodePipeline.
* Understanding of version control, deployment automation, and DevOps methodologies.

**4. Containers & Orchestration**

* Hands-on experience with Docker.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes, Amazon ECS, and Amazon EKS.
* Understanding of container deployment, scaling, and management.

**5. Linux, Networking & Scripting**

* Working knowledge of Linux administration.
* Understanding of networking concepts, including DNS, routing, firewalls, and load balancing.
* Experience with scripting languages such as Python, Bash, or Shell.

**6. Cloud Security & Monitoring**

* Knowledge of IAM, access management, cloud security, and compliance best practices.
* Experience with infrastructure monitoring, logging, alerting, and troubleshooting.
* Understanding of backup, disaster recovery, and cloud cost optimization.

  

**Preferred Certifications**

* AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate or Professional.
* AWS Certified DevOps Engineer Professional.
* Other relevant AWS or cloud certifications will be an advantage.

  

**Eligibility Criteria**

* 5–8 years of relevant experience in AWS Cloud Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, or DevOps.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience designing, deploying, and managing AWS environments.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional technical teams.
* Good communication skills and a proactive approach to resolving technical challenges.

  
  

**Join Jnanasethu IT Labs Private Limited and help build secure, scalable, and future-ready cloud infrastructure solutions!**

0a9b63a6.title: Service Delivery Manager
0a9b63a6.description:
We are hiring a hands-on **Service Delivery Manager** to run day-to-day production support for our Big Data and data integration platforms. You will lead a support pod of L1/L2/L3 engineers, act as incident commander for critical outages, own SLA delivery, and drive the automation agenda that removes recurring manual work.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Incident & Problem Management**

* Act as incident commander for P1/P2 production outages drive triage bridges, coordinate cross-team resolution, and manage business communication until service restoration.
* Own and deliver Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation within agreed SLAs; track corrective and preventive actions to closure.
* Run problem management for recurring issues; convert known errors into permanent fixes rather than repeated workarounds.

**SLA & Metric Governance**

* Track, report, and enforce response and resolution SLAs across the ticket queue; manage backlog, ageing, and breach risk proactively.
* Publish weekly and monthly KPI packs MTTR, MTTD, SLA compliance, ticket volume and trend, availability, automation savings to leadership.
* Own the operational review cadence with business and technology stakeholders.

**People & Team Leadership**

* Manage 16/7 or 24/7 rotational support rosters, shift handovers, on-call schedules, and holiday coverage.
* Mentor and coach support engineers; build technical depth and runbook discipline across the team.
* Conduct performance reviews, goal setting, and development planning; participate actively in interviewing, hiring, and onboarding.

**Automation & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify high-frequency, high-effort manual tasks and replace them with automation scripts, self-healing routines, and auto-remediation.
* Improve monitoring and alerting frameworks to shift from reactive to predictive detection; reduce alert noise and false positives.
* Maintain and continually improve runbooks, knowledge base articles, and standard operating procedures.

**Cross-Team Collaboration**

* Partner with software engineering, DevOps, and product teams to review upcoming deployments and assess release readiness.
* Represent support in CAB and change approval forums; enforce operational readiness criteria before production releases.
* Feed stability pain points, defect trends, and supportability gaps back into the development backlog.

  

**Must Have**

* Hands-on experience supporting **Hadoop** ecosystem components (HDFS, Hive, Spark, YARN, Sqoop, Oozie).
* Working experience with **IBM InfoSphere DataStage** — job design, scheduling, failure triage, and performance troubleshooting.
* Strong **Splunk** skills — building queries, dashboards, and alerts for log analysis and monitoring.
* Strong **SQL** for data validation, reconciliation, and issue investigation.
* Scripting/programming in **Python**, **Java**, or Shell for automation and tooling.
* ITIL-based Incident, Problem, and Change Management; ServiceNow or JIRA.
* Linux/Unix fundamentals and job scheduling tools (Control-M, Autosys, Airflow).

  

**Good to Have**

* Cloud data platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), Databricks, or Snowflake.
* CI/CD and DevOps tooling exposure (Jenkins, Git, Ansible).
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification.

ffddf3f4.description:
**Description**
Fulfillment by Amazon (FBA) enables millions of sellers worldwide to leverage Amazon's world-class fulfillment network — from storage and pick-pack-ship to customer service and returns. FBA Support Operations (S-Ops) is the team that ensures sellers receive best-in-class support throughout their FBA journey. We manage end-to-end seller support across multiple FBA programs, drive contact elimination through automation and process improvement, and continuously raise the bar on seller experience. Our mission is to make every seller interaction effortless — and where possible, eliminate the need for sellers to contact us at all.
  
  
The FBA S-Ops org is looking for a Program Manager who will launch and scale new seller engagement use cases, improve seller engagement ops efficiency, and drive Voice of Seller (VoS) solutions to close seller experience gaps. In this role, you will own the end-to-end program lifecycle from intake to launch, surface seller pain points through data-driven root-cause analysis, and partner cross-functionally to implement preventative fixes. You'll lead as a voice of the sellers for internal teams to ensure the right bar for seller experience, and systemic root cause fixes are in place to avoid recurring issues for our sellers.
  
  
Successful candidates will have experience with Program Management in a broad, global organization, have experience working with a variety of cross-organizational stakeholders, and be able to juggle competing priorities. We are looking for someone who is detail-driven, can create processes from scratch, has good problem solving and deep dive abilities. Ability to navigate ambiguous programs while keeping a high bar on quality of outputs is a must.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Own end-to-end program lifecycle for new seller engagement use cases: intake, assessment, design, change management, launch, and BAU integration across multiple FBA programs
  
  
Establish SOP's which promote the adoption of appropriate solutions and sustainability of desired results in complex operational environments and large scale launches
  
  
Partner with WW FBA teams to prioritize and execute new use cases; coordinate across Capacity Planning, WFM, Training, SOP, and Seller Engagement Ops teams for seamless launches
  
  
Work with product managers and leaders to ensure that strategies scale, and make smart trade-offs (e.g., short- vs. long-term needs). Identify gaps between teams, processes and plans, and demonstrate good judgment in how and when to escalate
  
  
Own the VoS pipeline end-to-end: intake seller pain points, develop clear and concise root-cause analysis (RCA) and write-ups, implement solutions with cross-functional owners, and measure impact
  
  
Identify and close SX gaps through data-driven insights and cross-functional partnership with Product, Tech, and Policy teams
  
  
Drive ops efficiency improvements — reducing waste, improving throughput, and optimizing seller engagement resource allocation
  
  
Serve as escalation point for seller issues: own investigations to identify root-causes, drive resolution, identify preventative solutions with cross-functional business owners, and track progress through closure
  
  
Deliver measurable improvements across key ops and SX metrics
  
  
Collaborate and build relationships with cross functional teams to ensure seamless execution and process excellence
  
  
**About The Team**
We are open to hiring candidates to work out of one of the following locations:
  
  
Bangalore, KA, IND
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of program or project management experience
* 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. 7d94d438.description:

Atlassian is seeking an exceptional Solutions Engineer who is passionate about addressing complex customer challenges and securing significant enterprise deals. In this role, you will collaborate closely with the enterprise sales team and regional channel partners to gain a deep understanding of our customers' needs. You will strategize on navigating various scenarios, deliver compelling demonstrations, and ultimately drive business closure. Your expertise will be crucial in ensuring that our solutions effectively meet the demands of our clients, contributing to their success and the growth of Atlassian.
  
  
**Your future team**
With over 300,000 customers worldwide, Atlassian is helping organisations like NASA, IBM, Hubspot, Samsung and Coca-Cola advance humanity through the power of incredible software that unleashes the potential of every team.
  
  
With a focus on value selling, we help our customers understand how our products combine to create enterprise solutions that transform their business’s outcomes. We’re different from other organisations because we approach everything we do using our value of ‘play as a team'. We support each other, celebrate our wins together and share knowledge. Our employees work with Atlassian, not for Atlassian.
  
  
Our team enjoys high earnings potential with the enterprise white space opportunity ahead of us, selling impactful products that are at the forefront of cloud and artificial intelligence utilization.

At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent.

* Deep knowledge of Atlassian’s product suite and ability to articulate its value in solving complex business challenges.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.

40c5c3d9.title: Presales Consultant
40c5c3d9.location: Mumbai, Mumbai Suburban, Navi Mumbai, India
40c5c3d9.description:
**About Fynd**

**Fynd is a frontier technology company. We started at the intersection of technology and retail because that is where technology was the least available. Over the years, we became one of Indias largest retail technology platforms. But retail was the entry point, not the boundary.**

  

**Today, Fynd builds intelligent software that runs business operations. Not tools that help people work faster, but systems that absorb entire functions: manufacturing, marketing, logistics, commerce, quality control. We sit inside our customers’ businesses, harvest deep domain context, and build AI systems that operate autonomously. We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare.**

**Role Overview**

**Fynd is a frontier technology company. We started at the intersection of technology and retail because that is where technology was the least available. Over the years, we became one of India’s largest retail technology platforms. But retail was the entry point, not the boundary.Today, Fynd builds intelligent software that runs business operations. Not tools that help people work faster, but systems that absorb entire functions: manufacturing, marketing, logistics, commerce, quality control. We sit inside our customers’ businesses, harvest deep domain context, and build AI systems that operate autonomously. We are expanding from retail into manufacturing, generative media, physical AI, and healthcare.**

  

**Responsibilities**

**You own a Fynd TMS customer end to end - from the first solution discussion in the sales cycle, through design and go-live, and then as the person accountable for that account running well and growing.**

**Fynd TMS sells into enterprise retail, distribution and 3PL operations where no two logistics networks look alike. Deals are won on whether we can credibly map a customer's dispatch reality - hubs, zones, rate cards, fleet mix, SLAs, COD, returns - onto the product, and then actually deliver it.**

**Join sales conversations as the product and logistics authority: run discovery on the customer's current dispatch flow, systems landscape and pain points.**

**Build and deliver tailored demos and pilots - not the generic deck, but the customer's own network configured in the product.**

**Own the solution narrative in RFPs, RFIs and proposals; write the solution and scope sections of the SOW.**

**Do gap analysis between customer requirements and current product capability. Decide what is configuration, what is customization, and what is a genuine "no" - and say so early.**

**Size effort and feasibility with engineering before commitments are made, so we don't sell what we can't ship.**

**Run implementation as a project: plan, milestones, RACI, weekly governance with the client.**

**Configure and validate masters - hubs, zones, service areas, rate cards, SLA/TAT rules, vehicle and rider profiles, route optimization parameters.**

**Coordinate integrations with the client's OMS/ERP/WMS and any carrier or 3PL partners; test APIs and webhooks yourself before handing them to the client.**

**Drive data migration, UAT, pilot rollout at a single hub or store cluster, and on-ground training for supervisors, dispatchers and riders.**

**Run hypercare through go-live and stabilization; sit in the control room on day one if that's what it takes.**

**Own adoption and health: are trips actually being planned in the system, is the rider app being used, is EPOD capture clean, are dashboards being looked at.**

**Run monthly and quarterly reviews with the client, tied to their metrics - cost per delivery, vehicle utilization, on-time performance, planning time saved.**

**Be the escalation path for issues; coordinate resolution with support and engineering and close the loop with the client.**

**Spot and drive expansion: new hubs, new geographies, additional modules, additional business units. Own renewal readiness.**

**Feed structured, prioritized product feedback back into the roadmap.**

**Someone who wants a pure sales quota role with no delivery accountability.**

**Someone who wants a pure project management role with no client-facing commercial exposure.**

**Someone who needs a fully documented product and a settled process to work inside.**

**Qualifications**

**Required**

**4–8 years in presales, solution consulting, implementation, or customer success - in logistics technology, supply chain SaaS, or enterprise B2B SaaS sold to operations teams.**

**Working knowledge of at least one of: transportation management, last-mile/mid-mile delivery, dispatch planning, route optimization, fleet operations, or 3PL/carrier operations.**

**Demonstrated ownership of an enterprise implementation from kickoff to go-live - you can walk us through one in detail, including what went wrong.**

**Technical fluency without being an engineer: comfortable with APIs and Postman, reading JSON, basic SQL, Excel modelling. You can debug a bad integration payload well enough to know whose problem it is.**

**Strong verbal and written communication. Requirement docs, review decks and client emails are a large part of this job.**

**Willing to be on the ground - warehouses, hubs, and client offices, not only on calls.**

**Preferred**

**Experience with TMS, WMS, OMS or route-optimization products (Shipsy, LogiNext, FarEye, Locus, Bringg, Blue Yonder, Oracle OTM, or in-house platforms at Delhivery, Ecom Express, Shadowfax, Porter, Zypp and similar).**

**Exposure to retail, quick commerce, FMCG distribution, or enterprise logistics buyers.**

**Comfort with route-optimization concepts - constraints, capacity, time windows, solver behaviour.**

**What do we offer?**

**Growth**

**At Fynd, growth is limitless. We nurture a culture that encourages innovation, embraces challenges, and supports continuous learning. As we expand into new product lines and global markets, we're seeking talented individuals eager to grow with us.**

  

**We believe in empowering our people to take ownership, lead with confidence, and shape their careers.**

  

**Learning Wallet: Enrol in external courses or certifications to upskill—we'll reimburse the costs to support your development.**

**Culture**

**We believe in building strong teams and lasting connections.**

**- Regular community engagement and team-building activities**

**- Biannual events to celebrate achievements, foster collaboration, and strengthen our workplace culture**

**Wellness**

**Your well-being is our priority. Comprehensive Mediclaim policy for you, your spouse, children, and parents.**

**Work Environment**

**We thrive on collaboration and creativity. Our teams work from the office five days a week to encourage open communication, teamwork, and innovation.**

**Join us to be part of a dynamic environment where your ideas make an impact!**

--------------------

Our department is on a bold journey — transforming and modernizing our IT landscape to enable Volvo’s vision of becoming a fully agile, data-driven company. With strong investments, cutting-edge technologies, and a shared mindset for continuous improvement, we’re creating the digital foundations that will power tomorrow’s production and distribution systems.

We’re reimagining end-to-end processes, driving transformation, and unlocking the full potential of data to shape smarter, more efficient, and more sustainable operations. Our environment is international, multicultural, and full of opportunities to grow — both personally and professionally.  
Our technology stack is diverse and future-oriented, built on a solid mix of COTS and SaaS solutions that we continuously evolve to meet the demands of the next generation of manufacturing.

**Who are you?**

* 12+ years of experience in the **end-to-end Finance module (AR,AP,GL,Service Billing,India Localization)** processes is a strong advantage, as is familiarity with **ERP(JD Edward) or COTS systems supporting business-critical operations.**

* As a Requirement Solution Engineer, you act as the vital link between our business and development teams. You capture what the business truly needs — and why — translating it into solutions that bring measurable value.

Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join **Volvo Group**. 72db1953.title: Solutions Architect- AI
72db1953.description:
USEReady is a global analytics and data management solutions company that helps enterprises harness the power of data to drive smarter decisions. With a strong presence across North America, USEReady partners with Fortune 500 companies to deliver end-to-end analytics, BI, data engineering, and AI/ML solutions. Our Bangalore office serves as a key hub for our finance, technology, and delivery operations.

**Experience:**
12+ years

**Focus:**
GenAI and agentic solutions presales

**About the Role**

Own technical solutioning for AI and agentic pursuits. Qualify what is real, kill what is not, and design systems that survive contact with enterprise constraints.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Lead AI discovery workshops — separating use cases with genuine ROI from ones that sound impressive and will not clear procurement.

• Design GenAI and agentic solutions end to end: retrieval architecture, agent orchestration, tool and MCP integration, human-in-the-loop design, and evaluation strategy.

• Define accuracy and performance targets in proposals, and define how they will be measured. Ambiguous success criteria are the single biggest source of fixed-price pain.

• Own the technical response for AI pursuits: architecture, estimates, model and platform selection, and total cost of ownership.

• Build demos and PoCs against client-representative data, including synthetic data approaches where client environments are not available.

• Address enterprise concerns directly — data residency, PII handling, model governance, auditability, and alignment to NIST AI RMF or ISO 42001 where clients require it.

• Advise clients on where agents genuinely outperform deterministic pipelines, and where they do not.

**Required Skills & Experience**

• 12+ years in software, data, or ML, with 3+ years building or architecting production LLM-based systems.

• Practical depth in RAG architectures, agent frameworks, prompt and context engineering, and evaluation methodology — you know why systems fail in production, not just how to demo them.

• Familiarity with the major model providers and the tradeoffs between them on cost, latency, and reasoning quality.

• Grounding in the underlying data layer — able to tell when an AI use case is really a data readiness problem.

• Credible with a skeptical CIO and a security review board, not just an innovation team.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.

**Nice to Have**

• Oil & Gas, manufacturing, or financial services domain experience.

• Exposure to AI governance frameworks (NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, EU AI Act).

• Experience in a consulting or systems-integrator environment.
