81f27b55.title: Network Architect
81f27b55.description:
Candescent is a forward-thinking technology company transforming how financial institutions deliver Intelligent Banking experiences. We unite digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions that power and connect digital banking, account opening, and branch solutions—creating seamless engagement across digital, remote, and in-person channels.

Our Experience-Led, Intelligence-Driven approach combines human-centered design with data, automation, and cloud-based innovation. Built on an API-first architecture, our extensible ecosystem enables institutions to adapt quickly, integrate easily, and unlock new opportunities for growth—turning every customer interaction into a moment of clarity, confidence, and connection.

**Position Summary**

Candescent is seeking an experienced and innovative **Network Architect** to lead the design, strategy, and evolution of our enterprise network infrastructure. This role is responsible for developing scalable, secure, and resilient network architectures that support corporate offices, cloud environments, financial institution operations, and emerging business initiatives.

The Network Architect will partner closely with Infrastructure, Security, Cloud Engineering, Application Development, and Operations teams to define technology roadmaps, establish engineering standards, and drive modernization initiatives. This position serves as the highest level of technical authority for enterprise networking and provides guidance for complex projects, strategic investments, and operational excellence.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Enterprise Network Architecture**

* Develop and maintain the enterprise network architecture roadmap.
* Design highly available, scalable, and secure LAN, WAN, WLAN, SD-WAN, Cloud and B2B Networking and internet edge solutions.
* Create and maintain high-level and low-level network designs, standards, and reference architectures.
* Evaluate existing environments and recommend improvements aligned with business objectives.
* Establish networking standards and governance for all Candescent locations and hosted environments.

**Cloud & Hybrid Networking**

* Design connectivity solutions for Azure, AWS,GCP (Must Have) and hybrid cloud deployments.
* Define architectures for cloud transit networking, DNS, routing, security segmentation, and application delivery.
* Lead cloud networking initiatives on secure multi-cloud connectivity.
* Collaborate with cloud engineering teams on network automation and infrastructure-as-code initiatives.

**Security Architecture & Compliance**

* Partner with Information Security teams to design secure network solutions.
* Develop architectures supporting Zero Trust, network segmentation, NAC, SASE, ZTNA, and secure remote access.
* Ensure designs meet regulatory and compliance requirements including FFIEC, PCI-DSS, SOX, and corporate security standards.
* Provide technical leadership during security assessments, audits, and risk reviews.

**Strategic Leadership**

* Provide architectural oversight for major infrastructure projects.
* Lead technology evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and vendor assessments.
* Develop multi-year network technology roadmaps and lifecycle management strategies.
* Influence infrastructure direction through innovation and industry best practices.
* Present architectural recommendations to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

**Operational Excellence**

* Act as the highest escalation point for complex networking issues.
* Review network performance, capacity, resiliency, and availability metrics.
* Guide disaster recovery and business continuity planning efforts.
* Ensure infrastructure designs align with operational supportability requirements.

**Automation & Modernization**

* Promote network automation and orchestration strategies.
* Design solutions utilizing APIs, scripting, and infrastructure-as-code platforms.
* Drive adoption of modern operational models and observability platforms.
* Partner with engineering teams to implement automated provisioning and configuration management.

**Mentorship & Collaboration**

* Mentor Network Engineers and Senior Engineers on architecture and design principles.
* Participate in technical reviews, change advisory boards, and project governance.
* Foster technical excellence across Infrastructure Engineering teams.
* Build strong partnerships with business units, application owners, vendors, and managed service providers.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline.
* 10+ years of enterprise networking experience.
* 5+ years designing large-scale, mission-critical network environments.
* Expert level experience with:
  + GCP Networking
  + Cloud and B2B Networking
  + Palo Alto Networks firewalls
  + Meraki Wireless networking technologies
  + SD-WAN solutions
* Strong experience designing:
  + Fortigate Network firewalls
  + Corporate office networks
  + Hybrid cloud connectivity
  + Individual Financial Institution Networks
* Experience with network security architecture and segmentation strategies.
* Proven ability to lead large-scale infrastructure transformation projects.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Financial services or regulated industry experience.
* Experience with:
  + Cisco Wireless / Meraki
  + Palo Alto Networks & SCM
  + Azure networking
  + AWS networking
  + GCP networking (Must Have)
  + Prisma Access
  + Network automation platforms
* Knowledge of infrastructure-as-code frameworks.
* Experience with monitoring and observability platforms.
* Strong written documentation and presentation skills.

**Certifications (Nice To Have)**

* Palo Alto Networks Certified Network Security Architect (PCNSA/PCNSE)
* Professional Cloud Network Engineer (PCNE)
* AWS Advanced Networking Specialty
* Microsoft Azure Network Engineer Associate
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)

**Success Metrics**

The successful Network Architect will:

* Establish enterprise architecture standards and governance.
* Improve network reliability, resiliency, and security posture.
* Reduce operational complexity through standardization and automation.
* Lead infrastructure modernization initiatives.
* Support business growth through scalable network design.
* Serve as the trusted technical advisor for network strategy across Candescent.

**Statement to Third Party Agencies**  
To ALL recruitment agencies: Candescent only accepts resumes from agencies on the preferred supplier list. Please do not forward resumes to our applicant tracking system, Candescent employees, or any Candescent facility. Candescent is not responsible for any fees or charges associated with unsolicited resumes.

**About the Role**

  

We are looking for a skilled Azure Cloud Engineer with 3-5 years of experience in designing, implementing, managing, and optimizing Microsoft Azure cloud infrastructure. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience with Azure services, cloud security, networking, monitoring, automation, and troubleshooting. The candidate will work closely with development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to ensure secure, scalable, reliable, and cost-effective cloud environments.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Design, deploy, configure, and manage Azure cloud infrastructure, including Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Storage Accounts, Azure App Services, and related services.
* Manage Azure networking components such as VNets, subnets, Network Security Groups (NSGs), Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, VPN Gateway, and DNS.
* Implement and maintain cloud security best practices, including Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), Microsoft Entra ID, Managed Identities, Key Vault, and access policies.
* Monitor cloud infrastructure performance, availability, and resource utilization using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, and Application Insights.
* Automate infrastructure provisioning and routine operational tasks using Azure CLI, PowerShell, Azure Automation, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform or ARM/Bicep templates.
* Support the implementation and maintenance of CI/CD pipelines in collaboration with DevOps teams using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Manage backup, disaster recovery, business continuity, and high-availability configurations using appropriate Azure services.
* Troubleshoot cloud infrastructure issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions to minimize service disruptions.
* Optimize Azure resource utilization and cloud expenditure by implementing cost-monitoring, resource-tagging, and cost-optimization practices.
* Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, configuration records, and operational procedures.
* Collaborate with development, security, DevOps, and infrastructure teams to support application deployments, cloud migrations, and environment management.
* Follow organizational policies and industry best practices for cloud governance, compliance, security, and operational management.

  

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 3-6 years of hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, with strong expertise in Microsoft Azure.
* Good understanding of core Azure services, including Azure Virtual Machines, Virtual Networks, Storage Accounts, Azure App Services, and Azure Monitor.
* Practical experience with Azure networking, identity and access management, security configurations, and troubleshooting.
* Knowledge of scripting and automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, or similar tools.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, ARM templates, or Bicep).
* Understanding of CI/CD concepts and tools such as Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
* Experience with cloud monitoring, logging, backup, disaster recovery, and performance optimization.
* Knowledge of cloud security principles, cost management, and resource governance.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

  

* Microsoft Azure certifications such as Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104) or Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305).
* Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, or Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
* Experience with cloud migration projects and hybrid cloud environments.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices, incident management, and change management processes.

Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

**Company Description**
India’s Future Investors (IFI) is India’s Money Entertainment Reality Show that combines money intelligence, human behavior, competition, and entertainment. Through immersive challenges and real-world financial scenarios, IFI explores how people think, prioritize, and decide under time constraints and pressure. The show focuses on how MONEY, TIME, and PRESSURE reveal CHARACTER, aiming to find India’s “Money Rockstar.” IFI invites people not only to watch but to participate, compete, and follow the journey as the search for India’s Money Rockstar unfolds. The platform offers a dynamic environment for professionals who want to contribute to an innovative, high-energy media experience centered on financial decision-making.
  
**Role Description**
The Cloud Architect will design, implement, and maintain scalable, secure, and highly available cloud architectures to support IFI’s digital platforms and production workflows. This full-time remote role involves working closely with product, engineering, and media teams to translate business and content requirements into robust cloud solutions, including infrastructure, application hosting, data flows, and integrations. Day-to-day responsibilities include planning and optimizing cloud infrastructure, defining architecture patterns, overseeing deployment pipelines, and ensuring reliability, performance, and cost efficiency. The Cloud Architect will also establish best practices for security and compliance, troubleshoot complex technical issues, and provide guidance to development teams on cloud-native design and integration. Collaboration, documentation, and continuous improvement of the overall cloud environment are central to this role.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong Solution Architecture and Architecture skills, with experience designing end-to-end cloud systems for high-traffic digital or media platforms.
* Hands-on expertise in cloud Infrastructure (compute, storage, networking) and infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, ARM templates).
* Background in Software Development with proficiency in at least one modern programming language (e.g., Python, Java, Node.js) and microservices design.
* Experience with Integration, including APIs, messaging, streaming, and connecting distributed services and third-party platforms.
* Deep knowledge of at least one major cloud provider (AWS, Azure, GCP), including security, identity and access management, monitoring, and cost optimization.
* Proven ability to design for scalability, reliability, and performance, using CI/CD pipelines, containers, and orchestration (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
* Strong problem-solving skills, clear communication, and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional and remote teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience in media, entertainment, or fintech environments, and familiarity with high-availability, low-latency architectures, is a plus.

e9d17c93.title: Managed Services Consultant - Lead
e9d17c93.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
  
  
By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.
  
  
Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
Lead managed services delivery for Sprinklr CCaaS customers, driving platform configuration, optimization, and adoption across digital and voice ecosystems. Act as a hands-on solution lead ensuring scalable design, strong customer outcomes, and continuous value realization.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Translate customer business requirements into best-practice CCaaS solutions aligned to Sprinklr capabilities and defined solution blueprints.
* Own and manage end-to-end configurations across omnichannel workflows, routing, IVR, case management, SLA frameworks, and automation.
* Manage and maintain core configuration architecture, ensuring alignment with customer blueprints, supportability, and scalability standards.
* Configure and optimize advanced routing models including skills-based routing, priority logic, queue segmentation, and escalation workflows.
* Design and enhance IVR flows, voice queue logic, call routing paths, and contact center workflow automation.
* Build and optimize bot workflows, conversational AI journeys, and automation frameworks to improve containment, productivity, and customer experience.
* Drive platform adoption by aligning features to customer use cases, usage patterns, and operational objectives.
* Monitor and improve customer contact center operational metrics such as SLA adherence, AHT, queue performance, response times, productivity, and CSAT.
* Identify platform gaps and optimization opportunities and implement best practice solutioning to improve efficiency and service outcomes.
* Manage post go-live changes, releases, configuration updates, and continuous platform improvements across the customer lifecycle.
* Support and guide API, CRM, telephony, and third-party system integrations to enable connected workflows and unified service operations.
* Lead training and onboarding sessions for agents, admins, and customer teams to drive adoption of workflows, tools, and operating practices.
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to identify new opportunities, drive platform consumption, and support upsell/cross-sell discussions.
* Act as the primary technical and functional point of contact, advising stakeholders on solution design, adoption strategy, and operational improvements.
* Leverage AI and automation opportunities to improve ROI, efficiency, and service performance.

**What Makes You Qualified?**
**Must Have Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in managed services, CCaaS, or technology consulting.
* Strong hands-on experience with Sprinklr CCaaS or similar platforms such as Genesys, Cisco Webex Contact Center, Twilio Flex, or comparable solutions.
* Strong knowledge of IVR, routing strategies, queue management, chatbot workflows, case management, and SLA configurations.
* Experience designing and supporting omnichannel customer journeys across digital and voice channels.
* Understanding of telephony concepts such as VoIP, SIP, CTI, and ACD.
* Experience with API, CRM, and third-party integrations.
* Hands-on experience in system configuration, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business needs into platform solutions.

**Good To Have Skills**

* Exposure to AI-driven support models, automation use cases, and digital deflection strategies.
* Experience with social and digital engagement platforms.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with understanding of customer service KPIs.
* CCaaS certifications such as Genesys, Cisco, or Avaya preferred.

**Who You Are**

* A strong technical consultant with an ownership mindset.
* Able to independently manage customer outcomes and multiple engagements.
* Skilled at balancing hands-on delivery with stakeholder engagement and solution guidance.
* Customer-focused, solution-oriented, and driven by continuous improvement.

**What Success Looks Like**

* High platform adoption and improved operational performance across customer accounts.
* Strong customer retention and measurable expansion opportunities.
* Successful delivery of scalable, optimized, and well-governed CCaaS solutions.
* Recognition as a trusted advisor for day-to-day platform and service improvements.

**We focus on our mission**
: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**
: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
  
  
**We invest in our people**
: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
  
  
To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
  
  
To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
  
  
**EEO - Our philosophy**
: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
  
  
Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
  
  
**Warning about Recruiting Scams:**
Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
  
  
If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

**Experience:** 10 Years Overall | Minimum 7 Years Relevant Experience  
**Location:** Remote – Pan India  
**Budget:** ₹2.5 LPA  
**Engagement Model:** Direct Contract with Haparz

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced CMS Architect with strong expertise in digital content architecture, enterprise content management systems, and knowledge management platforms. The ideal candidate will assess existing content ecosystems and design scalable, governed, and reusable content architectures for global websites and digital platforms.

This role focuses on content architecture, information architecture, taxonomy, metadata, content governance, localization, and knowledge management. The candidate should be capable of translating business requirements into practical architecture recommendations that improve content discoverability, consistency, reuse, and delivery across global markets.

Key Responsibilities

* Assess existing CMS, FAQ, and knowledge management ecosystems across global websites to identify architectural gaps, content duplication, and opportunities for improvement.
* Design scalable content models, classification frameworks, metadata structures, and information architectures that support reusable content across multiple websites and markets.
* Define taxonomy, tagging standards, and publishing workflows to improve content discoverability, consistency, governance, and traceability.
* Establish content reuse strategies, localization guidelines, and controlled content variations to support regional requirements without unnecessary duplication.
* Evaluate enterprise CMS, knowledge management systems, search capabilities, and content delivery platforms to recommend improvements and potential consolidation.
* Translate business and content requirements into architecture recommendations in collaboration with content strategists, business analysts, developers, and business stakeholders.
* Develop content lifecycle management frameworks covering creation, review, approval, publication, maintenance, archival, and retirement.
* Define governance models, content ownership, access controls, and compliance requirements for enterprise content repositories.
* Recommend approaches for multilingual content management, translation workflows, market-specific publishing, and global content consistency.
* Contribute to implementation playbooks, platform evaluation documents, architecture guidelines, and transformation roadmaps.
* Identify opportunities to improve content search, knowledge discovery, content analytics, and omnichannel content delivery.

Required Technical Expertise

* Strong experience with enterprise CMS platforms such as Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Sitecore, Salesforce Experience Cloud, Contentful, Kentico, Drupal, SharePoint, Bloomreach, or similar platforms.
* Expertise in digital content architecture, structured content modeling, and information architecture.
* Hands-on experience designing taxonomy, metadata models, tagging strategies, and content governance frameworks.
* Understanding of knowledge management systems, FAQ ecosystems, enterprise search, and knowledge discovery.
* Experience with content reuse, content lifecycle management, versioning, traceability, and publishing workflows.
* Understanding of localization, multilingual content delivery, translation management, and regional content variations.
* Ability to assess existing content platforms and develop architecture recommendations aligned with business and technical requirements.

Preferred Expertise

1a5c1577.description:
Job Title: Program Manager – Online MBA

**Industry:** EdTech / Higher Education / Online Education  
**Department:** Centre for Distance and Online Education  
**Reporting To:** Director – Strategic Initiatives  
**Qualification:** MBA or Master's degree in a relevant field  
**Experience:** Relevant experience in program management, preferably in online education

Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Program Manager to oversee the end-to-end operations and delivery of an Online MBA programme. The role involves managing student experience, academic operations, programme performance, external partnerships, admissions coordination, budgeting, and reporting.

The ideal candidate should have strong program management, analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills, along with an understanding of online learning platforms, Learning Management Systems (LMS), and student lifecycle management.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Program Management & Operations**

* Oversee the day-to-day operations and end-to-end delivery of the Online MBA programme.
* Monitor key performance indicators, including student engagement, retention, completion rates, and student satisfaction.
* Analyse programme performance data and implement strategies to improve operational efficiency and learner experience.
* Track individual student progress, identify at-risk learners, and coordinate appropriate intervention and support.
* Review and update programme curriculum in coordination with academic stakeholders to ensure relevance and quality.
* Develop and maintain programme websites, digital content, and online learning resources.
* Collaborate with the brand and marketing teams to develop programme-related communication and marketing materials.
* Manage programme budgets and monitor expenses to support financial sustainability.

**2. Student Experience & Support**

* Address student queries through email and other communication channels, ensuring timely resolution.
* Coordinate with academic teams, faculty members, and student support teams to enhance the overall learner experience.
* Organise student workshops, masterclasses, networking events, and other engagement activities.
* Conduct student satisfaction surveys, analyse feedback, and implement improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate with career services teams to facilitate career guidance and employment-related opportunities for students.
* Ensure smooth delivery of online classes and provide support for technical or operational issues, including during weekends when required.

**3. Partner & Vendor Management**

* Manage relationships with external vendors and partners, including technology providers and education financing partners.
* Coordinate vendor onboarding, evaluate performance, and resolve operational issues.
* Support contract negotiations and monitor service delivery against agreed requirements.
* Work with technology and Learning Management System (LMS) teams to ensure course content management, data backup, and platform functionality.

**4. Admissions & Enrolment Management**

* Coordinate with the admissions team to ensure smooth execution of admission and enrolment processes.
* Monitor the student enrolment journey and ensure timely completion of admission formalities.
* Coordinate with relevant departments to resolve admission-related operational issues and improve process efficiency.

**5. MIS, Reporting & Financial Coordination**

* Prepare Management Information System (MIS) reports, dashboards, and performance reports related to enrolments, student engagement, retention, and programme outcomes.
* Analyse student data and generate actionable insights to support management decisions.
* Coordinate with the finance department regarding student billing, fee payments, and outstanding dues.
* Oversee student refund processing in coordination with the finance team.
* Maintain accurate programme records, reports, and operational documentation.

**6. Stakeholder Coordination & Administration**

* Coordinate with academic, technology, finance, marketing, career services, and student support teams.
* Participate in programme review meetings and provide updates on performance, operational challenges, and improvement initiatives.
* Develop and maintain professional relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Conduct research on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in online programme management.
* Develop and implement crisis communication and issue-resolution plans.
* Coordinate campus facilities and logistical arrangements for visiting guests and programme-related events.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and participate in relevant professional development activities.

Required Qualifications

* MBA or Master's degree in Business Administration, Management, Education, or a related field.
* Relevant experience in programme management, project management, academic operations, or online education.
* Strong understanding of online learning platforms, digital education delivery, and student lifecycle management.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and coordinate cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience managing Online MBA programmes, distance education, higher education, or EdTech operations.
* Familiarity with Learning Management Systems (LMS), Student Information Systems (SIS), and Customer Relationship Management (CRM) platforms.
* Experience in MIS reporting, data analysis, budgeting, vendor management, and student engagement initiatives.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent project management qualification.

Key Skills

Program Management | Online MBA Operations | EdTech | Higher Education | Online Learning | Academic Operations | Student Experience | Student Engagement | Project Management | Learning Management System (LMS) | Vendor Management | Stakeholder Management | MIS Reporting | Data Analysis | Budget Management | Admissions Management | Student Lifecycle Management | Process Improvement | Cross-Functional Coordination

Working Conditions

* Full-time role in a professional office environment.
* Flexibility to work evenings or weekends when required for online classes, student engagement activities, and programme operations.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Experience:

48695c1b.title: Delivery Manager
48695c1b.description:
**Role Summary**

The Delivery Manager is responsible for end-to-end client delivery outcomes, operational stability, and account growth within assigned accounts. This is a
**technically hands-on delivery leadership role**
: you will be expected to understand architecture, code quality, environments, and release pipelines well enough to guide engineers, challenge estimates, and lead technical conversations with client stakeholders. The role operationalizes the
**3M Strategy (Manage, Monitor, Mine)**
, ensures adherence to the
**Tiered Operating Model**
, and acts as the primary day-to-day delivery contact for clients. You will work as a
**peer**
with global counterparts, drive client satisfaction, and proactively identify risks and expansion opportunities.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **1. Delivery Execution (MANAGE)**
  Own delivery commitments, including SLA tracking and quality assurance, for assigned accounts.
* Lead Agile sprint planning, execution, and demos in coordination with COEs, Solution Architects, and QA teams.
* Ensure hypercare stability (2–4 weeks post go-live) and transition to managed services.
* Manage resource allocation (onshore, nearshore, offshore) based on complexity and cost efficiency.
* Host weekly client delivery status meetings and internal syncs.
* Own major incident resolution, recovery planning, and corrective actions, including leading technical triage and root cause analysis (RCA) with engineering teams.
* Identify and implement process improvements to improve delivery efficiency and predictability.
* **2. Technical Leadership & Quality**
  Review solution designs, technical approaches, and estimates with architects and tech leads; challenge assumptions and flag technical risk early.
* Understand code, branching, CI/CD pipelines, environments, and release processes well enough to unblock teams and validate delivery status.
* Drive engineering quality practices: definition of done, technical debt tracking, and release readiness.
* Translate technical issues into clear business impact for client leadership, and client needs into clear technical direction for teams.
* Evaluate and promote the use of AI-assisted development and testing tools to improve team productivity and quality.
* **3. Risk & Opportunity Monitoring (MONITOR)**
  Continuously monitor client leadership changes, operational shifts, and market dynamics.
* Flag risks early using the
  **Account Health Dashboard (Green/Yellow/Red)**
  .
* Escalate delivery disputes or commercial risks to Delivery Director when thresholds are breached.
* Conduct continuous risk management and quality assurance checks.
* **4. Account Growth Support (MINE)**
  Partner with Account Executive (AE) and Client Success Team to identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities.
* Participate in Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) for key or at-risk accounts.
* Provide delivery health summaries and expansion recommendations to AEs.
* **5. Governance & Reporting**
  Produce
  **weekly status reports**
  rolled up to Delivery Director.
* Use PMO tools, playbooks, and dashboards per organizational standards.
* Co-run internal kickoffs with AE within
  **5 business days**
  of contract signing.
* Lead external client kickoffs within
  **1 business day**
  of tier/PM assignment.
* **6. Peer Collaboration (Global Delivery Model)**
  Operate as a peer with US and India Delivery Managers (no hierarchical silos).
* Participate in
  **weekly delivery health reviews**
  led by Delivery Director.
* Share best practices and resources across the global delivery organization.
* Provide a clean handover and clear escalation path for the hours you are offline, so clients are always covered.
* **7. Availability & Business Needs**
  Provide live support and be reachable for PST clients until approximately 1:00–2:00 AM IST, including client calls, release windows, and urgent escalations.
* Be available to attend the office on short notice when called upon by the business.
* Travel to client sites, delivery centers, or other locations as the need arises.

Must-Have Skills

Required • 8+ years of delivery/project management in IT services or software engineering, with a hands-on technical background (developer, tech lead, architect, or DevOps/QA engineering) of at least 3 years • Strong technical depth in modern software delivery: system design basics, APIs and integrations, databases, cloud (AWS/Azure), and CI/CD pipelines • Ability to read and review code or technical designs and hold credible technical discussions with engineers and client architects • Experience managing multiple clients simultaneously (shared PM model) • Strong working knowledge of Agile, DevOps, and hybrid delivery models • Proven ability to work with COEs (e.g., Modern Engineering, Integration, Cloud, ERP)

* Experience using portfolio or program-management systems, operational dashboards and data-driven reviews to support decisions.

* Performance, scalability, availability, reliability, fault tolerance and disaster recovery.

VikingCloud is the leading Predict-to-Prevent cybersecurity and compliance company, offering businesses a single, integrated solution to make informed, predictive, and cost-effective risk mitigation decisions – faster. Powered by the Asgard Platform™, the industry’s largest repository of anonymized cybersecurity and compliance event data, we continuously monitor and analyze over 6+ billion online events every day.

VikingCloud is the one-stop partner trusted by 4+ million customers to provide the predictive intelligence and competitive edge they need to stay one step ahead of cybersecurity and compliance disruptions to their business. Our 1,000 dedicated cybersecurity and compliance expert advisors understand that it’s not just about technology. It’s about transacting business and delivering an exceptional customer experience every day, without fail. That’s the measurable value we deliver. And that’s what we call, Business Uninterrupted.

**This Position**

Customer-facing pre-sales role responsible for discovery, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, service presentations, and ongoing support for cybersecurity and compliance opportunities.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a
**Pre-Sales Specialist**
to support the US sales organization in managing customer-facing pre-sales activities for cybersecurity and compliance services.

This is a
**mid level pre-sales position**
involving requirements gathering, proposal development, customer presentations, RFP responses, internal coordination, service positioning, and opportunity support.

The successful candidate will be expected to understand standard cybersecurity and compliance services, communicate them clearly, organize information effectively, and coordinate with internal specialists when deeper technical input is required.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support sales opportunities related to managed security, cybersecurity assessments, compliance, vulnerability management, security testing, and related services.
* Participate in discovery calls to understand customer business needs, current challenges, required services, timelines, and decision criteria.
* Ask relevant follow-up questions and document customer requirements accurately.
* Prepare customer presentations, proposals, RFP/RFI responses, service summaries, and statements of work.
* Map customer requirements to standard service offerings, capabilities, deliverables, and outcomes.
* Explain the scope, methodology, benefits, assumptions, and expected outputs of standard cybersecurity and compliance services.
* Present service capabilities to technical, procurement, operational, and business stakeholders.
* Conduct standard service demonstrations, walkthroughs, and capability presentations using approved materials.
* Support sales teams in preparing account-specific messaging, opportunity strategies, discovery plans, and presentation content.
* Develop clear responses to technical, operational, security, compliance, and vendor questionnaires.
* Coordinate with subject-matter experts for non-standard, highly technical, or specialized customer requirements.
* Consolidate inputs from delivery, professional services, compliance, operations, product, and security teams into a cohesive customer response.
* Support preparation of scope, deliverables, timelines, assumptions, dependencies, exclusions, and service acceptance criteria.
* Assist with pricing, effort estimation, resource assumptions, and commercial inputs in partnership with sales and delivery teams.
* Review customer requirements and identify risks, gaps, exclusions, or areas requiring clarification.
* Ensure that proposals and RFP responses are accurate, consistent, professionally written, and submitted on time.
* Maintain opportunity documentation, proposal trackers, content repositories, and internal approval records.
* Prepare meeting agendas, presentation scripts, discovery questionnaires, and post-meeting follow-up communication.
* Track action items and coordinate timely closure with internal stakeholders.
* Maintain reusable content related to cybersecurity services, compliance offerings, customer use cases, methodologies, and frequently asked questions.
* Support sales enablement activities, customer workshops, webinars, industry events, and internal training sessions.
* Capture customer feedback and communicate recurring requirements, objections, and market observations to the relevant teams.
* Work closely with US-based sales colleagues during Eastern Time Zone working hours.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Approximately 5 years of professional experience.
* At least 3 years of experience in pre-sales, sales engineering, proposal management, bid management, solution support, or technology-services sales support.
* Experience supporting enterprise or mid-market customers in IT services, cybersecurity, compliance, risk, cloud, infrastructure, or managed services.
* Basic to moderate understanding of cybersecurity and risk and compliance concepts.
* Practical exposure to at least some of the following areas:
* Managed security services.
* Security monitoring.
* Vulnerability management.
* Penetration testing and security testing.
* Compliance assessments.
* Risk assessments.
* Security questionnaires.
* Governance, risk, and compliance services.
* Proven experience preparing RFP/RFI responses, proposals, presentations, statements of work, and customer-facing documentation.
* Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.
* Strong ability to explain technical or service-related concepts in simple business language.
* Confidence in presenting to customers and facilitating structured discussions.
* Ability to work with incomplete information, ask relevant questions, and organize inputs from different stakeholders.
* Strong ownership of deadlines, follow-ups, documentation, and opportunity coordination.
* Good attention to detail and ability to review complex documents for accuracy and completeness.
* Ability to work effectively with US-based teams and customers.
* Comfortable working in US Eastern Time Zone-aligned hours.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Exposure to ISO 27001, PCI DSS, SOC 2, NIST, GDPR, HIPAA, or similar standards and frameworks.
* Familiarity with common cybersecurity technologies, including SIEM, EDR, firewalls, endpoint security, cloud security, vulnerability management, and network security.
* Experience supporting cybersecurity, GRC, compliance, risk, or professional-services offerings.
* Experience responding to enterprise RFPs and security questionnaires.
* Experience working with international customers, particularly US customers.
* Exposure to CRM, CPQ, proposal management, ticketing, document management, or collaboration platforms.
* Certifications such as Security+, CISA, CISM, CRISC, ISO 27001, or similar are desirable but not mandatory.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, political affiliation or opinion, medical condition, status as a veteran, and/or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

efef507f.title: Presales SuccessFactors - Senior Consultant - L3
efef507f.description:
**Job Description**
SAP SuccessFactors Bid Management / Presales Consultant JD
  
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The SAP SuccessFactors (SF) Bid Management / Presales Consultant is responsible for managing end-to-end bid and proposal activities for SAP SuccessFactors opportunities. The role ensures high-quality, compliant, and competitive RFP/RFI/RFQ responses by coordinating across Sales, SF Solution Architects, Delivery/AMS, Finance, and Legal. The consultant supports pursuits across SAP SuccessFactors modules such as Employee Central, Recruiting, Onboarding, Performance & Goals, Compensation, Learning, Time Tracking, and Workforce Analytics, including integrations, data migration, security/role design, change management, and post-go-live support (AMS).
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Manage the end-to-end bid lifecycle for SAP SuccessFactors opportunities, including RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, proposals, and presentations (new implementation, rollout, optimization, and AMS/support pursuits)
* Interpret client RFP requirements and evaluation criteria and translate them into a compliant response structure
* Develop and manage compliance matrices, response outlines, and submission checklists
* Coordinate inputs across Sales, Presales, SAP SuccessFactors Solution Architects/SMEs, Delivery/AMS leads, Finance, Legal, and Commercial teams
* Facilitate bid kick‑off calls, content workshops, review cycles, and final sign‑offs
* Ensure proposal content aligns with the SuccessFactors solution scope and delivery approach, including module scope (e.g., EC/Recruiting/Onboarding), global rollout strategy, data migration approach, integration design (SAP BTP/CPI, IAS/IPS, 3rd-party), security/role concept, testing, cutover, training, and hypercare/AMS assumptions and dependencies
* Leverage GenAI and RFP automation tools throughout the pursuit management lifecycle.
* Track risks, assumptions, dependencies, and action items throughout the bid lifecycle
* Ensure reuse of approved SAP SuccessFactors proposal assets, case studies, client references, CVs, and standard responses
* Perform final quality checks for compliance, messaging consistency, formatting, and submission readiness
* Manage proposal production and ensure on‑time submission through client portals and procurement platforms
* Maintain bid trackers, win/loss insights, and lessons learned for continuous improvement of SAP SuccessFactors pursuits
* Support commercial shaping activities such as scope clarifications, assumptions, exclusions, and change control approach in coordination with Sales and Delivery teams
* Work closely with Sales and Delivery teams to develop and update SAP SuccessFactors case studies (e.g., global rollouts, recruitment transformation, HR digitalization, integrations, and post-go-live optimization/AMS)
* Build SAP SuccessFactors RFP/RFI response content by reusing previously approved responses and ensuring review and validation by SF solution and delivery teams
* Work with the Marketing team to update proposal content such as company revenue, number of clients, employee count, and credentials
* Create and validate effort estimates and high-level plans based on SuccessFactors scope, modules, rollout waves, configuration/build activities, integrations, data migration, security/roles, testing, training, and hypercare/AMS requirements
* Create and refine PowerPoint presentations for client orals
* Experience working with SharePoint sites to manage proposal libraries, including case studies, standard RFP content, and active pursuits

**Required Skills & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in Bid Management / Proposal Management for SAP SuccessFactors and/or HXM services
* Hands‑on experience working on proposals and pursuits for the UK region
* Experience managing RFP/RFI/RFQ responses, proposal development, and bid timelines for SAP SuccessFactors programs (implementations, rollouts, upgrades, and optimization/AMS), covering modules such as Employee Central, Recruiting, Onboarding, Performance & Goals, Compensation, Learning, Time Tracking, and Analytics
* Ability to create client‑facing collateral such as presentations, case studies, and proposal assets
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and facilitation skills
* Clear, concise business writing skills with the ability to consolidate SME inputs into client‑ready proposals
* Strong planning and execution skills with experience managing risks, issues, and deadlines
* Working knowledge of SuccessFactors delivery terminology and artifacts (module scope/configuration, business rules/workflows, role-based permissions, MDF objects, integrations, data migration, testing, change management, and AMS) to manage proposal content with SMEs
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, especially PowerPoint, Excel and MS Word

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
  
**Get empowered by NTT DATA Business Solutions!**
**We transform. SAP® solutions into Value**
**NTT DATA Business Solutions is a fast-growing international IT company and one of the world’s leading SAP partners. We are a full service provider delivering everything from business consulting to implementation of SAP solutions, including hosting services and support.**

bdbbc6a2.description:
**Experience:**
5 years
  
  
**Job Type:**
Full Time
  
  
**Job Location:**
Delhi/Chennai
  
  
**JOB Description**
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Presales Networking Specialist to join our team. As a key member of our presales team, you will play a critical role in understanding customer requirements, designing customized networking solutions, and providing technical expertise throughout the sales process. You will collaborate closely with our sales teams to deliver comprehensive networking solutions that address our customers’ evolving needs.
  
  
**Profile : Presales Networking Specialist
  
  
No. of Positions: 3**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Engage with customers to understand their networking challenges, requirements, and objectives.
* Conduct in-depth technical discussions and presentations to articulate the value proposition of our networking solutions.
* Collaborate with sales teams to develop customized proposals, solution architectures, and technical responses to RFIs/RFPs.
* Design and configure networking solutions based on customer requirements, leveraging our product portfolio and industry best practices.
* Conduct product demonstrations and proof-of-concept (POC) activities to showcase the capabilities and benefits of our networking solutions.
* Provide technical guidance and support to sales teams during customer meetings, negotiations, and contract discussions.
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive landscape to inform product development and sales strategies.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, partners, and internal stakeholders to drive business growth and customer satisfaction.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (Master’s degree preferred).
* 5 years of experience in presales engineering, solution architecture, or technical sales roles within the networking industry.
* Deep understanding of networking technologies, protocols, and architectures, including but not limited to: routing, switching, SD-WAN, wireless networking, security, and cloud networking.
* Hands-on experience with networking equipment, platforms, and tools from leading vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, Arista, and Palo Alto Networks.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Proven track record of designing and delivering complex networking solutions that meet customer requirements and business objectives.
* Certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent is highly desirable.
* Excellent teamwork, collaboration, and problem-solving abilities.

551990b8.title: GTM Solutions Consultant III
551990b8.description:
ZoomInfo is where careers accelerate. We move fast, think boldly, and empower you to do the best work of your life. You’ll be surrounded by teammates who care deeply, challenge each other, and celebrate wins. With tools that amplify your impact and a culture that backs your ambition, you won’t just contribute. You’ll make things happen fast.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Solution Consultant II at ZoomInfo, you will partner with customers and prospects to understand their business objectives, use cases, and challenges, and map them to innovative solutions. Working closely with Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering teams, you will act as a strategic problem solver, build customer confidence, and help drive meaningful business outcomes.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Partner with AE’s and AM’s to discover customer needs and design solutions to solve complex customer challenges.
* Be the expert that articulates our solution capabilities through solution demonstrations anchored in the context of customer need and value
* Lead the technical aspects of the solution and customer evaluations while ensuring a memorable experience and delivering value to ensure the technical win
* Track and raise feature requests while collaborating closely with product management and engineering teams. Enhancements/capabilities and competitive intel

**What You Bring**

* Bachelors / Maters in Science Or Engineering
* 7 to 10 years of experience as presales solution consulting or technical sales experience in SaaS or enterprise technology space
* Shift : Adaptable to work in 5 PM to 2 AM IST or 7 PM IST to 4 AM IST which depend on business need
* Self-starter and team player that excels working in an unstructured environment and can quickly grasp technical concepts
* Customer obsessed mindset with a knack for understanding and solving problems using technology solutions
* Outstanding problem-solving skills, including the ability to meet a business requirement with a technical solution
* Proficient in delivering software demonstrations in-person and virtually
* Excellent interpersonal, communication, persuasion, presentation and writing skills
* Experience with technical business documentation like workflow diagrams, proposals, SOWs, RFPs and RFIs, etc.
* Proven experience working with employees at all levels of an organization
* Previous experience designing solutions in a platform/multi product environment
* Experience with Demo2Win and Value Selling Methodologies
* Experience selling into Sales/Marketing/Data Ops, Sales Leadership, Data Science, and Marketing
* Experience working in Conversation Intelligence (Chorus, Gong), Sales Automation (ZI Engage, Salesloft, Outreach), Chat (ZI Chat, Drift), or ABM/Marketing Automation (6Sense, DemandBase, Marketo, Eloqua, Pardot) would be a plus
* Experience in selling SAAS sales or marketing technology platforms that are feature rich and have numerous use cases across different types of customers and prospects
* Prior experience using or integrating with CRM systems such as Salesforce.com, Microsoft Dynamics, Hubspot, or Marketing Automation systems such as Marketo, Eloqua, Pardot or Experience with APIs and MCP Knowledge.
* Experience with recommending and demonstrating software solutions that have numerous applications to business leaders, to solve critical business challenges

**About Us**
ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM), the all-in-one AI GTM platform, enables sales, marketing, and customer success teams to execute their go-to-market strategy with confidence. Powered by the industry's most comprehensive B2B data, including more than 100 million companies, 500 million contacts, and billions of signals, ZoomInfo delivers the intelligence, automation, and integrations that modern revenue teams need to identify, engage, and convert their best buyers.
  
  
ZoomInfo is committed to protecting your privacy when you apply for jobs with us. Please review our Job Applicant Privacy Notice for more details on how we handle your personal information.
  
  
ZoomInfo may use a software-based assessment as part of the recruitment process. More information about this tool, including the results of the most recent bias audit, is available here.
  
  
ZoomInfo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and does not discriminate based on protected status. We welcome all applicants and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities regardless of sex, race, age, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, disability status, religion, protected military or veteran status, medical condition, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We also consider qualified candidates with criminal histories in accordance with legal requirements.
  
  
For Massachusetts Applicants: It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. ZoomInfo does not administer lie detector tests to applicants in any location.

58eddc26.title: Advisory Solutions Engineer
58eddc26.description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**

* Deep Expertise Development: Cultivate an in-depth understanding of Confluent’s technologies and the intricacies of building streaming applications.
* Technical Discovery and POC/Pilot Solutions: Collaborate with Confluent solutions engineers to gather requirements, identify use cases, and facilitate the development of Proof of Concept (POC)/Pilot solutions. Aid customers in overcoming technical challenges during initial blueprinting and use case deployment.
* Prospect Demos and Evangelization: Collaborate seamlessly with Confluent's Account Executives (AEs) and Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) to bring our offerings to new prospects. Craft and deliver tailored demos that go beyond the standard, showcasing the unique value proposition Confluent has to offer.
* Customer Engagement: Offer technical assistance in driving customer consumption through monthly customer health reports, Quarterly Business Reviews, and Quarterly Technical Reviews.
* Knowledge Sharing, Workshops, and Training: Support cross-functional teams, including Field Marketing, Partner Solutions by conducting training sessions and workshops/webinars for customers, partners, prospects, and internal teams to educate them on Confluent's platform/cloud, features, and best practices.
* RFP/Vendor risk assessment Support: Contribute to vendor risk assessments to ensure a comprehensive understanding of potential risks and opportunities associated with proposed solutions. Assist in answering Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and Requests for Quotations (RFQs).
* Technical Artifact Creation and Maintenance: Architect, build, and maintain reusable artifacts, including tools, prototypes, demos, workshops, and architecture blueprints.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Solutions Engineering or similar work experience in a technical pre-sales capacity.
* Process & Efficiency, a “scale” mindset. An ability to quickly leverage standardized demo environments, template proposals, and documented Proof of Concept (PoC) scopes to minimize preparation time.

Experience with Event-Driven architecture, Data Integration & Processing Techniques, Database & Data Warehouse technologies.
  
  

* First-Hand exposure to Cloud Architecture, Migrations, Deployment & Application Development.
* Experience with Automation, GitOps and Kubernetes.
* Proficiency in Java, Python or SQL.
* Development or implementation experience in a cloud-based environment, along with Technical certifications (e.g., Cloud Developer/Architect, Data Engineering & Integration).
* Clear, consistent demonstration of self-starter behavior, a desire to learn new things and tackle hard technical problems.
* Managing multiple evaluation processes across various industry verticals and use cases, ability to be nimble and organized is a must
* Exceptional presentation and communications capabilities to all levels across an organization.
* Ability to explain complex concepts in plain, non-technical language that resonates with mid-level managers and business owners.
* Fluency in English is a requisite.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Previous experience building solutions with Apache Kafka.
* Understanding of systems operations concepts (disk, network, operating systems, etc).
* Experience with software development tools, infrastructure automation, and CI/CD tooling (Terraform, Ansible) is a plus
* Experience building and operating large scale systems.
* Experience in technical pre-sales or consultative roles.

3a1eae6c.title: Presales Manager
3a1eae6c.description:
Send your resumes at anmol.kak@aionos.ai

We are seeking an experienced and dynamic **Manager CX Pre-Sales & Solutions** to build and own our Pre-Sales & Solutions charter for CX operations, end-to-end. This is a senior, high-impact role reporting directly to the **VP & Head, CX Solutions, Transformation & Excellence**, responsible for solution design, bid strategy and governance, commercial/pricing ownership, and proposal development for new business pursuits and existing account expansions across all channels and business accounts.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Solution Design & Architecture**

* Own solution design for new pursuits and account expansions, translating client requirements (RFP/RFI or direct ask) into an operating model covering staffing/FTE structure, technology stack, SLA construct, and transition approach.
* Partner with Operations, Training, Quality, IT, and Transition & PM teams to pressure-test feasibility of proposed solutions before submission.
* Build and maintain a reusable solution framework and playbook (staffing models, technology stack options, standard SLA constructs) to accelerate future pursuits.

  
  

**Bid Strategy, Governance & Commercial Ownership**

* Own go/no-go decisioning for inbound RFPs/RFIs, and end-to-end RFP/RFI lifecycle management, including intake, eligibility screening, compliance matrix creation, and timeline management.
* Coordinate inputs from cross-functional stakeholders (Legal, Finance, HR, IT, Operations, Training, Quality) to ensure timely, complete responses.
* Build costing and pricing models for each pursuit, conduct competitive benchmarking and margin/profitability analysis, and partner with Finance for commercial approval and sign-off.
* Review contractual and commercial terms for risk flags, escalating to Legal/Finance as needed, and maintain a bid compliance tracker and audit trail.

  
  

**Proposal Development & Content Ownership**

* Own end-to-end proposal development, including content drafting, formatting, and final packaging, ensuring brand consistency and submission quality.
* Build and maintain the capability deck, case-study library, and boilerplate content bank for reuse across pursuits.
* Maintain version control and a submission archive for audit and reuse purposes.

  
  

**Stakeholder & Business Partnership**

* Partner with account leadership, Operations, Training, and Quality to align pursuit strategy with delivery capability.
* Represent Pre-Sales & Solutions in client-facing discovery calls, orals, and executive presentations.
* Present pipeline status, win/loss analysis, and pursuit health to senior leadership on a regular cadence.

  
  

**Function Build-Out & Team Leadership**

* Build the business case for, and hire into, the Pre-Sales & Solutions team (Bid & Commercial Manager, Bid Associate) as pursuit volume grows.
* Set the function's operating rhythm, including pursuit intake process, go/no-go criteria, review cadences, and quality gates.
* Lead and mentor the team once hired, building a culture of ownership and continuous improvement.

  
  

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

  

**Must-Have:**

* 9-12 years of progressive experience in Pre-Sales, Solutions, Bid Management, or Commercial roles in a CX/BPO environment, including experience owning end-to-end solution design and bid strategy for large deals (500+ FTE). This is an individual contributor role requiring strong ownership and strategic thinking across the deal lifecycle.
* Demonstrated, hands-on experience across the full pursuit lifecycle: solutioning, bid governance, commercial/pricing modeling, and proposal development, ideally in a lean or individual-contributor capacity before scaling a team.
* Strong commercial acumen with hands-on financial/pricing modeling skills.
* Excellent written communication and proposal-writing skills, with experience owning content and collateral libraries.
* Excellent stakeholder management and executive presence, with experience presenting to senior/C-level audiences.

  
  

**Preferred:**

* Experience in the travel/airline or aviation-linked CX/BPO industry.
* Exposure to multi-geography or multi-site operating models (India and overseas).
* Bid/Proposal Management certification (APMP or equivalent).

  
  

**Position details:**

* **Location:** Gurgaon | Full-time, On-site
* **Working Days:** 5 Days a Week | 10 Hours Shift (flexibility to travel & work across sites)
* **Reporting To:** VP & Head CX Solutions, Transformation & Excellence

  
  

Send your resumes at **anmol.kak@aionos.ai**

* Excellent **verbal and written communication skills**.

e94e7841.title: Senior Architect
e94e7841.description:
Senior Architect

**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Qualification:** B.Arch.  
**Experience:** 5–8 Years

About Sarvatva

Sarvatva is a multidisciplinary architecture, interiors, and engineering consultancy working across residential, commercial, and institutional projects. Our work covers the complete process from concept design and 3D visualization to technical documentation and site execution.

We are looking for a **Senior Architect** who can independently lead projects from design development through execution, manage client and consultant coordination, and guide junior architects and designers.

Key Responsibilities

* **Lead and independently manage architectural projects** from concept to execution.
* Handle **residential and redevelopment projects**, ensuring design intent, quality and timely delivery.
* Develop and review **SD packages, working drawings, detailed drawings and GFC/execution drawings**.
* Lead **design development, planning, detailing and technical documentation**.
* Coordinate with **clients, structural/MEP consultants, contractors and site teams**.
* Conduct site visits and monitor **execution, workmanship and adherence to approved drawings**.
* Review drawings and resolve **design, technical and site-related issues**.
* Lead and mentor **junior architects and designers**, allocating tasks and reviewing deliverables.
* Manage project timelines, deliverables and coordination across multiple stakeholders.
* Prepare and present **design proposals, 3D views, renderings and presentations** to clients.
* Participate in client meetings and confidently communicate **design decisions, project requirements and technical solutions**.
* Ensure projects progress smoothly from **concept → design development → documentation → execution**.

Mandatory Skills

* **AutoCAD** – Advanced working knowledge
* **Photoshop** – Presentations & post-production
* **Lumion** – 3D visualization & rendering
* **Revit Architecture & BIM** – Working knowledge
* **PowerPoint** – Professional presentations

We’re Looking For

* **5–8 years of relevant architectural experience**
* Strong experience in **residential and redevelopment projects**
* Proven ability to **independently lead projects**
* Strong knowledge of **architectural detailing, construction and execution**
* Excellent **plan reading, working drawing and GFC drawing** skills
* Good understanding of **interior design, 3D modelling and visualization**
* Strong **client handling and consultant coordination** skills
* Ability to **lead, guide and review junior team members**
* Good understanding of **site execution and construction processes**
* Strong communication, coordination and problem-solving skills
* Willingness to undertake **regular site visits**
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver projects within deadlines

Role Expectations

The Senior Architect will be expected to take **ownership of assigned projects**, act as the key coordination point between the client, consultants and internal team, and ensure that the project moves efficiently from **design to successful execution**.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

* Outstanding communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.

* Exposure to innovative design challenges and multidisciplinary projects.
