a50be904.title: Managed Services Consultant - Sr
a50be904.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Role Summary**

Support managed services delivery for Sprinklr CCaaS customers by configuring, optimizing, and maintaining platform solutions across digital and voice channels. Focus on execution, operational stability, customer support, and ongoing platform adoption.

**What You’ll Do**

  

* Support configuration and maintenance of Sprinklr CCaaS solutions across chat, messaging, email, social, and voice channels.
* Execute platform updates aligned to defined solution blueprints, best practices, and core configuration architecture.
* Assist in configuring and maintaining routing logic, queues, IVR flows, case workflows, SLA rules, and escalations.
* Support bot workflows, automation rules, and bot-to-agent handoff configurations to improve operational efficiency.
* Identify basic platform gaps, configuration issues, and optimization opportunities, and recommend improvements aligned to customer requirements.
* Help maintain platform adoption by supporting users in understanding and using configured features effectively.
* Provide day-to-day support for post go-live enhancements, troubleshooting, and configuration changes.
* Assist in monitoring customer operations metrics such as SLA adherence, queue performance, response times, and agent productivity.
* Support basic API, CRM, and third-party integration activities, including validation and workflow coordination.
* Help onboard and train new agents, admins, and users on workflows, platform usage, and best practices.
* Work closely with Lead consultants and customer stakeholders to ensure configurations remain aligned to business needs and solution design.
* Support Customer Success and Sales teams by sharing platform adoption updates and operational insights where relevant.
* Document configurations, update process guides, and contribute to reusable knowledge and best practices.

**What Makes You Qualified?**

**Must Have Qualifications**

* 3–5 years of experience in CCaaS, managed services, technical support, or platform operations.
* Working knowledge of Sprinklr CCaaS or similar platforms such as Genesys, Cisco, or other contact center technologies.
* Experience with queues, routing, workflows, dashboards, SLA setup, or case management.
* Foundational understanding of IVR, telephony concepts, chatbot workflows, and platform automation.
* Basic knowledge of API, CRM integration concepts, and cross-system workflow dependencies.
* Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and configuration support skills.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Exposure to digital and social engagement channels.
* Understanding of customer support operations and service KPIs.
* Experience supporting user training and onboarding.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.

**Who You Are**

  

* Detail-oriented and hands-on with a strong execution mindset.
* Comfortable working in customer-facing, fast-paced support environments.
* A collaborative team player with growing technical and consulting skills.
* Focused on quality, platform stability, and customer success.

**What Success Looks Like**

  

* Accurate and reliable platform configurations.
* Stable day-to-day CCaaS operations and timely issue resolution.
* Strong support for customer adoption and user onboarding.
* Consistent contribution to operational efficiency and customer outcomes.

**We focus on our mission**: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.

* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

**We invest in our people**: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.

To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.

To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

**EEO - Our philosophy**: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.

Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.

If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

b53dbbe7.title: Advisory Solutions Engineer
b53dbbe7.description:
**Introduction**
At IBM Global Sales, we bring together innovation, collaboration, and expertise to help clients solve their most complex business challenges. Working across industries and geographies, you'll partner with colleagues, clients, and partners to co-create solutions that drive digital transformation and lasting impact.Success in Global Sales is built on curiosity, empathy, and collaboration. You'll connect technical understanding with strong people skills, building trusted relationships and shaping solutions that improve business and society. With world-class onboarding, continuous learning, and a supportive culture, IBM offers the tools and opportunities to grow your career. Join us and be part of a global team that's passionate about driving innovation and making a difference.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**

* Deep Expertise Development: Cultivate an in-depth understanding of Confluent’s technologies and the intricacies of building streaming applications.
* Technical Discovery and POC/Pilot Solutions: Collaborate with Confluent solutions engineers to gather requirements, identify use cases, and facilitate the development of Proof of Concept (POC)/Pilot solutions. Aid customers in overcoming technical challenges during initial blueprinting and use case deployment.
* Prospect Demos and Evangelization: Collaborate seamlessly with Confluent's Account Executives (AEs) and Sales Development Representatives (SDRs) to bring our offerings to new prospects. Craft and deliver tailored demos that go beyond the standard, showcasing the unique value proposition Confluent has to offer.
* Customer Engagement: Offer technical assistance in driving customer consumption through monthly customer health reports, Quarterly Business Reviews, and Quarterly Technical Reviews.
* Knowledge Sharing, Workshops, and Training: Support cross-functional teams, including Field Marketing, Partner Solutions by conducting training sessions and workshops/webinars for customers, partners, prospects, and internal teams to educate them on Confluent's platform/cloud, features, and best practices.
* RFP/Vendor risk assessment Support: Contribute to vendor risk assessments to ensure a comprehensive understanding of potential risks and opportunities associated with proposed solutions. Assist in answering Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and Requests for Quotations (RFQs).
* Technical Artifact Creation and Maintenance: Architect, build, and maintain reusable artifacts, including tools, prototypes, demos, workshops, and architecture blueprints.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Solutions Engineering or similar work experience in a technical pre-sales capacity.
* Process & Efficiency, a “scale” mindset. An ability to quickly leverage standardized demo environments, template proposals, and documented Proof of Concept (PoC) scopes to minimize preparation time.

Experience with Event-Driven architecture, Data Integration & Processing Techniques, Database & Data Warehouse technologies.
  
  

* First-Hand exposure to Cloud Architecture, Migrations, Deployment & Application Development.
* Experience with Automation, GitOps and Kubernetes.
* Proficiency in Java, Python or SQL.
* Development or implementation experience in a cloud-based environment, along with Technical certifications (e.g., Cloud Developer/Architect, Data Engineering & Integration).
* Clear, consistent demonstration of self-starter behavior, a desire to learn new things and tackle hard technical problems.
* Managing multiple evaluation processes across various industry verticals and use cases, ability to be nimble and organized is a must
* Exceptional presentation and communications capabilities to all levels across an organization.
* Ability to explain complex concepts in plain, non-technical language that resonates with mid-level managers and business owners.
* Fluency in English is a requisite.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* Previous experience building solutions with Apache Kafka.
* Understanding of systems operations concepts (disk, network, operating systems, etc).
* Experience with software development tools, infrastructure automation, and CI/CD tooling (Terraform, Ansible) is a plus
* Experience building and operating large scale systems.
* Experience in technical pre-sales or consultative roles.

b2332bac.title: Senior Solution Consultant IT - JD Edwards
b2332bac.description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
You’ll join a passionate and high-paced team working at the heart of Volvo Group’s transformation. Together, we are building the digital manufacturing system of the future — where data, automation, and people unite to redefine how sustainable power solutions are made and delivered to the world.
  
  
Our department is on a bold journey — transforming and modernizing our IT landscape to enable Volvo’s vision of becoming a fully agile, data-driven company. With strong investments, cutting-edge technologies, and a shared mindset for continuous improvement, we’re creating the digital foundations that will power tomorrow’s production and distribution systems.
  
  
We’re reimagining end-to-end processes, driving transformation, and unlocking the full potential of data to shape smarter, more efficient, and more sustainable operations. Our environment is international, multicultural, and full of opportunities to grow — both personally and professionally.
  
  
Our technology stack is diverse and future-oriented, built on a solid mix of COTS and SaaS solutions that we continuously evolve to meet the demands of the next generation of manufacturing.
  
  
**Who are you?**

* 12+ years of experience in the end-to-end Finance module (AR,AP,GL,Service Billing,India Localization) processes is a strong advantage, as is familiarity with ERP(JD Edward) or COTS systems supporting business-critical operations.
* You’re more than a Solution Consultant — you’re a connector, visionary, and problem-solver who turns business needs into digital realities. You thrive at the intersection of people, data, and technology, ensuring that every solution we build truly matters.
* As a Requirement Solution Engineer, you act as the vital link between our business and development teams. You capture what the business truly needs — and why — translating it into solutions that bring measurable value.
* Every day, you collaborate with stakeholders, architects, and engineers to create digital capabilities that move us toward Volvo Group’s ambition of becoming a fully agile and data-driven organization.
* You take pride in understanding complex business challenges and transforming them into actionable insights.
* You guide teams through the process — from refining requirements and ensuring architectural alignment to maintaining the highest standards in quality, security, and performance.
* You don’t just deliver solutions; you shape experiences that empower the business to grow and evolve.
* Curiosity drives you. You explore emerging technologies, new methodologies, and best practices to find smarter, more sustainable ways of working. You’re comfortable navigating change and thrive in an environment where collaboration, learning, and innovation go hand in hand.
* To succeed in this role, you bring both technical understanding and business insight — and you know how to connect the two. You have hands-on experience working close to the business, identifying needs, and transforming them into digital solutions that truly create value.
* You are used to translating business challenges into clear, actionable requirements and guiding development teams toward successful outcomes. You understand how to balance strategic thinking with operational excellence — seeing the bigger picture while making sure every detail fits.
* You’ve worked closely with Solution Architects, Developers, and Testers, and you know how to bridge communication between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* You bring a strategic mindset and a collaborative spirit. You know how to listen, connect, and inspire. You take ownership of results, lead with curiosity, and always keep the end user in focus. You communicate clearly, work seamlessly across teams and cultures, and make things happen — from concept to delivery.

**Ready for the next move?**
Did we catch your attention - Join our ride today and help us make a difference for the future of sustainable power solutions.
  
  
At Volvo Group, we believe in the value of in-person collaboration and connection. Our general principle is that employees work from the office.
  
  
Volvo Group never requests any form of payment or fees from candidates at any stage of the recruitment process. Any such demand is a scam. To view the authentic job description and apply securely, please visit: Jobs at Volvo Group
  
  
We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
  
  
**Who We Are And What We Believe In**
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
  
  
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join
**Volvo Group**
. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.
  
  
**Volvo Group Digital Technology & Operations (DTO)**
is a new division. The organizational set up is structured around domains, digital products with functions for digital excellence to deliver outstanding customer experience.
  
  
Joining the new DTO division means being part of a fast-moving digital product-oriented organization where teams truly own what they build from idea to delivery. In DTO, we work in agile, cross-functional teams, mastering the latest technology, and creating outstanding digital experiences that make a real difference for our colleagues and Volvo Group customers around the world. We put people first and build our culture on trust, passion, customer success, change, and performance. If you want to grow, collaborate across functions and entities, and help shape the future of digital products within Volvo Group, DTO is a great place to be.
  
  
In some countries and for specific positions within Volvo Group Digital Technology & Operations, background checks may be required, in accordance with local laws & regulations. If this is applicable to the role you have applied for, you will be informed.

94ebe382.title: SFDC Architect
94ebe382.description:
We are seeking an experienced **Salesforce Solution Architect** with 10+ years of experience to lead the design, development, and evolution of enterprise Salesforce solutions supporting global B2B and B2C business operations.The ideal candidate will combine strong solution architecture capabilities with hands-on Salesforce technical expertise. The role requires someone who can translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions, guide development teams, make sound architectural decisions, and write or debug code when required.The architect will work across multiple Salesforce applications, external enterprise systems, country-specific business processes, and cross-functional technology teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards and long-term business objectives.**Key Responsibilities1. Solution Architecture and Design**

* Own end-to-end Salesforce solution architecture, from requirements discovery through design, implementation, deployment, and production support.
* Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce architectures, technical designs, data models, integration patterns, and implementation roadmaps.
* Evaluate standard Salesforce capabilities, configuration, declarative automation, custom development, and external services to recommend the most appropriate solution.
* Define architectural standards, reusable components, coding guidelines, design patterns, and technical best practices.
* Assess the impact of proposed changes on existing applications, integrations, business processes, and future enhancements.
* Identify technical risks, scalability constraints, platform limitations, and opportunities for simplification.

**2. Hands-on Salesforce Development**

* Write, review, debug, and optimize Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and other Salesforce customizations when required.
* Develop proof-of-concepts and technical prototypes to validate architectural decisions and resolve complex technical challenges.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of Apex triggers, asynchronous processing, Batch Apex, Queueable Apex, platform events, transaction management, and governor limits.
* Ensure code follows bulkification, security, exception-handling, testability, and performance best practices.
* Review complex implementations and guide developers in resolving technical issues.
* Participate directly in critical development activities, production troubleshooting, and performance optimization when necessary.

**3. Salesforce Data Modeling and Governance**

* Design scalable Salesforce data models using standard and custom objects, appropriate relationships, and well-defined ownership and sharing strategies.
* Define data mastership, external identifiers, deduplication, matching, data migration, and reconciliation approaches.
* Design data models that support global customer identities, B2B relationships, B2C customer journeys, and country-specific business requirements.
* Ensure appropriate data access, privacy, auditability, and regulatory considerations are incorporated into the architecture.

**4. Integration Architecture**

* Design and govern integrations between Salesforce and enterprise platforms such as SAP, customer portals, identity providers, middleware, and marketing platforms.
* Define suitable integration patterns using REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architecture, asynchronous processing, and middleware where appropriate.
* Address authentication, authorization, idempotency, retries, error handling, monitoring, reconciliation, and integration resilience.
* Collaborate with enterprise integration and platform teams to manage dependencies, API contracts, release sequencing, and system-wide changes.

**5. Global Platform and Release Governance**

* Support a global Salesforce platform operating across multiple countries and business markets.
* Balance global architecture standards with legitimate local business and regulatory requirements.
* Evaluate the impact of changes across countries, applications, integrations, and downstream systems before approving designs.
* Coordinate with business stakeholders, development teams, QA, DevOps, security, and platform teams to ensure controlled delivery.
* Contribute to release planning, technical risk assessments, environment strategy, deployment readiness, and production stability.
* Prevent unnecessary customization and architectural fragmentation across markets.

**6. Technical Leadership and Team Enablement**

* Provide technical direction and architectural guidance to Salesforce developers, technical leads, QA engineers, and integration teams.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, design walkthroughs, and technical knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Establish development standards and reusable patterns that improve code quality, maintainability, and developer productivity.
* Mentor team members and support technical decision-making across distributed teams.
* Communicate architectural decisions, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.

**7. Platform Evolution and Continuous Improvement**

* Evaluate new Salesforce capabilities and recommend adoption based on business value, technical fit, and platform strategy.
* Identify opportunities to improve performance, reduce technical debt, simplify integrations, and optimize delivery costs.
* Contribute to Salesforce platform roadmaps and long-term architecture decisions.
* Support production incident analysis and implement sustainable solutions that prevent recurring issues.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud and Experience Cloud.
* Hands-on experience with Apex, Triggers, LWC, SOQL, Salesforce security, and declarative automation.
* Strong understanding of Salesforce data modeling, sharing and visibility, governor limits, transaction boundaries, and platform architecture.
* Experience designing enterprise integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and asynchronous or event-driven patterns.
* Understanding of integration resilience, error handling, monitoring, data reconciliation, and API security.
* Experience with Salesforce deployments, source control, CI/CD, and release management.
* Familiarity with enterprise identity and access management, SSO, OAuth, and external identity solutions.
* Ability to diagnose complex technical issues and validate architectural decisions through working code or prototypes.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and customer engagement integrations.
* Exposure to Salesforce Data Cloud and/or Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud.
* Experience with SAP or other ERP integrations.
* Experience with middleware and integration platforms such as MuleSoft, SnapLogic, Informatica, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience with multi-country Salesforce implementations and global platform governance.
* Experience with Experience Cloud portals, external users, customer identity, and large-scale customer data management.
* Familiarity with consent management, customer data privacy, and market-specific regulatory requirements.

**Experience and Qualifications**

* Typically 10+ years of Salesforce or relevant enterprise CRM experience.
* Demonstrated experience owning solution architecture for complex Salesforce implementations.
* Proven experience leading technical teams and collaborating across business and technology functions.
* Salesforce Application Architect certification preferred; System Architect or relevant advanced certifications are an advantage.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills.

**Success Criteria**The successful candidate will be expected to:

* Deliver scalable and maintainable architecture aligned with enterprise standards.
* Make defensible design decisions with clear consideration of alternatives, risks, and trade-offs.
* Independently validate critical technical designs through code, prototypes, debugging, and code reviews.
* Minimize regression risk across existing systems, integrations, and country implementations.
* Improve engineering standards and enable development teams to deliver consistently.
* Maintain a balance between architectural leadership and hands-on technical contribution.

**Role Expectation**This is an architecture-led role with hands-on technical responsibilities. The candidate is not expected to spend every day implementing features, but must be capable of independently writing and debugging Apex and related Salesforce code when complex technical challenges, critical issues, or architectural validation require it.

Pay: ₹3,000,000.00 - ₹4,000,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

Global Head IS Enterprise Architecture

\_\_

The IS Architect within the Enterprise Architecture team supports the development, adoption and continuous improvement of enterprise architecture standards, reference architectures, methodologies and governance practices across ABB. Working closely with Enterprise and Domain Architects, the role contributes to the definition and maintenance of architecture principles, standards and reusable architectural assets, helping ensure consistency, alignment and optimization of the IS landscape.

The role reports to the **Enterprise Architecture Practice & Governance Lead** and has no direct reports  
  
The work model for the role is: hybrid

* 6+ years of experience in Enterprise, Domain, Solution Architecture, technology consulting, or a related architecture discipline.
* Strong understanding of enterprise architecture principles, frameworks, standards, governance processes, and reference architectures.
* Experience with architecture methodologies and modeling tools, preferably TOGAF and Ardoq.
* Knowledge of architecture reviews, compliance assessments, and exception management processes.
* Experience working within complex, decentralized, matrix, or multi-division organizations.

157bf7f5.title: Solution Architect, Public Sector India
157bf7f5.description:
**Company Description**
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
As the Solution Architect for Public Sector India, you'll be the technical lead for ServiceNow's entry into the Indian public sector. You'll turn government digitisation programs into solution blueprints, proof of concepts, and winning bids, with AI at the centre of the story.
  
  
**Purpose**
Design and deliver AI-led architectures aligned with the India AI Mission & ministry priorities, proof of concepts, and tender responses that win public sector business in India and build trust with government technology leaders and SI partners.
  
  
**India Public Sector Context**

* Who we serve: central ministries, state governments, PSUs, regulators, smart city and urban bodies, and digital public infrastructure programs.
* Where ServiceNow fits: citizen grievance and service delivery, case management, GRC, IT operations for large government estates, workflow over legacy systems, and AI-assisted operations.
* How deals happen: tender-led (RFP/RFQ, GeM), SI and partner-led bids, price-sensitive evaluation, long sales cycles.
* What shapes the design: data residency, MeitY-empanelled cloud, CERT-In and security audits, the DPDP Act, and Make in India preferences.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with Public Sector BD & Sales Leads for the GTM plan for Central and State Ministries, Public Sector Banks and Higher Education / Universities
* Lead architecture sessions with government CIO, IT, and NIC teams, translating program goals into actionable blueprints.
* Own the technical response on RFPs and tenders: compliance matrices, architecture, sizing, and clarifications.
* Build and run proof of concepts and demos across AI, workflow, and integration that prove value in days, not weeks.
* Design within government constraints: hosting, data localisation, security, AI governance, and integration with legacy and national platforms.
* Co-sell with SIs and partners on solution scope, bid strategy, and delivery handoff.
* Partner with Sales, Solution Consultants, Specialists, Product, and Legal on deal strategy and risk.
* Work with regional AI experts to shape and validate AI solutions and proof of concepts.
* Build reusable India public sector assets: reference architectures, AI use-case patterns, an RFP response library, and a compliance FAQ.
* Mentor Solution Consultants on public sector sales motions.

**Qualifications**
**To be successful in this role you have:**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
* 8-10 years of exclusive public sector pre-sales experience (government, PSU, or SI/OEM on government programs).
* Excellent communication: executive presence, storytelling, and strong written and verbal skills. Able to simplify complex architecture for non-technical decision makers and earn credibility with CIOs, senior officials, and SI architects.
* AI fundamentals (LLMs, agents, RAG, data readiness, responsible AI and governance), with the drive and capacity to reach expert level within 12-18 months.
* Expertise in AI architecture, workflow automation, data & analytics, and integration frameworks
* Proven track record on tenders and RFPs, with fluency in procurement and compliance requirements.
* Depth in enterprise workflow or ITSM platforms (ServiceNow preferred; fast ramp expected if not), plus integration, API, data, and automation architecture.
* Trusted advisor on deal strategy, not only demos.
* Based in, or willing to relocate to, NCR (New Delhi), with regular travel to government offices

**Good To Have**

* Hands-on ServiceNow experience, including Now Assist and AI Agents.
* Familiarity with MeitY empanelment, GeM, CERT-In, the DPDP Act, and the IndiaAI Mission.
* Existing government and SI network.

**What We Offer**

* A structured AI upskilling path to expert level over 6-12 months.
* Direct access to regional AI experts for design, proof of concepts, and deal support.
* Ground-floor ownership of a new vertical in India.

TR21
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
**Work Personas**
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity Employer**
ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.
  
  
**Accommodations**
We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.
  
  
**Export Control Regulations**
For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

e7b0f120.title: Sr. Application Architect
e7b0f120.description:
**Description**
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Application Architect to design and deliver modern, cloud-native applications for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India customers. In this role, you will own the technical architecture of complex customer engagements, from application assessment and modernization strategy through design, build, and production go-live. You will advise senior customer engineering leaders on how to re-architect, migrate, and modernize their application portfolios on AWS.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect with deep software engineering and IT consulting experience and a proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed applications for enterprise customers. You can work through ambiguous problems with limited guidance and make sound architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on the highest standards, and enjoy mentoring engineers and turning proven patterns into reusable assets for the wider team.
  
  
You will lead technical workstreams made up of AWS consultants, partners, and customer developers, and set the architecture direction across microservices, containers, serverless, APIs, data integration, and DevOps practices. You are expected to write and review code, produce architecture artifacts, run design reviews, and resolve technical risks before they affect delivery. You will also support pre-sales by shaping solution designs and estimates, earn customer trust through technical credibility, and use AI/GenAI (including AI-assisted development tools) to speed up how applications are designed and built.
  
  
In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Application Architecture Delivery Practice Manager.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
  
  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
* Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
* Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC)/ AI-assisted software engineering, from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
* Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
* Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
* Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
* Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
* Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
* Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
* 10+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
* 10+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
* 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Travel up to 30% of the time

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 6+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
* Experience with designing and building application using AWS services such as Lambda, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Kubernetes
* Experience in one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C
* Experience in professional, non-internship software development, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
* Experience with CloudFormation, Chef, Puppet, Salt, or Ansible in production environments
* Familiarity with AI-DLC / AI-assisted software engineering, data preparation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and deploying Generative/Agentic AI solutions

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. **Lead Solution Architect- Bespoke Applications, Azure & Digital Modernization**
**Role family:**
Business Consulting / Solution Architecture
  
  
**Technology focus:**
Azure, web, mobile, APIs, microservices and integration
  
  
**Ideal Candidate**
A customer-oriented Lead Solution Architect who combines broad architectural thinking with hands-on engineering credibility. The candidate should be able to navigate from business problem to solution strategy, defend choices with senior stakeholders, and guide multidisciplinary teams toward a secure, scalable, supportable and commercially viable outcome.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Own end-to-end architecture and presales solutioning for bespoke application engagements, translating business needs into secure, scalable and delivery-ready solutions across modern user experiences, cloud-native platforms, integration and application modernization.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Lead Solution Architect will provide technical and consulting leadership across complex bespoke application opportunities and transformation programs. The role combines customer-facing presales, application architecture, business and technical analysis, cloud-native engineering, estimation, migration planning and delivery governance. The successful candidate will shape pragmatic solutions that balance business outcomes, user experience, security, operability, cost, risk and delivery feasibility.
  
  
Application Solution Architect
  
  

* Lead customer discovery, architecture workshops, and solution definition from opportunity qualification through proposal, solution defence, and transition to delivery.
* Own end-to-end architecture across user experience, applications, APIs, integration, data, security, Azure cloud, DevSecOps, observability, and service management.
* Translate business and technical requirements into target architectures, modernization roadmaps, estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and delivery-ready artefacts.
* Assess legacy applications, technical debt, cloud readiness, and non-functional requirements; define rationalisation and migration strategies using the 6R approach.
* Design scalable web, mobile, microservices, event-driven, and cloud-native solutions, selecting technologies based on fit, maintainability, and delivery context.
* Lead RFI/RFP/RFQ solutioning, including technical proposals, effort and cost estimates, delivery models, presentations, proofs of concept, solution defence, and commercial clarifications.
* Guide design, development, migration, code reviews, testing, CI/CD, security, and resolution of complex engineering risks.
* Partner with sales, bid management, delivery, security, cloud, data, service, and commercial teams to ensure solutions are competitive, executable, and supportable.
* Establish architecture standards, reusable patterns, governance, and quality gates, and provide leadership through mobilisation and early delivery.
* Coach architects and engineering teams and contribute to reference architectures, accelerators, playbooks, and knowledge assets.

Core Technical Capabilities
  
  

* Application architecture: Layered and modular design, domain-driven principles, microservices, event-driven patterns, APIs, integration, and cloud-native design.
* Modernisation and migration: Application rationalisation, 6R assessments, technical-debt analysis, monolith decomposition, containerisation, migration sequencing, and roadmap development.
* Cloud and engineering: Azure hosting, serverless and container patterns, identity, data services, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated testing, observability, SRE-aligned operability, and FinOps-aware decisions.
* Design and development: Responsive web and mobile solutions, accessibility, usability, design systems, coding practices, code reviews, testing strategy, and engineering-quality controls.
* Programming and frameworks: TypeScript, JavaScript, NativeScript, Angular, React, Flutter, Spring Boot, and Node.js.
* Analysis and delivery: Requirements elicitation, process and capability analysis, functional decomposition, NFR definition, dependency analysis, solution option assessment, backlog shaping, sprint planning, and Agile architecture governance.
* Architecture governance: Context, component, deployment, integration, data, security, and NFR views; decision records; traceability; architecture reviews; standards compliance; risk management; and handover criteria.

c8daaf52.title: Sr. Application Architect
c8daaf52.description:
**Description**
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Application Architect to design and deliver modern, cloud-native applications for AWS Professional Services (ProServe) India customers. In this role, you will own the technical architecture of complex customer engagements, from application assessment and modernization strategy through design, build, and production go-live. You will advise senior customer engineering leaders on how to re-architect, migrate, and modernize their application portfolios on AWS.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a hands-on architect with deep software engineering and IT consulting experience and a proven track record of delivering large-scale distributed applications for enterprise customers. You can work through ambiguous problems with limited guidance and make sound architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience. You thrive in a fast-paced, growth environment, insist on the highest standards, and enjoy mentoring engineers and turning proven patterns into reusable assets for the wider team.
  
  
You will lead technical workstreams made up of AWS consultants, partners, and customer developers, and set the architecture direction across microservices, containers, serverless, APIs, data integration, and DevOps practices. You are expected to write and review code, produce architecture artifacts, run design reviews, and resolve technical risks before they affect delivery. You will also support pre-sales by shaping solution designs and estimates, earn customer trust through technical credibility, and use AI/GenAI (including AI-assisted development tools) to speed up how applications are designed and built.
  
  
In this capacity you will be based in India and are expected to travel occasionally (30-40%). You will report into the India ProServe Application Architecture Delivery Practice Manager.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
  
  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
* Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
* Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC)/ AI-assisted software engineering, from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement.
* Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
* Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
* Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
* Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
* Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
* Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth

0b759049.title: Infrastructure Solution Architect (Network & Cloud)
0b759049.description:
Shape the Future of Cloud & Capacity Services as a Solution Architect
  
  
**Are you ready for the next step in your career?**
Join us as a
**Solution Architect – Cloud & Capacity**
and play a key role in ensuring reliable, scalable, and cost-conscious cloud and infrastructure services across India and Asia. In this senior individual-contributor role, you will combine architecture expertise with service delivery ownership, translating business needs into practical solutions while driving operational excellence throughout the service lifecycle. You will work across Microsoft Azure, Amazon Web Services (AWS), and hybrid infrastructure environments, collaborating with regional stakeholders, infrastructure teams, and external providers to support business-critical services and transformation initiatives. This is an opportunity to directly influence reliability, performance, capacity, and efficiency across a complex technology landscape.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Lead platform and service architecture across Microsoft Azure, AWS, and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Manage the full service lifecycle, balancing availability, performance, security, scalability, and cost.
* Oversee service delivery and supplier performance, ensuring agreed SLAs and KPIs are achieved.
* Coordinate incident, problem, and change management activities with internal teams and service providers.
* Drive capacity and performance management through forecasting, demand planning, right-sizing, and lifecycle management.
* Partner with security and global teams to align cloud governance and security controls with established standards.
* Strengthen backup, recovery, and disaster recovery readiness across assigned services.
* Promote FinOps practices, automation, and cost optimization initiatives across Azure, AWS, and capacity services.
* Coordinate and support cloud and infrastructure migration projects, including planning, testing, cutover preparation, and operational handover.
* Collaborate with regional and global stakeholders to manage schedules, risks, dependencies, documentation, and service readiness.

Expectations from you
  
  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
* At least 8 years of infrastructure experience.
* Strong expertise in Microsoft Azure or Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Ability to manage architecture and service delivery responsibilities across both cloud platforms.
* Solid understanding of hybrid infrastructure, compute, virtualization, storage, backup, and capacity/performance management.
* Experience in solution architecture and service delivery management.
* Proven experience with service-level management, operational improvement, and supplier coordination.
* Experience coordinating and supporting infrastructure migrations and projects.
* Advanced English communication skills and the ability to work effectively with business stakeholders, global teams, and external providers.
* Experience with both Azure and AWS, Infrastructure as Code, automation, FinOps practices, ITIL, or cloud certifications is considered an advantage.

To succeed in this role
  
  
Success in this role comes from your ability to combine strong cloud architecture expertise with disciplined service delivery ownership. You focus on ensuring reliability, capacity, security, and cost efficiency across Azure, AWS, and hybrid infrastructure environments while effectively coordinating stakeholders, suppliers, and project activities. Your experience in infrastructure operations, migrations, and continuous service improvement enables you to make a measurable impact across India and Asia.
  
  
We Also Expect You To Align With Valmet’s Leadership Principles—practical Behaviors That Guide How We Lead, Collaborate, And Succeed Together
  
  

* Take accountability – Act with ownership, set clear expectations, and follow through
* Lead with courage – Champion change, try bold ideas, and learn quickly
* Build on trust – Listen to understand, be open, and create psychological safety
* Collaborate for growth – Work across boundaries, value diverse perspectives, and focus on customer value

We offer
  
  
In this role, you will join an environment where cloud architecture, service delivery, and infrastructure transformation come together. You will work closely with regional stakeholders, IT Infrastructure teams, and external service providers to maintain and enhance critical cloud and capacity services across India and Asia. The role offers meaningful ownership spanning architecture, operations, governance, capacity planning, cost optimization, and migration initiatives. You will have the opportunity to influence key technology decisions while supporting reliable and efficient services that enable business success. Working across Azure, AWS, and hybrid infrastructure, you will contribute to both day-to-day operational excellence and long-term service development.
  
  
Valmet offers an inspiring and challenging position with opportunities to contribute to international operations and work with modern technologies. We value continuous learning, collaboration, and professional development while providing an environment where people can grow their expertise and make a meaningful impact.
  
  
When everything works together
  
  
*Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers; we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.*
*At Valmet, diversity of thought drives innovation. We are committed to a respectful and inclusive environment, where people can be themselves and are supported to contribute at their best. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and make hiring decisions based on skills, experience, and potential, never on personal characteristics such as gender, gender identity, age, ethnicity, nationality, disability, neurodiversity, religion, sexual orientation, or political views.*
*Join the team – and lead the way with us!*

61ba4b00.title: Managed Services Consultant - Lead
61ba4b00.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.

By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.

Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.

**Job Description**
-------------------

**Role Summary**

Lead managed services delivery for Sprinklr CCaaS customers, driving platform configuration, optimization, and adoption across digital and voice ecosystems. Act as a hands-on solution lead ensuring scalable design, strong customer outcomes, and continuous value realization.

**What You’ll Do**

  

* Translate customer business requirements into best-practice CCaaS solutions aligned to Sprinklr capabilities and defined solution blueprints.
* Own and manage end-to-end configurations across omnichannel workflows, routing, IVR, case management, SLA frameworks, and automation.
* Manage and maintain core configuration architecture, ensuring alignment with customer blueprints, supportability, and scalability standards.
* Configure and optimize advanced routing models including skills-based routing, priority logic, queue segmentation, and escalation workflows.
* Design and enhance IVR flows, voice queue logic, call routing paths, and contact center workflow automation.
* Build and optimize bot workflows, conversational AI journeys, and automation frameworks to improve containment, productivity, and customer experience.
* Drive platform adoption by aligning features to customer use cases, usage patterns, and operational objectives.
* Monitor and improve customer contact center operational metrics such as SLA adherence, AHT, queue performance, response times, productivity, and CSAT.
* Identify platform gaps and optimization opportunities and implement best practice solutioning to improve efficiency and service outcomes.
* Manage post go-live changes, releases, configuration updates, and continuous platform improvements across the customer lifecycle.
* Support and guide API, CRM, telephony, and third-party system integrations to enable connected workflows and unified service operations.
* Lead training and onboarding sessions for agents, admins, and customer teams to drive adoption of workflows, tools, and operating practices.
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to identify new opportunities, drive platform consumption, and support upsell/cross-sell discussions.
* Act as the primary technical and functional point of contact, advising stakeholders on solution design, adoption strategy, and operational improvements.
* Leverage AI and automation opportunities to improve ROI, efficiency, and service performance.

**What Makes You Qualified?**

**Must Have Qualifications**

* 5+ years of experience in managed services, CCaaS, or technology consulting.
* Strong hands-on experience with Sprinklr CCaaS or similar platforms such as Genesys, Cisco Webex Contact Center, Twilio Flex, or comparable solutions.
* Strong knowledge of IVR, routing strategies, queue management, chatbot workflows, case management, and SLA configurations.
* Experience designing and supporting omnichannel customer journeys across digital and voice channels.
* Understanding of telephony concepts such as VoIP, SIP, CTI, and ACD.
* Experience with API, CRM, and third-party integrations.
* Hands-on experience in system configuration, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business needs into platform solutions.

**Good to Have Skills**

* Exposure to AI-driven support models, automation use cases, and digital deflection strategies.
* Experience with social and digital engagement platforms.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with understanding of customer service KPIs.
* CCaaS certifications such as Genesys, Cisco, or Avaya preferred.

**Who You Are**

  

* A strong technical consultant with an ownership mindset.
* Able to independently manage customer outcomes and multiple engagements.
* Skilled at balancing hands-on delivery with stakeholder engagement and solution guidance.
* Customer-focused, solution-oriented, and driven by continuous improvement.

**What Success Looks Like**

  

* High platform adoption and improved operational performance across customer accounts.
* Strong customer retention and measurable expansion opportunities.
* Successful delivery of scalable, optimized, and well-governed CCaaS solutions.
* Recognition as a trusted advisor for day-to-day platform and service improvements.

**We focus on our mission**: Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.

* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

**We believe in our product**: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

**We invest in our people**: We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.

To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.

To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

**EEO - Our philosophy**: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.

Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.

If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

**Description**
---------------

Job Title: DevOps Architect

Job Description:
  
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated DevOps Architect to join our dynamic team. As a DevOps Architect, you will play a pivotal role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our DevOps practices, infrastructure, and tools. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the seamless integration of our microservices architecture, utilizing a range of technologies. If you are passionate about creating robust, scalable, and efficient DevOps solutions and have a deep understanding of both cloud and on-premise environments, we encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities:

Design, architect, and implement end-to-end DevOps solutions that support our microservices architecture, ensuring seamless integration of dotnet and Java applications.
  
Lead efforts in setting up, configuring, and managing Kubernetes clusters on on-premise VMs and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) to ensure high availability, scalability, and performance.
  
Collaborate with development and operations teams to enhance our CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GIT, automating deployment processes and ensuring code quality.
  
Oversee the integration and management of essential tools such as Kafka, Keycloak, nginx, Ocelot API gateway, MS SQL, MongoDB, KSQLDB, Kafka connect, and Schema registry, ensuring optimal performance and reliability.
  
Fine-tune Kubernetes based container orchestration for production workloads, implementing best practices for monitoring, logging, and alerting.
  
Provide expertise in cloud and on-premise networking, optimizing network configurations for both environments to ensure secure and efficient communication between services.
  
Stay updated with industry trends and emerging technologies, recommending and implementing innovative solutions to enhance our DevOps practices.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  
Total of 10+ and 3+ years of proven experience as a DevOps Architect or in a similar role, with a track record of designing and implementing successful DevOps strategies for complex microservices architectures.
  
Strong expertise in Kubernetes, including hands-on experience with setting up and managing clusters on both on-premise VMs and Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  
Proficiency in building and optimizing CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and GIT.
  
Extensive experience with tools and technologies related to microservices architecture, such as Kafka, Keycloak, nginx, Ocelot API gateway, MS SQL, MongoDB, KSQLDB, Kafka connect, and Schema registry.
  
Solid understanding of containerization, container orchestration, and related technologies.
  
Excellent cloud and on-premise network understanding, with the ability to design and optimize network configurations for secure and efficient communication.
  
Strong understanding of security standards and frameworks such as CIS, FIPS etc and expertise in Kubernetes security hardening.
  
Excellent scripting and programming skills (Python, Bash, etc.).
  
Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IAC) tools such as Ansible and Terraform, with a track record of automating complex infrastructure deployments.
  
Experience in customer-facing interactions, including addressing technical concerns and conducting solution demonstrations.
  
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

Relevant certifications in DevOps, Kubernetes, Azure, or related areas.
  
Experience in the banking or financial industry.
  
Previous exposure to polyglot applications using dotnet and Java.
  
If you are an innovative thinker, a problem solver, and a collaborative team player with a passion for creating robust DevOps solutions, we invite you to join our team and help shape the future of our banking applications.

**Job Title:**
2S IT CBS Lead Manager
  
  
**Department**
: ISPL, CIB 2S CBS
  
  
**About Business Line/Function**
Cross‑Business Solutions (CBS) is a transversal function within BNP Paribas Corporate & Institutional Banking that centralises and coordinates all transversal related activities across the 2S business lines.
  
  
The focus is on scaling up and standardizing processes, systems, and technologies to achieve operational efficiency and consistency. This may involve implementing new technologies, such as automation, robotics, or artificial intelligence, to enhance productivity and reduce costs. The team will also work on developing and implementing standardized processes, procedures, and metrics to measure performance and drive continuous improvement.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
The primary purpose of this role is to lead 2S India project team, stay close to code and act as the techno-functional point contact for operations, business, Infosec and Infrastructure. Architecture direction is set with the platform architect and you own its execution.
  
  
The technical lead is responsible to drive the delivery, support and stability of our custody and depository platforms. The estate is mixed: the core is Java/J2EE with Spring, Angular and Oracle, alongside .Net and MS SQL Server components.
  
  
And provide end‑to‑end managerial and delivery oversight for the newly created CBS teams in Mumbai, ensuring seamless recruitment, onboarding, and performance excellence while championing employee engagement and strict adherence to global processes and quality standards.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Technical management & coordination**

* Coordinate day to day with operations and vendors - Track and reduce technical debt, false-positive analysis, hardening and closure of audit observations and remediate vulnerabilities.
* Lead, mentor and review the work of developers.
* Manage deployments with versioned artifacts and rollback plans.
* Translate solution design into deliverables work with estimate and task breakdown.
* Improve CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and code quality scanning (SonarQube, Snyk etc.).
* Run requirement elicitation, gap analysis and impact assessment with Operations users. Produce clear functional and technical specifications and support SIT/UAT, release and hypercase.
* Lead L3 support and incident resolution with root cause analysis and permanent fixes
* Participate in DR/BCP tests, prepare evidence and close findings.

**Team Building & Onboarding**

* Lead the recruitment of new CBS talent in Mumbai, coordinating with HR to define profiles, interview, select, and onboard staff quickly and efficiently.
* Design and execute structured onboarding programmes that accelerate time‑to‑productivity

**Operational Oversight**

* Directly supervise day‑to‑day activities of CBS staff in Mumbai, ensuring smooth delivery of services and alignment with global operating models.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs), service‑level agreements (SLAs), and quality metrics; intervene promptly to resolve deviations.

**Employee Engagement & Development**

* Foster a high‑performance culture through regular coaching, performance reviews, and career‑development plans.
* Organize engagement initiatives (Peer‑recognition program) to maintain morale and retention.

**Process & Quality Governance**

* Ensure all team activities comply with global 2S IT processes, regulatory requirements, and internal quality frameworks.
* Conduct periodic audits and drive continuous‑improvement projects to mitigate operational risks.

**Issue Mitigation & Escalation Management**

* Identify emerging operational issues, perform root‑cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for critical incidents, coordinating response with global support functions.

**Specific Qualifications**

* 12+ years of experience with at least 5+ years managing cross‑functional teams and Techno management role
* Strong understanding of banking systems and related business processes
* Hands on technical credibility with an eye for business impact & ownership and accountability for delivery and production stability.
* Excellent communication and influencing skills across senior‑level business and technology stakeholders.
* Very good experience in regulatory and control-heavy environment.

**Behavioral Skills**

* Strong Communication & Interpersonal skills
* Analytical Ability and Critical thinking
* Team Player

**Education Level:**
Bachelor Degree or equivalent
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporates and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg.
