82b946a4.title: Delivery Manager
82b946a4.description:
Please note that we will only be able to accept candidates who have the appropriate rights and documentation for employment in India.

**Who We Are.**

Axi is a leading global provider of margin and deliverable Foreign Exchange, Contracts for Difference (CFDs), and Financial Spread betting. Our business has evolved into a world-class, multifaceted brokerage with offices in six regions. With heavy investment in the latest trading technology, Axi seeks to offer the most comprehensive end-to-end trading experience available, servicing traders of all levels from beginners to institutional-level clients.

**Let's talk about the cool stuff you will do at Axi!**

We are looking for an experienced
**Delivery Manager**
to drive the successful delivery of strategic technology initiatives across our global engineering teams. You will be responsible for owning the delivery lifecycle from planning through execution, ensuring projects are delivered on time, at the highest quality, and with predictable outcomes. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-growing fintech organization where you'll lead transformation initiatives, partner with cross-functional stakeholders across global regions, and leverage modern technologies and AI-driven tools to continuously improve delivery excellence.

**Your EDGE Assignment / You Will**

**Delivery Cadence**

* Define, document, and continuously improve the team's delivery cadence — sprint/iteration length, ceremony schedule (planning, refinement, review, retro), and reporting rhythm.
* Ensure the cadence is followed: ceremonies happen on schedule, with the right people, producing real decisions.
* Adapt cadence to the needs of different workstreams (e.g., a fast-moving feature team vs. a compliance-heavy workstream) without fragmenting the organisation into inconsistent processes.

**Stage Gate Ownership**

* Own the criteria for moving work between stages (e.g., Discovery → Ready for Build → In Progress → Review → Release) and enforce them consistently.
* Act as the checkpoint before work advances: confirm acceptance criteria are met, dependencies are cleared, risk/compliance sign-offs are in hand, and Definition of Done is completed.
* Act when something is not ready and explain exactly what is missing and what is needed to pass the gate.
* Track and report exceptions/waivers when a gate is bypassed and ensure it is a deliberate decision.

**Delivery Planning**

* Build delivery plans grounded in real data: backlog sizing (story points/estimates), team velocity history, known dependencies, and risk.
* Convert scope and velocity into realistic timelines and communicate them as ranges with clear assumptions and confidence levels.
* Re-forecast the plan on a regular cadence (e.g., every sprint) as scope, velocity, or risk changes, and proactively flag slippage.
* Maintain visibility tools (burnup/burndown, roadmap views, RAID logs) that let stakeholders self-serve status.

**Cross-Team Coordination & Reporting**

* Be the primary point of contact for delivery status to leadership and stakeholders — translating team-level detail into a clear picture of progress, risk, and trade-offs.
* Identify and actively manage cross-team dependencies, blockers, and resourcing conflicts before they hit the critical path.
* Facilitate trade-off conversations (scope vs. time vs. quality) with data.

**Process Ownership & Continuous Improvement**

* Own the delivery process documentation (workflow stages, gate criteria, estimation method, ceremony structure) and keep it current, e.g. in Confluence.
* Run retrospectives that produce real process changes.
* Balance rigor with pragmatism — add process where it removes risk or ambiguity and remove process if not needed.

**Are you the one?**

* 8+ years in a Delivery Manager, Scrum Master, Program Manager, or Technical Project Manager role, ideally spanning multiple teams or workstreams.
* Demonstrated experience running Agile/Scrum (or Kanban/hybrid) delivery cadences end-to-end — not just attending ceremonies but designing and improving them.
* Hands-on experience with story-point estimation, velocity tracking, and forecasting delivery timelines from that data.
* Proven ability to hold a line on process/quality gates under deadline pressure, with the communication skill to do so without becoming a bottleneck or being seen as purely a blocker.
* Strong stakeholder management — comfortable presenting status, risk, and trade-offs to senior leadership.
* Fluency with delivery tooling (Jira, Confluence, or equivalent) and building reporting views (burnup/burndown, roadmaps, dashboards) that reduce manual status-chasing.
* Hands-on exposure to tools such as Postman and Datadog, with an interest in leveraging AI to improve delivery and operational efficiency.
* Proven experience delivering technology transformation initiatives, including system migrations, process transitions, or Global Capability Centre (GCC) setup and transition projects.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; able to turn ambiguous, fast-moving work into a clear plan and a clear narrative.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience in [industry — e.g., fintech, trading platforms, regulated environments], particularly where compliance/risk sign-off is part of the stage-gate process.
* Certification such as CSM, PSM, SAFe, or PMP (useful signal, not a substitute for hands-on experience).
* Experience introducing or maturing a delivery process in an organization that didn't previously have one.

**Axi's bag of delights**

* Competitive and attractive compensation.
* Extensive learning opportunities including professional certifications and soft-skills development.
* 18 annual leave days and 12 sick leave days per year.
* Public holidays as declared by local government.
* Maternity leave as per law.
* Health insurance coverage.

**Axi's interview journey**

* Talent Acquisition Round – 45 Minutes
* Hiring Manager Interview – 1 Hour
* Technical Interview - 1 Hour
* Final Interview – 1 Hour

Please note that our organization works with recruitment agencies on a pre-approved basis only. A recruitment agency that wishes to submit candidate profiles or resumes for consideration must obtain prior written consent from our talent acquisition team. We do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, and we will not be responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Should we receive an unsolicited resume from a recruitment agency that does not have prior written consent, we will not be responsible for the payment of any fees related to the recruitment of the candidate represented in the unsolicited resume.

At Axi, we prioritize creating a workplace that upholds fairness and respect for all. We encourage every individual within our community to contribute towards a culture where everyone feels a sense of belonging and is treated with the dignity they deserve. We make all employment-related decisions—whether in hiring, compensation, training, performance reviews, or termination—based on merit and without bias, ensuring equal opportunities for everyone. We consciously work to identify and overcome any unconscious biases, with a commitment to fostering an inclusive environment where every employee and candidate feels genuinely welcomed and valued.

66754a99.description:
**Responsibilities & Key Deliverables**
---------------------------------------

As the Program Manager for the K2 Platform at Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing the planning, execution, and monitoring of vehicle program deliverables in alignment with the Mahindra New Product Development (NPD) process. Your responsibilities will include:

* Strategically planning and managing project timelines, milestones, and deliverables to ensure on-time and on-budget completion of vehicle development programs.
* Identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks throughout the program lifecycle by collaborating closely with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to resolve bottlenecks promptly.
* Leading the creation and maintenance of dynamic dashboards and reporting tools that provide real-time visibility into project health, critical paths, and key performance indicators for management review.
* Updating project health status and communicating critical path developments to the management team every fortnight, enabling informed decision-making and proactive issue resolution.
* Driving IT-enabled Project Management Office (PMO) initiatives such as developing engineering release portals, online dashboards, and other digital tools to streamline program tracking and enhance transparency.
* Liaising with the NPD Quality Assurance team to coordinate progress on gateway reviews and secure Start of Production (SOP) clearances, ensuring compliance with quality and regulatory standards.
* Maintaining commercial acumen by evaluating and contributing to business cases for new programs, ensuring that financial objectives align with project goals.
* Preparing and delivering comprehensive management review presentations that synthesize progress reports, risk assessments, and strategic plans to senior leadership.

You will be expected to foster cross-functional collaboration, cultivate a problem-solving mindset within the team, and champion continuous improvement in program management processes, facilitating the successful launch of innovative vehicle products.

**Experience**
--------------

The ideal candidate will bring 5 to 8 years of professional experience in program or project management, ideally within the automotive or related manufacturing sectors. This experience should encompass:

* End-to-end management of complex product development programs, demonstrating hands-on expertise in planning, executing, and closing projects with multiple stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
* Proven track record of effectively managing risks, issues, and dependencies in fast-paced environments, ensuring alignment with organizational priorities and timelines.
* Demonstrated use of project management tools such as MS Project, with capability to design and maintain project dashboards and reporting systems that track progress against critical milestones.
* Experience collaborating with quality assurance teams to navigate product gateway approvals and SOP readiness checkpoints within a structured development process.
* Acumen in commercial evaluation of programs including understanding financial metrics like Internal Rate of Return (IRR) and payback periods to inform program feasibility and prioritization decisions.
* Previous involvement in delivering presentations and status reports to senior management and executive leadership.
* Competitive knowledge of product lifecycle management and an understanding of design and engineering processes, even if not directly involved in design activities.

This extensive experiential background will enable the Program Manager to strategically steer projects to successful completions and effectively contribute to product innovation and business growth.

**Industry Preferred**
----------------------

The preferred industries for sourcing talent for this role include:

* Automotive manufacturing companies specialising in vehicle production, engineering, and new product introductions.
* Tractor and farm equipment manufacturers with experience in program management of large-scale engineering projects.
* Allied sectors related to heavy vehicle production, agricultural machinery, and related industrial machinery companies where complex new product developments are executed.

Professionals from these industries are typically well-versed in the demands of rigorous product development cycles and have experience managing large, cross-functional initiatives aligned with commercial and engineering priorities.

**Qualifications**
------------------

This role requires formal qualifications and relevant professional experience to successfully navigate the complexities of program management within product development environments. The ideal qualifications include:

* A Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) degree or equivalent in a relevant engineering discipline such as Mechanical, Automotive, or Industrial Engineering.
* Demonstrable program management experience specifically aligned with new product development initiatives or vehicle program executions.
* Additional certifications in project or program management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) would be advantageous but are not mandatory.

These qualifications provide the foundational knowledge and skills to effectively plan, monitor, and report on multifaceted engineering programs while coordinating cross-functional efforts aligned with business objectives.

**General Requirements**
------------------------

We seek candidates who embody a strong set of competencies and personal attributes essential for success in this role, including:

* **Excellent Communication Skills:** Ability to clearly and concisely convey complex information to diverse stakeholders and team members, fostering transparency and collaboration.
* **Enabling and Problem-Solving Mindset:** Proactive in identifying challenges and enabling solutions through effective collaboration and resourcefulness.
* **Strong Attention to Detail:** Vigilant in recognizing potential issues early and addressing them before they escalate, ensuring quality and timely delivery.
* **Ownership and Accountability:** Demonstrates an end-to-end ownership attitude, taking responsibility for project outcomes while motivating teams to meet deliverables.
* **Collaborative Approach:** Empathetic to team perspectives and skilled at harmonising diverse viewpoints towards common goals.
* **Technical Proficiency:** Hands-on experience with MS Project for scheduling and tracking; familiarity with product lifecycle management processes; basic understanding of engineering design fundamentals (preferred but not mandatory); knowledge of Teamcenter PLM systems beneficial.
* **Commercial Awareness:** Understanding of financial evaluation techniques such as Internal Rate of Return (IRR) and payback analysis to contribute to sound business decisions within program management.

**Our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion**
------------------------------------------------------

At Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd, we are deeply committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where every individual is respected and valued. We believe that diversity in our workforce drives innovation, creativity, and the overall success of our business. Our commitment entails:

* **Equal Opportunity:** Providing fair access to employment opportunities and career development regardless of race, gender, age, disability, sexual orientation, religion, or background.
* **Inclusive Culture:** Promoting a work environment where differences are embraced and all voices are heard, ensuring a sense of belonging for all employees.
* **Accessible Processes:** Implementing recruitment, onboarding, and development practices that support the participation of people with varied abilities and experiences.
* **Continuous Learning:** Encouraging ongoing awareness, training, and education on diversity, equity, and inclusion to build respectful, collaborative teams.

Through these commitments, we strive to attract, retain, and nurture talented professionals who share our values and contribute to pioneering solutions within the Farm Division and beyond.

**About the job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. 7e66566d.title: Program Manager 4
7e66566d.description:
**Job Description**
This role will lead complex technical programs, establishes scope and milestones, improves cross-team processes, automates reporting, and acts as a technical liaison across stakeholder teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Primary Responsibilities**
**Program Ownership**

* Lead one or more major GPU Cluster Health domains such as strategic customer availability, partner repair execution, RMA/spares governance, data/reporting framework, repair workflow improvement, or engineering platform tooling.
* Translate availability gaps into structured programs with scope, owners, milestones, KPIs, risks, dependencies, and executive-ready status.
* Drive weekly operating rhythm for assigned domains, including KPI review, blockers, escalations, decisions, and follow-through.

**Customer and Horizontal Leadership**

* Support the vertical/horizontal TPM model by owning either a customer vertical or a horizontal functional area.
* For vertical ownership, lead availability and repair strategy for assigned strategic customers and customer clusters.
* For horizontal ownership, lead cross-cutting programs such as NVIDIA/AMD partner tracking, SDE/SRE tooling, RMA/spares feedback loop, SOP tracking, or metrics/reporting framework.

**KPI Definition and Governance**

* Define KPI measurement methods for repair health, including cluster availability, unavailable-host backlog, repair cycle time, repair success rate, reopen rate, spare availability, RMA loop performance, partner responsiveness, and SLA/SLO adherence.
* Drive consistent reporting standards across TPMs and support teams.
* Identify trends across multiple workstreams and convert them into prioritized corrective actions.

**Cross-Functional Execution**

* Partner with India, Morocco, and Mexico SDE/SRE teams to identify tooling and first-level support needs.
* Prioritize tooling requirements that reduce manual repair coordination, improve triage, automate reporting, or accelerate repair handoffs.
* Work with GSL, CHS, CPV, TRS, Warminator , and data center operations to remove repair blockers.
* Support incident-style escalation for clusters at availability risk.

**Continuous Improvement**

* Lead post-program retrospectives and drive process updates.
* Standardize repeatable playbooks, intake processes, escalation paths, and repair governance artifacts.
* Identify automation opportunities and advocate for prioritization.

**Expected Outcomes**

* Major repair programs have clear objectives, metrics, owners, and measurable improvement .
* Leadership has reliable visibility into customer cluster health and repair risk.
* Repair blockers are resolved through structured governance instead of ad hoc escalation.
* Tooling and reporting requirements are translated into actionable SDE/SRE work.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.
  
  
Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

4ba747d7.description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience in program management.
* Experience with Enterprise Mobility Management (EMM) or Mobile Device Management (MDM) platforms, such as Zero-Touch or Android Management API.
* Experience designing device managed services across camera, connectivity, power, or AI stacks.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* 5 years of experience managing cross-functional or cross-team projects.
* 5 years of experience architecting enterprise technical roadmaps or scaling mobile enterprise solutions.
* Experience collaborating with cross-functional executive stakeholders to drive technical roadmaps across mobile devices, Android OS, or cloud ecosystems.
* Experience architecting end-to-end AI/ML solutions for enterprise applications.
* Experience with advanced wi-fi protocols for large-scale enterprise mobile device deployments.

**About The Job**
A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers.
  
  
The Pixel Enterprise Engineering team is dedicated to empowering enterprises and SMBs by equipping them with the most secure, intelligent, and productive devices on the market. We sit at the intersection of premium Pixel hardware and Google’s unmatched software ecosystem seamlessly bringing together the power of advanced AI, the flexibility of Android, and the collaborative strength of Google Workspace. We collaborate closely with Customer's Engineering, Product, and Business teams, we dive deep into our customers' unique operational challenges. This cross-functional alignment allows us to architect, suggest, and implement highly customized, innovative solutions that directly address specific business pain points. Our commitment spans the entire customer lifecycle. From the initial discovery phase and proof-of-concept pilots to full-scale fleet deployments, we are on the ground ensuring seamless integration. Once a fleet is operational, we act as a real-time consulting and support engine troubleshooting challenges, optimizing device performance, and helping businesses future-proof their operations by rapidly deploying new functionalities as they emerge on the Pixel roadmap.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define the long-term enterprise solutions roadmap, aligning with executive leadership across Google’s hardware, Android OS, and cloud ecosystems.
* Architect AI-driven Enterprise solutions to solve large enterprise use cases considering customer’s competing requirements such as privacy, power, latency, and TCO (Total Cost of Ownership).
* Advocate innovative approaches to solve enterprises customer unique work flows encompassing expertise in different domains OS, Connectivity, Power, Camera, MDM/EMM.
* Anticipate shifts in global Security, regulatory and Compliance frameworks to architect proactive security solutions of highly regulated industries (e.g., Finance, Healthcare, Defense).
* Foster a high-performing collaboration culture through talent development and perspectives, while acting as a strategic partner to executive leadership.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. 936dc815.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
936dc815.description:
**About Tekion**
Positively disrupting an industry that has not seen any innovation in over 50 years, Tekion has challenged the paradigm with the first and fastest cloud-native automotive platform that includes the revolutionary Automotive Retail Cloud (ARC) for retailers, Automotive Enterprise Cloud (AEC) for manufacturers and other large automotive enterprises and Automotive Partner Cloud (APC) for technology and industry partners. Tekion connects the entire spectrum of the automotive retail ecosystem through one seamless platform. The transformative platform uses cutting-edge technology, big data, machine learning, and AI to seamlessly bring together OEMs, retailers/dealers and consumers. With its highly configurable integration and greater customer engagement capabilities, Tekion is enabling the best automotive retail experiences ever. Tekion employs close to 3,000 people across North America, Asia and Europe.
  
  
**Summary**
The Senior Technical Program Manager drives large-scale, cross-functional technical initiatives that are critical to Tekion’s business and product strategy. This role is responsible for end-to-end program leadership, ensuring alignment across engineering, product, and operational teams while delivering complex programs on time and within scope. The ideal candidate is a seasoned program leader with strong technical depth, stakeholder management experience, and a track record of delivering in high-growth environments.
  
  
**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Lead the execution of high-impact technical programs involving multiple teams, systems, and stakeholders
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Security, and other functions to define scope, success metrics, and delivery plans
* Identify and proactively manage program risks, dependencies, and trade-offs; escalate as needed to unblock progress
* Establish clear operating cadences, including status reporting, stakeholder communication, and executive updates
* Drive clarity and accountability across workstreams, ensuring alignment with company goals and product milestones
* Mentor junior TPMs and contribute to developing best practices, templates, and tools for the TPM function
* Influence strategic planning and roadmapping with a program-centric execution lens

**Qualifications**

* 6–8 years of experience in technical program management, software delivery, or engineering leadership
* Proven track record of leading complex technical programs in fast-paced or high-growth environments
* Deep understanding of software development, system architecture, and agile methodologies
* Exceptional stakeholder engagement, conflict resolution, and communication skills
* Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, and other project management and collaboration tools
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field; advanced certifications (e.g., PMP, SAFe) a plus

**Current Tekion Employees: Please apply via the Internal Job Board in Ashby**

2344b3db.title: Solution Engineering
2344b3db.description:
**Overview**
our purpose is to empower organizations to transform the way they work by harnessing the full potential of artificial intelligence. We guide customers through the evolving digital landscape, enabling them to unlock new opportunities, enhance productivity, and deliver exceptional employee and customer experiences. By integrating advanced AI capabilities across devices, cloud platforms, and everyday business applications, we help organizations realize seamless, innovative, and secure solutions that drive sustained growth and success in the AI era.
  
  
As a Solution Engineer in the AI Business Solutions – Copilot team, you will lead technical engagements that drive AI transformation for enterprise customers. Your mission is to win technical decisions and accelerate adoption of Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Copilot Studio & Agents, and related solutions by delivering compelling demos, envisioning sessions, and scalable architectures. You will act as a trusted advisor, guiding customers through secure, compliant, and value-driven implementations that align with their enterprise strategies.
  
  
This role is pivotal in shaping the future of work by enabling customers to realize the full potential of AI-powered productivity. You will collaborate closely with sales, customer success, engineering, and partner teams to remove technical blockers, generate pipeline, and ensure seamless handoffs for deployment and adoption. Your success will be measured by technical wins, customer adoption, partner engagement, and your contributions to a high-performance, learning-oriented team culture
  
  

* Drive AI transformation by orchestrating complex technical engagements across multiple stakeholders.
* Lead architecture design for secure, scalable solutions aligned with enterprise strategy.
* Mentor IC3–IC4 engineers and lead peer learning sessions to elevate team capability.
* Influence product and go-to-market strategy by providing structured feedback to engineering and sales leadership.
* Proactively identify and escalate unresolved technical blockers through formal channels.
* Champion compliance, diversity, and inclusion by modeling ethical behavior and inclusive practices

**Responsibilities**

* Lead AI transformation engagements (e.g. demos, pilots) to win technical decisions and drive customer commitment to Copilot/Agents, including documented adoption plans and a smooth hand-off to Customer Success/partners for usage onboarding.
* Support AI Workforce SSP hunting effort by engaging w/customer contacts, lead qual., and partner co-sell opportunities
* Assist in ME3 , ME5 , ME7 , Agent 365 upsell opportunities focused on Teams Phone that require technical support, and bring in a partner for co-sell.
* Generate new pipeline and competitive wins for M365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Copilot Studio & Agents, ME3 and Frontline Worker by delivering impactful AI-powered demos/Art-of-Possible sessions, removing technical blockers, and highlighting Microsoft’s differentiation to secure deals and protect the install base.
* Craft scalable, secure, and modular architectures that align to customer’s enterprise strategy and technical roadmap while embedding security at every level.
* Maintain operational excellence with 100% deal hygiene – capture technical close plans and consumption plans in MSX for every opportunity, attach a partner to every qualified deal, and promptly escalate unresolved technical blockers.
* Continuously upskill to meet role expectations (achieve L200 consultative and L400 technical depth certifications) and contribute to team excellence by sharing at least one deal win/loss insight per quarter and engaging in regular coaching.

**Qualifications**
Core Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8-10 years of Experience in pre-sales, solution engineering, technical consulting, or customer-facing technical roles.
* Strong understanding of Microsoft Copilot technologies, Generative AI, and AI-powered productivity solutions.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Knowledge of Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Power Platform, and Azure AI services.
* Understanding of Microsoft 365 workloads such as:

+ Microsoft Teams
+ SharePoint
+ Outlook

**Our Mission**
At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Who We Are**
In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!
  
  
We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
  
  
**Job Summary**
****Our Mission****
At Palo Alto Networks®, everything starts and ends with our mission:
  
  
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
  
  
We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren’t easy goals to accomplish – but we’re not here for easy. We’re here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
  
  
We’re changing the nature of work. Palo Alto Networks is evolving to meet the needs of our employees now and in the future through FLEXWORK, our approach to how we work. From benefits to learning, location to leadership, we’ve rethought and recreated every aspect of the employee experience at Palo Alto Networks. And because it FLEXes around each individual employee based on their individual choices, employees are empowered to push boundaries and help us all evolve, together.
  
  
**Your Career**
The Solutions Consultant is the evolution of the traditional Sales Engineering role, aligning how we best serve our customers in understanding their environment, providing solution guidance and ensuring value realization in their investment with Palo Alto Networks. As a Solutions Consultant you provide technical leadership and expertise and guidance in your customer’s security transformation journey. As a Solutions Consultant for IT/ITeS, you will be part of the core technical team, architecting solutions for large IT/ITeS customers in the region. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives and ensuring value realization of their investment with Palo Alto Networks. You evangelize our industry leadership in on-prem, cloud, and security operations services that establish PANW as your customer’s cybersecurity partner of choice.
  
  
**Your Impact**
**Role**
Curiosity is core to the Solutions Consultant role, and you see complex problems as opportunities to learn and deliver innovative solutions! You define your impact by:
  
  

* Meeting and exceeding sales quotas by building and implementing strategic, technical account plans that target cross-platform solutions.
* Your ability to position, demonstrate and create high level designs across the entire PANW portfolio based on customer business needs.
* Conducting discovery to understand and articulate the key technical, operational, and commercial imperatives of your prospects and customers
* Working closely with Professional Services, Customer Success and Specialist teams to ensure overall customer implementation and adoption of solutions.
* Demonstrating strong communication skills and the ability to influence through effective presentations and customer-specific demos, technical engagements, and workshops
* Leading successful technical validation efforts based on best practices to ensure technical win in assigned opportunities.
* Orchestrating supporting resources (Specialists, Channel Resources, Customer Support) to ensure a one-team approach that demonstrates a cohesive strategy
* Promoting end-to-end solutions that include PANW and/or partner professional services to ensure customers realize business value sooner
* Understanding the competitive landscape and effectively differentiating our leadership
* Continuously investing in yourself to develop technical and professional skills that drive your ever-increasing contributions to success of our customers while actively participating within the Solutions Consultant community and at industry events
* (OT) - Identifying technical stakeholders and cultivating relationships with key personas to build and drive a security architecture transformation roadmap

**Qualifications**
**Your Experience**

* Understanding of data networking and/or modern application design and cloud architectures
* Delivering cybersecurity solutions that solve technical challenges and influence new business initiatives
* Influencing and gaining buy-in from key stakeholders, either in a customer-facing or internal role; prior experience in a pre-sales role is ideal
* Creating and delivering technical presentations, workshops, or technical validation engagements
* Experience in selling, designing, implementing, or managing one or more of the following solutions: Network Security, SASE, SaaS, CNAPP and/or SOC Transformation Technologies
* Partnering with Customer Support functions to ensure successful implementation and adoption of sold solutions

Our Solutions Consultant team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire,and empower our potential clients in their journey to transform their security architectures.

You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. Our Solutions Consulting community is driven by the mission to be our customers’ cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting their digital way of life.

**Business Applications**
team is hiring now and we’re looking for our next
**D**

to join us. The role has an immediate start and would be on a permanent contract.
  
  
The Microsoft Business Group is a cloud-first, full-service Microsoft partner committed to delivering innovative technology solutions that solve human challenges. We are compelled by our core values to drive transformational results for clients across all company sizes, geographies and industries. The Cognizant Microsoft Business Group team delivers full lifecycle solutions—from project inception and planning, through deployment to ongoing support and maintenance.
  
  
**Why should you work at Microsoft Business Group?**
Multi Award Winning Business
  
  
Official and Award-Winning Microsoft Partner
  
  
Award Winning Databricks Partner

Cloud Native Organisation

Private Medical Insurance
  
  
Employee Assistance Programme

**What impact will you have in this role?**
The ideal candidate will be an ambitious and enthusiastic consultant who will nurture needs and deliver Microsoft Business Applications solutions for existing and prospective clients. Working with the Business Analysis, sales professionals’ practice and client teams to design, build, oversee, and implement solutions using the Power Platform and Dynamics 365 customer engagement first-party applications. You should be experience in articulating architectural designs in written form, with the ability to explain complex concepts in clear. concise form that can be understood by Business stakeholders.
  
  
**What will the Dynamics 365 CE and Power Apps Pre-Sales Consultant be doing day to day in their role?**
Supporting Microsoft Business Group sellers, Cognizant sellers, client partners and customer relationship managers and Microsoft co-selling to win Dynamics 365 F&O work with existing and new customers, both proactive outgoing initiatives and responding to incoming requests, RFPs, ITTs and Frameworks.
  
  
As the Dynamics CE , leading initial discovery with customers to establish their needs, outcomes and how these can best be supported through Dynamics CE, wider Power Platform and embracing Agentic AI
  
  
Identifying and creating with MBG Offering Team Industry and cross industry go to market solutions, supporting as the subject matter expert marketing and other promotional campaigns.
  
  
Advising customers on the fit of Microsoft Dynamics CE and the wider Power Platform to their environment, infrastructure, functional and non-functional needs, and their compliance requirements
  
  
Work on and support the completion of response to customer demand. These could be a simple and straight forward PoC that requires architectural review, or a complex enterprise architecture
  
  
Have excellent interpersonal skill and be able to work in a wide, diverse group of stakeholders.
  
  
Have experience of taking a concept at enterprise level, create the scope (temporal, financial, resource) and translate this into an executable design that competitive positions us well in the market, using the appropriate levers to deliver a compelling bid.
  
  
**What type of experience does the Dynamics 365 CE and Power Apps Pre-Sales Consultant need to be successful in this role?**
Must have over 10+ years of experience in Microsoft stack with strong experience working as a Technical Consultant or Solution Architect in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE (CRM)
  
  
Strong understanding of Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE and experience of working on full life-cycle implementations across Dynamics 365 CE Sales, Service, Customer Insights , Power Apps, Power Apps and preferably Field Services too.
  
  
Deep understanding of Co Pilot Agentic AI solutions and their fit within and around Dynamics CE

Understanding of high-level solution architecture and fit of Dynamics CE solutions within customers target environment
  
  
Ability to lead response to clients such as RFP’s, RFIs, POC, Discovery and Demonstrations.
  
  
Ability to take an aspiration design and turn it into an executable design
  
  
Experienced in data integration and data migration
  
  
Experience with onsite/offshore delivery models
  
  
Experience with defined frameworks (MVC, Entity Framework and Enterprise Library)
  
  
Strong client facing communication skills
  
  
Experienced providing Pre-Sales demonstrations.
  
  
Good experience and knowledge of
  
  
Microsoft Azure
  
  
**What education and certification credentials are needed for this role?**
Educated to degree level or equivalent
  
  
TOGAF certified ideally
  
  
Certified in an Agile methodology
  
  
Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE/CRM certification (preferably Dynamics 365 Customer Service and Sales– MB-210 to 240) is highly desirable

We encourage our team members to meet with our customers in person for at least 20% of the time they are working together. Sometimes this requires travel outside of normal working hours.

a069a758.title: Presales Manager
a069a758.description:
**Job Description**
**Ciklum**
is looking for a
**Presales Manager**
to join our team full-time in India.
  
  
We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Presales Manager will anchor presales for designated territories, driving strategic sales support and bid management from opportunity qualification through to deal closure. This role blends solution expertise with proposal leadership to deliver high-quality responses, compelling demonstrations, and winning value propositions. The ideal candidate brings a proven track record in IT services presales—spanning product engineering, AI, cloud, and data solutions—along with strong leadership capabilities and the ability to collaborate across functions to accelerate revenue growth.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the end-to-end presales process from opportunity qualification to closure
* Support the identified Markets team to develop and execute go-to-market strategies, focusing on closing deals and meeting sales targets
* Work closely with the GTM teams during the presales phase to gain understanding of client’s business challenges, requirements, and objectives
* Create high-quality proposals and RFP (Request for Proposal) responses. Ensure the solution is clearly articulated, including technical, operational, and financial aspects
* Create client-facing presentations to effectively communicate Ciklum’s service offering, solution description, pricing & engagement models, etc.
* Partner with internal stakeholders including service lines, delivery, architects, subject matter experts (SMEs), and product managers to ensure the feasibility and quality of proposed solutions
* Work on market analysis, specific client research, white space analysis, analyze competitive landscapes to understand market positioning and adjust proposals accordingly to maximize win rates
* Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends, technologies, and competitors’ offerings to develop differentiated solutions
* Maintain flexible working hours to ensure consistent alignment with the GTM team and accommodate client discovery calls and presentations across time zones, as needed

**Requirements**

* Experience Level: 10+ years of overall experience in the IT services Industry, with min of 7years+ of Presales experience in the areas described above
* Technical Expertise: Must have strong IT Services knowledge - product engineering, AI & ML, Data Engineering & analytics, cloud computing, mobile, customer experience and other cutting-edge technologies.
* Communication Skills: Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills to effectively communicate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Consultative Selling: Ability to engage in solution-based selling and create value propositions that resonate with clients
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field
* MBA from a recognized institute (preferred in Marketing, IT, or Strategy)
* Presales certifications (APMP, etc.) and relevant technology credentials (AWS, Azure, Salesforce, ITIL, TOGAF, etc.) are an advantage

**What’s in it for you?**

* Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
* Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
* Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
* Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
* Care: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

**About Us**
At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.
  
  
India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.
  
  
**Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!**
Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

**Who We Are**
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Global Sales**
at HPE is about building the future. We are redefining what’s next and combining our legacy of innovation with a bold new goal to accelerate everything we do. Our sales organization is comprised of 10,000+ professionals in sales, presales, service, and support functions. Together with our partners, we deliver global, commercial, public sector & small/medium business customers throughout 11 geographies. We’re transforming businesses. Join us redefine what’s next for you.
  
  
**Job Family Definition**
Responsible for architecting solutions that will support Partners in achieving their customers' business outcomes across the HPE Private Cloud AI portfolio (hardware, software, services, and as a service offerings) in combination with all necessary third-party components (e.g. ISV integration). Develops and articulates compelling, accurate, and relevant proposals and ensures customer's business and technical requirements are met. Can be aligned to a specific area of technical expertise (e.g., products, solutions, services). Provides technical expertise to sales teams and customers (through sales presentations, product/solution demonstrations, etc.) aimed at gaining the customer mindshare within their domain. These jobs focus on technical selling to customers/partners. May be aligned to specific accounts based on business priority.
  
  
**Management Level Definition**
Contributions impact technical components of HPE products, solutions, or services regularly and sustainable. Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to solve complex business issues and is regarded as a subject matter expert. Provides expertise and partnership to functional and technical project teams and may participate in cross-functional initiatives. Exercises significant independent judgment to determine best method for achieving objectives. May provide team leadership and mentoring to others.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**What you’ll do:**

* Demonstrates in-depth knowledge in one or more solution domains, company products, services, and solutions as well as the customer’s technical and business environment.
* Develops compelling customer proposals and critically reviews them, manages the expectations of internal stakeholders and customers, ensuring the meeting of customer’s business and technical requirements are met.
* Quantifies the impact of the business problem(s), positions business value, identifies the strengths and weaknesses of the overall proposed solution to achieve long-term business objectives.
* Provides input to all global business units to address IT trends, requirements, gaps, or unmet needs.
* Translates outcome-based solutions into a functional solution design that aligns to the customers business needs, and then translates that functional design into a technical design and architecture that can be scaled to accommodate growth.
* Communicates how the solution value propositions addresses customer business needs.
* Tracks leading-edge and emerging technologies.
* Contributes to industry development for one or more domains through conferences (content support/presentations, demos, booth support) and industry events, while also monitoring social media.
* Incorporates an understanding of technology trends within the IT industry, as well as the customer’s industry.
* Actively gathers and applies competitive intelligence as a critical component of account support.
* Drives the Account Business Planning process, leveraging knowledge of industry trends and the customer’s technical environment.
* Participates in deep-dive discussions and partners with the account team to build customer relationships at all levels by advocating and presenting technical strategies for a customer's transformation.
* Produces in-depth comparative analysis of alternative approaches to meet solution requirements.
* Develops, configures, and right sizes an optimal workload solution, balancing cost, scope, scale, boundaries, and benefits to deliver superior value and increase the win rate.
* Leverages deep knowledge of partner products and services and adjusts strategies to leverage the relationship between the service provider/partner and the customer.
* Successfully transfers knowledge to external partners to deliver effective solutions to customers.
* Proactively builds the pipeline by identifying opportunities (e.g., enhancements, unmet or unrecognized needs, up-selling, and cross-selling opportunities) within the account.
* Monitors the account pipeline and nurtures active deals from the opportunity to close.
* Uses pipeline insights to help prioritize activities in a way that ensures time, and resources are invested wisely in pursuit of deals with the highest potential.
* Actively participates in sales forecast meetings and provides feedback to accelerate the sales lifecycle.
* Documents ongoing work (activities, tasks) throughout the sales cycle using specific tools and resources and sharing best practices with peers and partners to collaborate more effectively.
* Builds strong professional relationships with customer key executives across the business and industry.
* Proactively shares knowledge with peers and helps develop more junior team members.

**Education And Experience**
**What you need to bring:**

* First-level university technical degree or equivalent technical qualifications. Advanced degree in technology preferred.
* 8–12 years of technical experience in IT with a focus on technical consulting and solution selling
* Knowledge-based as well as 1+ experienced-based relevant industry certifications very strongly preferred.
* Enterprise architecture frameworks and project management methodologies and certifications are helpful, but not required.

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Advanced experience participating in and leading solution configurations and the creation of demos and proofs-of-concept (POC) to meet customer requirements.
* Advanced understanding of the company portfolio of products, software, services, solution domain specialization, adjacent solution domain(s), and how they can be combined to address customer needs.
* Advanced ability to translate aaS and complete ecosystem, differentiated value, solutions, and workloads and ability to prioritize aaS offerings and consumption models that will achieve the customer’s outcomes and greatest return.
* Advanced understanding of aaS business model variations.
* Advanced ability to collaborate cross-functionally to ensure consistency of output and meet aaS strategic goals.
* Advanced written and verbal communication skills, including active listening and storytelling, and the ability to communicate in English and applicable local languages as needed to perform job requirements.
* Demonstrates advanced discussion and persuasion skills used to support company point-of-view, while respectfully questioning and challenging proposed solutions.
* Advanced business and financial acumen—sales cycle, pipeline growth, reporting, ability to influence, business strategy linkage— with an understanding of functional responsibilities of various customer business roles, including typical KPIs important to, CxOs and line-of-business (LOB) executives; knowledgeable about TCO/ROI concepts and calculations, financial models, and understand how customers generate revenue.
* Advanced consultative/value selling skills, including, whiteboarding, objection handling, and closing skills to proactively help customers make business decisions.
* Advanced company business knowledge, technical tools, and standard customer relationship management (CRM) systems and tools.
* Advanced resource management skills, including how and when to effectively engage SMEs/specialists.
* Hands on experience with one or more products, solutions, tools, or services aligned to respective job responsibility.
* Ability to design and develop a playbook for demonstrations or walk throughs of products, solutions, tools, or service.
* Ability to deliver live demonstrations or walk throughs of products, solutions, tools, or service to customers, partners, and other stakeholders.
* Advanced project and time management knowledge or experience with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, including appropriate due diligence.
* Advanced knowledge of partner offerings and how/when to leverage them for deals within an area of specialization, understanding of the company's go-to-market strategy.
* Advanced understanding of Geo application of company’s go-to-market strategy as it relates to partners; has broad knowledge of partner offerings, along with how/when to leverage them for deals.
* Advanced strategic planning and account planning skills, as well as being an expert at using business and technical tools, and standard customer relationship management (CRM) systems.

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

1b2f040f.description:
**Company Description**
  
HackHalt Cyber Intelligence Council is a Section 8 organization committed to combating cybercrime worldwide and strengthening digital safety for individuals, businesses, and government bodies. The company focuses on AI-driven cybersecurity and advanced research to proactively identify, prevent, and respond to emerging threats. Its work is structured around four core pillars: Prevention, Education, Detection, and Rapid Response, offering a comprehensive approach to cyber risk management. Supported by more than 40 global partners and a track record of training over 10,000 individuals by 2026, HackHalt is building resilient cyber ecosystems and empowering the next-generation cyber workforce.
  
**Role Description**
  
This is a full-time, remote Cybersecurity Pre-sales (Commission Based) role focused on supporting the growth of HackHalt’s cybersecurity solutions and services. The individual in this position will engage prospective clients, understand their security challenges, and present tailored technical and business value propositions. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting needs assessments, participating in discovery calls, preparing demos and presentations, and collaborating with technical teams to design solutions aligned with client requirements. The role also involves responding to RFPs/RFIs, creating proposal documents, supporting proof-of-concept engagements, and maintaining accurate records of opportunities and client interactions. The position is commission-based, requiring strong initiative, goal orientation, and the ability to build and maintain long-term professional relationships.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Cybersecurity and Information Security skills, with a solid understanding of common threats, controls, and risk management principles.
* Candidates should possess Network Security skills, including familiarity with firewalls, intrusion detection/prevention systems, and secure network architectures.
* Candidates should possess Application Security skills, such as awareness of secure coding practices, vulnerability assessment, and common application-layer attack vectors.
* Candidates should possess broad Cyber domain knowledge, including current threat landscapes, industry compliance standards, and security frameworks.
* Relevant experience in pre-sales, solution consulting, or technical sales within the cybersecurity or IT domain is highly beneficial.
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value for diverse stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage multiple opportunities, and meet commission-based performance targets.
* Preferred qualifications include a degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, and industry certifications such as CEH, CompTIA Security+, CISSP, or equivalent.

a3882c9a.title: Delivery Lead
a3882c9a.description:
**Job Title: Delivery Lead**

The Senior Process Consultant / Delivery Lead is responsible for leading a Sub Value Stream portfolio / Global Programme and driving end-to-end process re-engineering and transformation initiatives to deliver agreed transformation objectives.

The purpose of the Operation Transformation Process Consultant is to support the end-to-end process re-engineering / transformation activities that will deliver transformation goals.

The role requires deep expertise in customer-centric, data-driven process improvement and transformation, covering 4Cs: Customer, Colleague, Cost, Control, and Scalability. The Delivery Lead drives strategic planning and supports Operating Models, governance, tooling, and delivery execution to ensure sustainable business outcomes.

The role also acts as a change catalyst, partnering with Global Business Lines across geographies (primarily home and priority markets) and supporting multiple internal engagements to drive measurable performance improvement.

**In this role, you will:**

* Operate at a Programme delivery level, working for global business and regions and helping the Operations Transformation, business transformation to focus on end customers.
* To deliver the Global Ops transformation programs delivering P&L targets by focusing on the globally directed projects and initiatives by identifying strategic opportunities, designing, implementing, and embedding the change to the operations processes.
* Responsible for leading transformation of different complexities focusing on end-to-end digital journeys with a lens on scalable and reusable solutions and leading other Delivery Leads & Senior Process consultant’s in managing a large transformation program to deliver an agreed set of business objectives.
* Facilitate program governance, RAID management, Fortnightly / Monthly governance packs for Accounts Business Services. Position ID validation with Finance, Anaplan Governance Oversight, Change Request (CRs) Management, JIRA Ticket Housekeeping, Forecast Confidence analysis with Operations Leads by providing a forward view.
* The role requires to oversee and mentor Delivery Leads and Senior process consultants in a program/project environment guiding them to deliver program/project objectives
* For specific functional areas, deliver step change in operational performance (cost, service levels, and customer satisfaction) through identification and successful initiation of new process improvement initiatives aligned with local/regional transformation goals.
* Act as a strategic transformation delivery lead focusing on operational excellence & working closing with stakeholders to identify key projects. Provide detail input to ensure commercially viable decisions are taken on prioritizing and optimizing the project portfolio.
* Work closely with different transformation programme and providing on ground support from DBS Operations transformation perspective with Revisit projects post deployment on regular basis to validate whether the objectives are met and sustainable
* Be knowledgeable of key business drivers – WFM data, process maps, process insights, data intelligence etc. Also Organize & lead process reviews, walkthrough, bootcamp sessions.
* Mobilize right support for reengineering projects and ensuring designs are translated into implementation- including Tech funding ask, Business case creation, supporting Jira work for demand intake process.

Contemplate contingencies and develop strategies to manage risks and collaborate with other enablers & teams i.e. Automation, Technology, Operation Transformation Program Office to drive Global and local re-engineering initiatives

**Operational Performance:**

* Proven track record managing complex, multi-country and multi-stakeholder programmes.
* Strong ability to influence senior stakeholders, challenge constructively, and drive decisions in ambiguous environments.

c70b459b.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
c70b459b.description:
**About Refold**

Enterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants. We think that's the last big software category that hasn't been automated — and we're automating it.

Refold is the AI integration delivery layer. Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves.

Traction: 30+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500+ active users, 10M+ API calls processed daily, seven-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time-to-go-live by 70% and recovered 8,000+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5-month builds to 90% faster delivery.

Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30. We've raised $6.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating.

We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. This is the second AE seat in the US and the first hired to build the motion, not inherit it.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Own the technical win:**
  Lead discovery, demos, and architecture conversations from first call to signature. When a deal is won or lost on technical confidence, that outcome is yours
* **Build the proof, don't slide it:**
  Stand up working prototypes against the customer's actual systems and messy data — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce. Our product is the demo; a deck is a fallback, not a strategy
* **Run crisp POCs:**
  Design focused evaluations with explicit success criteria, timelines, and exit conditions. We're deliberately moving away from 4-week POCs — help us prove value in days
* **Speak both languages:**
  Translate schema mapping, auth flows, multi-tenancy, and in-tenant deployment into terms a CTO trusts and a VP of Professional Services can build a business case on
* **Clear security and procurement:**
  Own architecture reviews, security questionnaires, and RFP/RFI responses. Air-gapped, in-tenant deployment is one of our strongest cards — know how to play it
* **Hand off clean:**
  Partner with Delivery and our Forward Deployed Engineers so every go-live starts from a real technical plan, not a rediscovery exercise
* **Feed the platform:**
  You'll be one of our highest-signal sources of product truth. Surface the gaps and friction you hit in the field and push them into the roadmap
* **Build the SE motion:**
  Turn what works into a demo library, discovery framework, POC playbook, reference architectures, and competitive teardowns against iPaaS incumbents

**Role Information:**

* **Partners with:**
  The founding AE team and the founders directly; backed by Forward Deployed Engineers and Delivery
* **Average deal size:**
  $50–100K land / $200–300K expand
* **Average deal cycle:**
  3–6 months
* **Technical buyers you'll face:**
  CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Product, VPs of Professional Services / Delivery, plus platform architects and security reviewers
* **Ideal customer:**
  Sales-led with an integrations page, an internal PS team or SI dependency, and enterprise deals that hinge on connectors
* **Competitive set:**
  iPaaS and middleware incumbents (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, SnapLogic) and in-house build
* **Current growth team:**
  1 BDR, 1 AE, 2 Marketing, 4 Post-Sale, plus a 20-person engineering and delivery org

**Required Skills & Abilities**

* **Proven SE:**
  5–8 years in solutions engineering, pre-sales, or technical consulting at a SaaS, data, or AI company. This is a hard requirement — we're not training someone into the seat
* **Builder, not just a presenter:**
  Hands-on with APIs and data integration, and fluent enough in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript to build a working prototype yourself over a weekend
* **Enterprise systems fluency:**
  Real experience with systems of record — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Dynamics — and the messy parts: custom fields, schema mapping, OAuth, retries, idempotency, why an integration broke at 2 am
* **Sales instinct:**
  You've sold to or with product and professional services teams at software companies and understand what changes when your buyer's customer is the end user
* **Room-ready:**
  You can hold a CTO's attention, survive a security review, and be the calm one when the demo environment misbehaves
* **High ownership in ambiguity:**
  No playbook exists yet. You'll write it while running live deals, and you'll be comfortable doing both at once

**Nice to Have**

* Background in iPaaS, middleware, integration, or data infrastructure — or a track record of selling against MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or SnapLogic
* Hands-on with LLMs and agentic frameworks, not just familiar with the concepts
* Experience with air-gapped, in-tenant, or customer-VPC deployments and the security conversations that come with them
* Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes)
* First-SE or early-stage experience where you built the function, not joined one
* Worked day-to-day with an offshore engineering or delivery team

9c0e4a71.title: Lead Solution Architect - ADMS Presales | Bespoke Applications, Azure & Digital Modernization
9c0e4a71.description:
Job Location: Pune, Noida, Chennai, Bangalore
  
  
Location Flexibility: Multiple Locations in Country
  
  
Req Id: 12807
  
  
Posting Start Date: 10/13/26
  
  
At Fujitsu, we've been driven to create a sustainable world through innovation since 1935. Today, we lead in digital transformation globally with our 130,000 employees across 50+ countries. We empower our diverse community to achieve greatness through career development and opportunities. Explore our internal positions and join us in shaping a brighter future. Thank you for being a part of Fujitsu. We look forward to growing together toward a brighter future.
  
  
**Lead Solution Architect- Bespoke Applications, Azure & Digital Modernization**
**Role family:**
Business Consulting / Solution Architecture
  
  
**Technology focus:**
Azure, web, mobile, APIs, microservices and integration
  
  
**Ideal Candidate**
A customer-oriented Lead Solution Architect who combines broad architectural thinking with hands-on engineering credibility. The candidate should be able to navigate from business problem to solution strategy, defend choices with senior stakeholders, and guide multidisciplinary teams toward a secure, scalable, supportable and commercially viable outcome.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Own end-to-end architecture and presales solutioning for bespoke application engagements, translating business needs into secure, scalable and delivery-ready solutions across modern user experiences, cloud-native platforms, integration and application modernization.
  
  
**Role Summary**
The Lead Solution Architect will provide technical and consulting leadership across complex bespoke application opportunities and transformation programs. The role combines customer-facing presales, application architecture, business and technical analysis, cloud-native engineering, estimation, migration planning and delivery governance. The successful candidate will shape pragmatic solutions that balance business outcomes, user experience, security, operability, cost, risk and delivery feasibility.
  
  
Application Solution Architect
  
  

* Lead customer discovery, architecture workshops, and solution definition from opportunity qualification through proposal, solution defence, and transition to delivery.
* Own end-to-end architecture across user experience, applications, APIs, integration, data, security, Azure cloud, DevSecOps, observability, and service management.
* Translate business and technical requirements into target architectures, modernization roadmaps, estimates, assumptions, dependencies, and delivery-ready artefacts.
* Assess legacy applications, technical debt, cloud readiness, and non-functional requirements; define rationalisation and migration strategies using the 6R approach.
* Design scalable web, mobile, microservices, event-driven, and cloud-native solutions, selecting technologies based on fit, maintainability, and delivery context.
* Lead RFI/RFP/RFQ solutioning, including technical proposals, effort and cost estimates, delivery models, presentations, proofs of concept, solution defence, and commercial clarifications.
* Guide design, development, migration, code reviews, testing, CI/CD, security, and resolution of complex engineering risks.
* Partner with sales, bid management, delivery, security, cloud, data, service, and commercial teams to ensure solutions are competitive, executable, and supportable.
* Establish architecture standards, reusable patterns, governance, and quality gates, and provide leadership through mobilisation and early delivery.
* Coach architects and engineering teams and contribute to reference architectures, accelerators, playbooks, and knowledge assets.

Core Technical Capabilities
  
  

* Application architecture: Layered and modular design, domain-driven principles, microservices, event-driven patterns, APIs, integration, and cloud-native design.
* Modernisation and migration: Application rationalisation, 6R assessments, technical-debt analysis, monolith decomposition, containerisation, migration sequencing, and roadmap development.
* Cloud and engineering: Azure hosting, serverless and container patterns, identity, data services, Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated testing, observability, SRE-aligned operability, and FinOps-aware decisions.
* Design and development: Responsive web and mobile solutions, accessibility, usability, design systems, coding practices, code reviews, testing strategy, and engineering-quality controls.
* Programming and frameworks: TypeScript, JavaScript, NativeScript, Angular, React, Flutter, Spring Boot, and Node.js.
* Analysis and delivery: Requirements elicitation, process and capability analysis, functional decomposition, NFR definition, dependency analysis, solution option assessment, backlog shaping, sprint planning, and Agile architecture governance.
* Architecture governance: Context, component, deployment, integration, data, security, and NFR views; decision records; traceability; architecture reviews; standards compliance; risk management; and handover criteria.

Leadership and Consulting Skills
  
  

* Excellent executive communication, presentation, facilitation, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical decisions in business terms.
* Strong analytical, estimation, troubleshooting, and structured problem-solving capability, with clear articulation of trade-offs.
* Customer-focused and commercially aware, with an understanding of how architecture choices affect cost, risk, schedule, scalability, serviceability, and competitive positioning.
* Collaborative and credible across matrix teams, cultures, and time zones, with the ability to influence without authority and manage competing priorities.
* Strong ownership, adaptability, resilience, quality orientation, and the ability to coach architects and engineers.

**Experience And Qualifications**

* Significant experience in application solution architecture, bespoke software engineering, technology consulting, or an equivalent customer-facing role.
* Demonstrated experience designing and modernising enterprise applications across web, mobile, API, integration, and cloud platforms.
* Experience leading architecture and solutioning across presales and delivery, including estimation, proposal development, and transition to implementation.
* Practical understanding of Azure solution patterns, security, resilience, integration, DevSecOps, operational readiness, and Agile delivery.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Relevant cloud, architecture, Agile, project-management, or engineering certifications are desirable.

**Technology and Platform Exposure**
**Front end and mobile:**
Angular, React, Flutter, NativeScript, TypeScript, JavaScript, responsive design and accessibility.
  
  
**Back end and APIs:**
Spring Boot, Node.js, REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices, event-driven services and API management.
  
  
**Cloud and containers:**
Microsoft Azure, containers, Kubernetes, serverless services, platform services, hybrid integration and cloud governance.
  
  
**Integration and Middleware:**
API gateways, messaging, event streaming, enterprise integration patterns and service-to-service security.
  
  
**Engineering and delivery:**
Git-based engineering, CI/CD, automated testing, code quality, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code and environment strategy.
  
  
**Operations:**
Monitoring, logging, tracing, alerting, resilience, backup/recovery, service readiness and support transition.
  
  
Relocation Supported: Yes
  
  
Visa Sponsorship Approved: No
  
  
At Fujitsu, we are committed to an inclusive recruitment process that values the diverse backgrounds and experiences of all applicants. We believe that hiring people from a wide variety of backgrounds makes us stronger, not because it's the right thing to do, but because it allows us to draw on a wider range of perspectives and life experiences.
